verses.original: ਸੰਕਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਰੈ ਜੋਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)kaT nahee parai jon nahee aavai naam nira(n)jan jaa ko re ||
verses.translation: He does not fall into misfortune, and He does not take birth; His Name is the Immaculate Lord.

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਐਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਾਈ ਨ ਬਾਪੋ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੭੦॥
verses.translit: kabeer ko suaamee aaiso Thaakur jaa kai maiee na baapo re ||2||19||70||
verses.translation: Kabeer's Lord is such a Lord and Master, who has no mother or father. ||2||19||70||
Gauree:

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਉ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਲੋਗੁ ਨਿੰਦਉ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhau ni(n)dhau mo kau log ni(n)dhau ||
verses.translation: Slander me, slander me - go ahead, people, and slander me.
Slander is pleasing to the Lord's humble servant.
Slander is my father, slander is my mother. ||1||Pause||
If I am slandered, I go to heaven;
the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides within my mind.
If my heart is pure, and I am slandered,
then the slanderer washes my clothes. ||1||
One who slanders me is my friend;
the slanderer is in my thoughts.
The slanderer is the one who prevents me from being slandered.
The slanderer wishes me long life. ||2||
I have love and affection for the slanderer.
Slander is my salvation.
Slander is the best thing for servant Kabeer.
The slanderer is drowned, while I am carried across. ||3||20||71||

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਤੂੰ ਐਸਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raajaa raam too(n) aaisaa nirabhau taran taaran raam raiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O my Sovereign Lord King, You are Fearless; You are the Carrier to carry us across, O my Lord King. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਹੋਤੇ ਤਬ ਤੁਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਬ ਤੁਮ ਹਹੁ ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jab ham hote tab tum naahee ab tum hahu ham naahee ||
verses.translation: When I was, then You were not; now that You are, I am not.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਏਕ ਭਏ ਹਹਿ ਏਕੈ ਦੇਖਤ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ab ham tum ek bhe heh ekai dhekhat man pateeaahee ||1||
verses.translation: Now, You and I have become one; seeing this, my mind is content. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਬ ਬਲੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਅਬ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲੁ ਨ ਖਟਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jab budh hotee tab bal kaisaa ab budh bal na khaTaiee ||
verses.translation: When there was wisdom, how could there be strength? Now that there is wisdom, strength cannot prevail.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਦਲੀ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੭੨॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer budh har liee meree budh badhalee sidh paiee ||2||21||72||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, the Lord has taken away my wisdom, and I have attained spiritual perfection. ||2||21||72||
Gauree:

verses.original: ਖਟ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਬੀਚ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: khaT nem kar koThaRee baa(n)dhee basat anoop beech paiee ||
verses.translation: He fashioned the body chamber with six rings, and placed within it the incomparable thing.

verses.original: ਕੁੰਜੀ ਕੁਲਫੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ku(n)jee kulaf praan kar raakhe karate baar na laiee ||1||
verses.translation: He made the breath of life the watchman, with lock and key to protect it; the Creator did this in no time at all. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮਨ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ab man jaagat rahu re bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Keep your mind awake and aware now, O Sibling of Destiny.

verses.original: ਗਾਫਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ਚੋਰੁ ਮੁਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gaafal hoi kai janam gavaio chor musai ghar jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You were careless, and you have wasted your life; your home is being plundered by thieves. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਪਹਰੂਆ ਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch paharooaa dhar meh rahate tin kaa nahee pateeaaraa ||
verses.translation: The five senses stand as guards at the gate, but now can they be trusted?

verses.original: ਚੇਤਿ ਸੁਚੇਤ ਚਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਲੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਉਜਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chet suchet chit hoi rahu tau lai paragaas ujaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: When you are conscious in your consciousness, you shall be enlightened and illuminated. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਉ ਘਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੁ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: nau ghar dhekh ju kaaman bhoolee basat anoop na paiee ||
verses.translation: Seeing the nine openings of the body, the soul-bride is led astray; she does not obtain that incomparable thing.

verses.original: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਵੈ ਘਰ ਮੂਸੇ ਦਸਵੈਂ ਤਤੁ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥੨੨॥੭੩॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer navai ghar moose dhasavai(n) tat samaiee ||3||22||73||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, the nine openings of the body are being plundered; rise up to the Tenth Gate, and discover the true essence. ||3||22||73||
Gauree:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਆਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: maiee moh avar na jaanio aanaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: O mother, I do not know any other, except Him.

verses.original: ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਜਾਸੁ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤਾਸੁ ਬਸਹਿ ਮੋਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: siv sanakaadh jaas gun gaaveh taas baseh more praanaanaa(n) || rahaau ||
verses.translation: My breath of life resides in Him, whose praises are sung by Shiva and Sanak and so many others. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੰਮਿਤ ਗਗਨ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhe pragaas giaan gur ga(n)mit gagan ma(n)ddal meh dhiaanaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: My heart is illuminated by spiritual wisdom; meeting the Guru, I meditate in the Sky of the Tenth Gate.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੈ ਰੋਗ ਭੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਾਗੇ ਮਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bikhai rog bhai ba(n)dhan bhaage man nij ghar sukh jaanaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: The diseases of corruption, fear and bondage have run away; my mind has come to know peace in its own true home. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਰਤਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੂਸਰ ਮਨਹਿ ਨ ਆਨਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: ek sumat rat jaan maan prabh dhoosar maneh na aanaanaa ||
verses.translation: Imbued with a balanced single-mindedness, I know and obey God; nothing else enters my mind.

verses.original: ਚੰਦਨ ਬਾਸੁ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਬਾਸਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਘਟਿਓ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dhan baas bhe man baasan tiaag ghaTio abhimaanaanaa ||2||
verses.translation: My mind has become fragrant with the scent of sandalwood; I have renounced egotistical selfishness and conceit. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਗਾਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹੈ ਥਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan gai dhiaai jas Thaakur taas prabhoo hai thaanaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: That humble being, who sings and meditates on the Praises of his Lord and Master, is the dwelling-place of God.

verses.original: ਤਿਹ ਬਡ ਭਾਗ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਮਥਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: teh badd bhaag basio man jaa kai karam pradhaan mathaanaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: He is blessed with great good fortune; the Lord abides in his mind. Good karma radiates from his forehead. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵ ਸਹਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਓ ਏਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaaT sakat siv sahaj pragaasio ekai ek samaanaanaa ||
verses.translation: I have broken the bonds of Maya; the intuitive peace and poise of Shiva has dawned within me, and I am merged in oneness with the One.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਰਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੭੪॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer gur bheT mahaa sukh bhramat rahe man maanaanaa(n) ||4||23||74||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, meeting the Guru, I have found absolute peace. My mind has ceased its wanderings; I am happy. ||4||23||74||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਬਾਵਨ ਅਖਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raag gauRee poorabee baavan akharee kabeer jeeau kee
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Baawan Akhree Of Kabeer Jee:
One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਬਾਵਨ ਅਛਰ ਲੋਕ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਇਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: baavan achhar lok trai sabh kachh in hee maeh ||
verses.translation: Through these fifty-two letters, the three worlds and all things are described.

verses.original: ਏ ਅਖਰ ਖਿਰਿ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਓਇ ਅਖਰ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: e akhar khir jaahige oi akhar in meh naeh ||1||
verses.translation: These letters shall perish; they cannot describe the Imperishable Lord. ||1||
Wherever description is possible, only there the letters get used.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਅਬੋਲ ਤਹ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh abol teh man na rahaavaa ||
verses.translation: Where the state is beyond description, there, the mind itself ceases to be a descriptor.
He is in both speech and silence.

verses.original: ਜਸ ਓਹੁ ਹੈ ਤਸ ਲਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jas oh hai tas lakhai na koiee ||2||
verses.translation: No one can know or describe Him as He is. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਲਹ ਲਹਉ ਤਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ਕਹਉ ਤ ਕੋ ਉਪਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aleh lahau tau kiaa kahau kahau ta ko upakaar ||
verses.translation: If I come to know the Lord, what can I say; what good does it do to speak?

verses.original: ਬਟਕ ਬੀਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: baTak beej meh rav rahio jaa ko teen lok bisathaar ||3||
verses.translation: His expanse spreads across the three worlds and He is contained within it just like the banyan tree is contained within its seed (and the seed is contained within the banyan tree). ||3||

verses.original: ਅਲਹ ਲਹੰਤਾ ਭੇਦ ਛੈ ਕਛੁ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਭੇਦ ॥
verses.translit: aleh laha(n)taa bhedh chhai kachh kachh paio bhedh ||
verses.translation: One who tries to know the Unknowable Lord, his dilemma gets resolved, and bit by bit, the mystery disappears.

verses.original: ਉਲਟਿ ਭੇਦ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਭੰਗ ਅਛੇਦ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aulaT bhedh man bedhio paio abha(n)g achhedh ||4||
verses.translation: Turning away from the world, one's mind is pierced through with this mystery, and one obtains the Indestructible, Impenetrable Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਤੁਰਕ ਤਰੀਕਤਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: turak tareekat jaaneeaai hi(n)dhoo bedh puraan ||
verses.translation: The devout Muslim seeks guidance from the Tariqat ( Sufi scripture) ; the devout Hindu from the Vedas and Puraanas.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਸਮਝਾਵਨ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਕਛੂਅਕ ਪੜੀਐ ਗਿਆਨ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: man samajhaavan kaarane kachhooak paReeaai giaan ||5||
verses.translation: To instruct their minds, people ought to study some sort of spiritual wisdom. ||5||
I know only the One, the Universal Creator, the Primal Being.

verses.original: ਲਿਖਿ ਅਰੁ ਮੇਟੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: likh ar meTai taeh na maanaa ||
verses.translation: I do not believe in anyone whom the Lord writes (into being) and erases.
If someone knows the One, the Universal Creator,
Knowing Him, (his elevated state) shall not perish. ||6||
KAKKA: When the rays of Divine Light come into the heart-lotus,
the moon-light of Maya cannot close the blossomed heart lotus again.

verses.original: ਅਰੁ ਜੇ ਤਹਾ ਕੁਸਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: ar je tahaa kusam ras paavaa ||
verses.translation: And if one obtains the subtle fragrance of that spiritual flower,
I cannot describe the indescribable; I could speak, but what can I explain/describe? ||7||
KHAKHA: When this mind (-bird that has received a ray of the divine light) has entered the tree hollow ( refuge of the Lord)

verses.original: ਖੋੜੇ ਛਾਡਿ ਨ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: khoRe chhaadd na dheh dhis dhaavaa ||
verses.translation: It does not leave this tree hollow to wander in the ten directions.
Then it (the mind bird) comes to know the source of compassion, the Lord and stays.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਖਿਅਉ ਅਖੈ ਪਦੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: tau hoi nikhiaau akhai padh lahai ||8||
verses.translation: then, it becomes (one with) the immortal Lord, and attains the state of eternal dignity. ||8||
GAGGA: One who understands the Guru's Word
does not listen to anything else.
He remains unattached like a bird and does not go anywhere,
when he grasps the Ungraspable Lord and dwells in the sky of the Tenth Gate. ||9||
GHAGHA: He dwells in each and every body.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਫੂਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT fooTe ghaT kabeh na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Even when a body-pitcher bursts, the existence of the Lord does not diminish.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ਘਾਟ ਜਉ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: taa ghaT maeh ghaaT jau paavaa ||
verses.translation: When someone finds the landing/port ( to cross the world-sea) within his own heart,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਘਟੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਵਘਟ ਕਤ ਧਾਵਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: so ghaT chhaadd avaghaT kat dhaavaa ||10||
verses.translation: why should he abandon that landing/port to wander around? ||10||

verses.original: ਙੰਙਾ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਵਾਰੋ ਸੰਦੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: n(g)(n)n(g)aa nigreh saneh kar niravaaro sa(n)dheh ||
verses.translation: NGANGA: Restrain yourself, love the Lord, and dismiss your doubts.

verses.original: ਨਾਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਭਾਜੀਐ ਪਰਮ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਏਹ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naahee dhekh na bhaajeeaai param siaanap eh ||11||
verses.translation: (This task is hard, but) do not run away because the task seems hard and not attainable; this is the highest wisdom. ||11||
CHACHA: He created this world as if its a great painting.
Let go of this painting, and remember the Painter.
The hassle is that this painting is so wondrous.
( To save yourself from this attachment) leave (contemplation of) the painting and focus your consciousness on the Painter. ||12||
CHHACHHA: The Sovereign Lord of the Universe is here with you.

verses.original: ਛਕਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਰਹਹੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: chhak k na rahahu chhaadd k na aasaa ||
verses.translation: Why are you so unhappy? Why don't you abandon your desires?

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਤਉ ਛਿਨ ਛਿਨ ਸਮਝਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: re man mai tau chhin chhin samajhaavaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, each and every moment I try to instruct you,
but you forsake Him, and entangle yourself with others. ||13||
JAJJA: If someone burns his body while he is still alive,
and burns away the desires of his youth, then he finds the right way.

verses.original: ਅਸ ਜਰਿ ਪਰ ਜਰਿ ਜਰਿ ਜਬ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: as jar par jar jar jab rahai ||
verses.translation: When he burns his desire for his own wealth, and that of others,
then he finds the Divine Light. ||14||
JHAJHA: You are entangled in the world, and you do not know how to get untangled.
You hold back in fear, and are not approved by the Lord.
Why do you talk such nonsense, trying to convince others?
Stirring up arguments, you shall only obtain more arguments. ||15||

verses.original: ਞੰਞਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਜੁ ਘਟ ਰਹਿਓ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: n(j)(n)n(j)aa nikaT ju ghaT rahio dhoor kahaa taj jai ||
verses.translation: NYANYA: He dwells near you, deep within your heart; why do you leave Him and go far away?

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਜਗੁ ਢੂਢਿਅਉ ਨੇਰਉ ਪਾਇਅਉ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: jaa kaaran jag ddooddiaau nerau paiaau taeh ||16||
verses.translation: I searched the whole world for Him, but I found Him near myself. ||16||
TATTA: It is such a difficult path, to find Him within your own heart.

verses.original: ਖੋਲਿ ਕਪਾਟ ਮਹਲਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: khol kapaaT mahal k na jaahee ||
verses.translation: Open the doors within, and enter the Mansion of His Presence.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਅਟਲ ਟਲਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh aTal Tal kateh na jaavaa ||
verses.translation: Beholding the Immovable Lord, you shall not slip and go anywhere else.
You shall remain firmly attached to the Lord, and your heart will be happy. ||17||
T'HAT'HA: Keep yourself far away from this mirage.
With great difficulty, I have calmed my mind.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਠਗਿ ਠਗਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin Thag Thagiaa sagal jag khaavaa ||
verses.translation: That cheater, who cheated and devoured the whole world

verses.original: ਸੋ ਠਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ ਠਉਰ ਮਨੁ ਆਵਾ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: so Thag Thagiaa Thaur man aavaa ||18||
verses.translation: - I have cheated that cheater, and my mind is now at peace. ||18||
DADDA: When the Fear of God wells up, other fears depart.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਡਰ ਮਹਿ ਡਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: taa ddar meh ddar rahiaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: Other fears are absorbed into that Fear.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਡਰ ਡਰੈ ਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: jau ddar ddarai ta fir ddar laagai ||
verses.translation: When one rejects the Fear of God, then other fears cling to him.

verses.original: ਨਿਡਰ ਹੂਆ ਡਰੁ ਉਰ ਹੋਇ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: niddar hooaa ddar ur hoi bhaagai ||19||
verses.translation: But if he becomes fearless, the fears of his heart run away. ||19||
DHADHA: Why do you search in other directions?
Searching for Him like this, the breath of life runs out.
When I returned after climbing the mountain,

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਗੜੁ ਗੜਿਓ ਸੁ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: jeh gaR gaRio su gaR meh paavaa ||20||
verses.translation: I found Him in the fortress - the fortress which He Himself made. ||20||

verses.original: ਣਾਣਾ ਰਣਿ ਰੂਤਉ ਨਰ ਨੇਹੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: naanaa ran rootau nar nehee karai ||
verses.translation: NANNA: The warrior who fights on the battle-field should keep up and press on.
He should not yield, and he should not retreat.
Blessed is the coming of one
who conquers the one and renounces the many. ||21||
TATTA: The impassable world-ocean cannot be crossed over;
the body remains embroiled in the three worlds.
But when the Lord of the three worlds enters into the body,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਤਤਹਿ ਤਤ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: tau tateh tat miliaa sach paavaa ||22||
verses.translation: then one's essence merges with the essence of reality, and the True Lord is attained. ||22||
T'HAT'HA: He is Unfathomable; His depths cannot be fathomed.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਅਥਾਹ ਇਹੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: oh athaeh ih thir na rahaavaa ||
verses.translation: He is Unfathomable; this body is impermanent, and unstable.
The mortal builds his dwelling upon this tiny space;
without any pillars, he wishes to support a mansion. ||23||
DADDA: Whatever is seen shall perish.
Contemplate the One who is unseen.
When the key is inserted in the Tenth Gate,
then the Blessed Vision of the Merciful Lord's Darshan is seen. ||24||
DHADHA: When one ascends from the lower realms of the earth to the higher realms of the heavens, then everything is resolved.
The Lord dwells in both the lower and higher worlds.
Leaving the earth, the soul ascends to the heavens;

verses.original: ਤਉ ਅਰਧਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: tau aradheh uradh miliaa sukh paavaa ||25||
verses.translation: then, the lower and higher join together, and peace is obtained. ||25||
NANNA: The days and nights go by; I am looking for the Lord.
Looking for Him, my eyes have become blood-shot.
After looking and looking,when He is finally found,
then the one who was looking merges into the One who was looked for. ||26||
PAPPA: He is limitless; His limits cannot be found.
I have attuned myself to the Supreme Light.
One who controls his five senses
rises above both sin and virtue. ||27||
FAFFA: Even without the flower, the fruit is produced.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਫਲ ਫੰਕ ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: taa fal fa(n)k lakhai jau koiee ||
verses.translation: One who looks at a slice of that fruit
and reflects on it, will not be consigned to reincarnation.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਫਲ ਫੰਕ ਸਭੈ ਤਨ ਫਾਰੈ ॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: taa fal fa(n)k sabhai tan faarai ||28||
verses.translation: A slice of that fruit slices all bodies. ||28||
BABBA: When one drop blends with another drop,
then these drops cannot be separated again.
Become the Lord's slave, and hold tight to His meditation.
If you turn your thoughts to the Lord, the Lord will take care of you like a relative. ||29||
BHABHA: When doubt is pierced, union is achieved.
I have shattered my fear, and now I have come to have faith.
I thought that He was outside of me, but now I know that He is within me.
When I came to understand this mystery, then I recognized the Lord. ||30||
MAMMA: Clinging to the source, the mind is satisfied.

verses.original: ਮਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: maramee hoi su man kau jaanai ||
verses.translation: One who knows this mystery understands his own mind.
Let no one delay in uniting his mind.

verses.original: ਮਗਨ ਭਇਆ ਤੇ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: magan bhiaa te so sach paavai ||31||
verses.translation: Those who obtain the True Lord are immersed in delight. ||31||

verses.original: ਮਮਾ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਸਾਧੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mamaa man siau kaaj hai man saadhe sidh hoi ||
verses.translation: MAMMA: The mortal's business is with his own mind; one who disciplines his mind attains perfection.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਮਨ ਸਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: man hee man siau kahai kabeeraa man saa miliaa na koi ||32||
verses.translation: Only the mind can deal with the mind; says Kabeer, I have not met anything like the mind. ||32||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਕਤੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: eih man sakatee ih man seeau ||
verses.translation: This mind is Shakti; this mind is Shiva.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: eih man pa(n)ch tat ko jeeau ||
verses.translation: This mind is the life of the five elements.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲੇ ਜਉ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih man le jau unaman rahai ||
verses.translation: When this mind is channeled, and guided to enlightenment,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਕੀ ਬਾਤੈ ਕਹੈ ॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: tau teen lok kee baatai kahai ||33||
verses.translation: it can describe the secrets of the three worlds. ||33||

verses.original: ਯਯਾ ਜਉ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਸਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: yayaa jau jaaneh tau dhuramat han kar bas kaiaa gaau ||
verses.translation: YAYYA: If you know anything, then destroy your evil-mindedness, and subjugate the body-village.

verses.original: ਰਣਿ ਰੂਤਉ ਭਾਜੈ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਰਉ ਥਾਰਉ ਨਾਉ ॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: ran rootau bhaajai nahee soorau thaarau naau ||34||
verses.translation: When you are engaged in the battle, don't run away; then, you shall be known as a spiritual hero. ||34||
RARRA: I have found tastes to be tasteless.
Becoming tasteless, I have realized that taste.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਰਸ ਛਾਡੇ ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: eeh ras chhaadde uh ras aavaa ||
verses.translation: Abandoning these tastes, I have found that taste.

verses.original: ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਇਹ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: auh ras peeaa ieh ras nahee bhaavaa ||35||
verses.translation: Drinking in that taste, this taste is no longer pleasing. ||35||
LALLA: Embrace such love for the Lord in your mind,

verses.original: ਅਨਤ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: anat na jai param sach paavai ||
verses.translation: that you shall not have to go to any other; you shall attain the supreme truth.

verses.original: ਅਰੁ ਜਉ ਤਹਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ar jau tahaa prem liv laavai ||
verses.translation: And if you embrace love and affection for Him there,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਅਲਹ ਲਹੈ ਲਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: tau aleh lahai leh charan samaavai ||36||
verses.translation: then you shall obtain the Lord; obtaining Him, you shall be absorbed in His Feet. ||36||
WAWA: Time and time again, dwell upon the Lord.
Dwelling upon the Lord, defeat shall not come to you.

verses.original: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜੇ ਬਿਸਨਤਨਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: bal bal je bisanatanaa jas gaavai ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those, who sing the praises of the Saints, the sons of the Lord.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: visan mile sabh hee sach paavai ||37||
verses.translation: Meeting the Lord, total Truth is obtained. ||37||

verses.original: ਵਾਵਾ ਵਾਹੀ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਵਾ ਜਾਨੇ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaavaa vaahee jaaneeaai vaa jaane ih hoi ||
verses.translation: WAWA: Know Him. By knowing Him, this mortal becomes Him.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਜਬ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਬ ਮਿਲਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: eih ar oh jab milai tab milat na jaanai koi ||38||
verses.translation: When this soul and that Lord are blended, then, having been blended, they cannot be known separately. ||38||
SASSA: Discipline your mind with sublime perfection.
Refrain from that talk which attracts the heart.
The heart is attracted, when love wells up.
The King of the three worlds is perfectly pervading and permeating there. ||39||

verses.original: ਖਖਾ ਖੋਜਿ ਪਰੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥ ਜੋ ਖੋਜੈ ਸੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: khakhaa khoj parai jau koiee || jo khojai so bahur na hoiee ||
verses.translation: KHAKHA: Anyone who seeks Him, and by seeking Him, finds Him, shall not be born again.
When someone seeks Him, and comes to understand and contemplate Him,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਤ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੪੦॥
verses.translit: tau bhavajal tarat na laavai baaraa ||40||
verses.translation: then he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean in an instant. ||40||
SASSA: The bed of the soul-bride is adorned by her Husband Lord;
her skepticism is dispelled.

verses.original: ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖ ਛਾਡਿ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: alap sukh chhaadd param sukh paavaa ||
verses.translation: Renouncing the shallow pleasures of the world, she obtains the supreme delight.

verses.original: ਤਬ ਇਹ ਤ੍ਰੀਅ ਓੁਹੁ ਕੰਤੁ ਕਹਾਵਾ ॥੪੧॥
verses.translit: tab ieh treea ouh ka(n)t kahaavaa ||41||
verses.translation: Then, she is the soul-bride; He is called her Husband Lord. ||41||
HAHA: He exists, but He is not known to exist.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਤਬਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jab hee hoi tabeh man maanaa ||
verses.translation: When He is known to exist, then the mind is pleased and appeased.

verses.original: ਹੈ ਤਉ ਸਹੀ ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: hai tau sahee lakhai jau koiee ||
verses.translation: Of course the Lord exists, if one could only understand Him.

verses.original: ਤਬ ਓਹੀ ਉਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪੨॥
verses.translit: tab ohee uh eh na hoiee ||42||
verses.translation: Then, He alone exists, and not this mortal being. ||42||

verses.original: ਲਿੰਉ ਲਿੰਉ ਕਰਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: li(n)au li(n)au karat firai sabh log ||
verses.translation: Everyone goes around saying, ""I'll take this, and I'll take that.""
Because of that, they suffer in terrible pain.

verses.original: ਲਖਿਮੀ ਬਰ ਸਿਉ ਜਉ ਲਿਉ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: lakhimee bar siau jau liau laavai ||
verses.translation: When someone comes to love the Lord of Lakhshmi,

verses.original: ਸੋਗੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪੩॥
verses.translit: sog miTai sabh hee sukh paavai ||43||
verses.translation: his sorrow departs, and he obtains total peace. ||43||
KHAKHA: Many have wasted their lives, and then perished.
Wasting away, they do not remember the Lord, even now.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨਿ ਜਉ ਮਨਾ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: ab jag jaan jau manaa rahai ||
verses.translation: But if someone, even now, comes to know the transitory nature of the world and restrain his mind,

verses.original: ਜਹ ਕਾ ਬਿਛੁਰਾ ਤਹ ਥਿਰੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੪੪॥
verses.translit: jeh kaa bichhuraa teh thir lahai ||44||
verses.translation: he shall find his permanent home, from which he was separated. ||44||
The fifty-two letters have been joined together.
But people cannot recognize the One Word of God.
Kabeer speaks the Shabad, the Word of Truth.
One who is a Pandit, a religious scholar, must remain fearless.
It is the business of the scholarly person to join letters.
The spiritual person contemplates the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਜੀਅ ਜੈਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai jeea jaisee budh hoiee ||
verses.translation: According to the wisdom within the mind,
says Kabeer, so does one come to understand. ||45||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਥਿਤੰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੰੀ ॥
verses.translit: raag gauRee thita(n)ee kabeer jee ka(n)ee ||
verses.translation: Raag Gauree, T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days Of Kabeer Jee:
Shalok:
There are fifteen lunar days, and seven days of the week.
Says Kabeer, it is neither here nor there.
When the Siddhas and seekers come to know the Lord's mystery,
they themselves become the Creator; they themselves become the Divine Lord. ||1||
T'hitee:
On the day of the new moon, give up your hopes.
Remember the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
You shall attain the Gate of Liberation while yet alive.
You shall come to know the Shabad, the Word of the Fearless Lord, and the essence of your own inner being. ||1||
One who enshrines love for the Lotus Feet of the Lord of the Universe

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh bhe man niramal har keeratan meh anadhin jaagaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: - by the Grace of the Saints, her mind becomes pure; night and day, she remains awake and aware, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1||Pause||
On the first day of the lunar cycle, contemplate the Beloved Lord.
He is playing within the heart; He has no body - He is Infinite.
The pain of death never consumes that person
who remains absorbed in the Primal Lord God. ||2||
On the second day of the lunar cycle, know that there are two beings within the fiber of the body.
Maya and God are blended with everything.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਬਢੈ ਨ ਘਟਤਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naa oh baddai na ghaTataa jai ||
verses.translation: God does not increase or decrease.
He is unknowable and immaculate; He does not change. ||3||
On the third day of the lunar cycle, one who maintains his equilibrium amidst the three modes
finds the source of ecstasy and the highest status.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, faith wells up.
Outwardly, and deep within, God's Light is always radiant. ||4||
On the fourth day of the lunar cycle, restrain your fickle mind,

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਹਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh sa(n)g kabahu na bahahu ||
verses.translation: and do not ever associate with sexual desire or anger.
On land and sea, He Himself is in Himself.
He Himself meditates and chants His Chant. ||5||
On the fifth day of the lunar cycle, the five elements expand outward.
Men are occupied in the pursuit of gold and women.
How rare are those who drink in the pure essence of the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jaraa maran dhukh fer na hoi ||6||
verses.translation: They shall never again suffer the pains of old age and death. ||6||

verses.original: ਛਠਿ ਖਟੁ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਛਹੂੰ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: chhaTh khaT chakar chhahoo(n) dhis dhai ||
verses.translation: On the sixth day of the lunar cycle, the six chakras run in six directions.
Without enlightenment, the body does not remain steady.
So erase your duality and hold tight to forgiveness,

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਸੂਲ ਨ ਸਹਹੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: karam dharam kee sool na sahahu ||7||
verses.translation: and you will not have to endure the torture of karma or religious rituals. ||7||
On the seventh day of the lunar cycle, know the Word as True,
and you shall be accepted by the Lord, the Supreme Soul.
Your doubts shall be eradicated, and your pains eliminated,
and in the ocean of the celestial void, you shall find peace. ||8||
On the eighth day of the lunar cycle, the body is made of the eight ingredients.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਅਕੁਲ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: taa meh akul mahaa nidh raiaa ||
verses.translation: Within it is the Unknowable Lord, the King of the supreme treasure.
The Guru, who knows this spiritual wisdom, reveals the secret of this mystery.
Turning away from the world, He abides in the Unbreakable and Impenetrable Lord. ||9||
On the ninth day of the lunar cycle, discipline the nine gates of the body.
Keep your pulsating desires restrained.
Forget all your greed and emotional attachment;

verses.original: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਅਮਰ ਫਲ ਖਾਹੁ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: jug jug jeevahu amar fal khaahu ||10||
verses.translation: you shall live throughout the ages, eating the fruit of immortality. ||10||
On the tenth day of the lunar cycle, there is ecstasy in all directions.
Doubt is dispelled, and the Lord of the Universe is met.
He is the Embodiment of light, the incomparable essence.

verses.original: ਅਮਲ ਨ ਮਲ ਨ ਛਾਹ ਨਹੀ ਧੂਪ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: amal na mal na chhaeh nahee dhoop ||11||
verses.translation: He is stainless, without stain, beyond both sunshine and shade. ||11||
On the eleventh day of the lunar cycle, if you run in the direction of the One,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਕਟ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: tau jonee sa(n)kaT bahur na aavai ||
verses.translation: you will not have to suffer the pains of reincarnation again.
Your body will become cool, immaculate and pure.
The Lord was said to be far away, but He is found near at hand. ||12||
On the twelfth day of the lunar cycle, twelve suns rise.
Day and night, the celestial bugles vibrate the unstruck melody.
Then, one beholds the Father of the three worlds.
This is wonderful! The human being has become God! ||13||
On the thirteenth day of the lunar cycle, the thirteen holy books proclaim
that you must recognize the Lord in the nether regions of the underworld as well as the heavens.
There is no high or low, no honor or dishonor.
The Lord is pervading and permeating all. ||14||
On the fourteenth day of the lunar cycle, in the fourteen worlds
and on each and every hair, the Lord abides.
Center yourself and meditate on truth and contentment.
Speak the speech of God's spiritual wisdom. ||15||
On the day of the full moon, the full moon fills the heavens.
Its power is diffused through its gentle light.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਿਆ ਥੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: aadh a(n)t madh hoi rahiaa theer ||
verses.translation: In the beginning, in the end, and in the middle, God remains firm and steady.
Kabeer is immersed in the ocean of peace. ||16||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਵਾਰ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ੭ ॥
verses.translit: raag gauRee vaar kabeer jeeau ke 7 ||
verses.translation: Raag Gauree, The Seven Days Of The Week Of Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: baar baar har ke gun gaavau ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord each and every day.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਗਮਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur gam bhedhu su har kaa paavau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, you shall come to know the mystery of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
On Sunday, begin the devotional worship of the Lord,
and restrain the desires within the temple of the body.
When your attention is focused day and night upon that imperishable place,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੇਣੁ ਸਹਜ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tau anahadh ben sahaj meh bai ||1||
verses.translation: then the celestial flutes play the unstruck melody in tranquil peace and poise. ||1||
On Monday, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down from the moon.
Tasting it, all poisons are removed in an instant.
Restrained by Gurbani, the mind remains indoors;
drinking in this Nectar, it is intoxicated. ||2||
On Tuesday, understand reality;
you must know the way the five thieves work.
Those who leave their own home to go out wandering
shall feel the terrible wrath of the Lord, their King. ||3||
On Wednesday, one's understanding is enlightened.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai kamal meh har kaa baas ||
verses.translation: The Lord comes to dwell in the lotus of the heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੋਊ ਏਕ ਸਮ ਧਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur mil dhouoo ek sam dharai ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, one comes to look alike upon pleasure and pain,
and the inverted lotus is turned upright. ||4||
On Thursday, wash off your corruption.
Forsake the trinity, and attach yourself to the One God.
At the confluence of the three rivers of knowledge, right action and devotion, there,
why not wash away your sinful mistakes? ||5||

verses.original: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਾਰੈ ਸੁ ਇਹ ਬ੍ਰਤਿ ਚੜੈ ॥
verses.translit: sukirat sahaarai su ieh brat chaRai ||
verses.translation: On Friday, keep up and complete your fast;
day and night, you must fight against your own self.
If you restrain your five senses,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਦੂਜੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਪੈਸੈ ਕਬੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: tau dhoojee dhirasaT na paisai kabai ||6||
verses.translation: then you shall not cast your glance on another. ||6||

verses.original: ਥਾਵਰ ਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੀ ਵਟੀ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: thaavar thir kar raakhai soi || jot dhee vaTee ghaT meh joi ||
verses.translation: On Saturday, keep the candle of God's Light steady within your heart;
you will be enlightened, inwardly and outwardly.

verses.original: ਤਬ ਹੂਆ ਸਗਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tab hooaa sagal karam kaa naas ||7||
verses.translation: All your karma will be erased. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag ghaT meh dhoojee aan ||
verses.translation: Know that as long as you place your hopes in others,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਲਉ ਮਹਲਿ ਨ ਲਾਭੈ ਜਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: tau lau mahal na laabhai jaan ||
verses.translation: you shall not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
When you embrace love for the Lord,
says Kabeer, then, you shall become pure in your very fiber. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raag gauRee chetee baanee naamadheau jeeau kee
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Chaytee, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
God makes even stones float.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ ਜਨ ਕਸ ਨ ਤਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam kahat jan kas na tare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: So why shouldn't Your humble slave also float across, chanting Your Name, O Lord? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਾਰੀਲੇ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰੂਪ ਕੁਬਿਜਾ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਤਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: taareele ganikaa bin roop kubijaa biaadh ajaamal taareeale ||
verses.translation: You saved the prostitute, and the ugly hunch-back; You helped the hunter and Ajaamal swim across as well.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਬਧਿਕ ਜਨ ਤੇਊ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ॥
verses.translit: charan badhik jan teuoo mukat bhe ||
verses.translation: The hunter who shot Krishna in the foot - even he was liberated.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਕਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hau bal bal jin raam kahe ||1||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who chant the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਦਰੁ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ਦੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhaasee sut jan bidhar sudhaamaa ugrasain kau raaj dhe'ee ||
verses.translation: You saved Bidur, the son of the slave-girl, and Sudama; You restored Ugrasain to his throne.

verses.original: ਜਪ ਹੀਨ ਤਪ ਹੀਨ ਕੁਲ ਹੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹੀਨ ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਊ ਤਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: jap heen tap heen kul heen karam heen naame ke suaamee teuoo tare ||2||1||
verses.translation: Without meditation, without penance, without a good family, without good deeds, Naam Dayv's Lord and Master saved them all. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ
verses.translit: raag gauRee ravidhaas jee ke padhe gauRee guaareree
verses.translation: Raag Gauree, Padhay Of Ravi Daas Jee, Gauree Gwaarayree:
One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੋਚ ਸੋਚ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: meree sa(n)gat poch soch dhin raatee ||
verses.translation: The company I keep is wretched and low, and I am anxious day and night;
my actions are crooked, and I am of lowly birth. ||1||
O Lord, Master of the earth, Life of the soul,

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਹੁ ਮੈ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: moh na bisaarahu mai jan teraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: please do not forget me! I am Your humble servant. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਹੁ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਜਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: meree harahu bipat jan karahu subhaiee ||
verses.translation: Take away my pains, and bless Your humble servant with Your Sublime Love.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਨ ਛਾਡਉ ਸਰੀਰ ਕਲ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: charan na chhaaddau sareer kal jaiee ||2||
verses.translation: I shall not leave Your Feet, even though my body may perish. ||2||
Says Ravi Daas, I seek the protection of Your Sanctuary;

verses.original: ਬੇਗਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਲਾਂਬਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
verses.translit: beg milahu jan kar na bilaa(n)baa ||3||1||
verses.translation: please, meet Your humble servant - do not delay! ||3||1||
Baygumpura, 'the city without sorrow', is the name of the town.
There is no suffering or anxiety there.
There are no troubles or taxes on commodities there.

verses.original: ਖਉਫੁ ਨ ਖਤਾ ਨ ਤਰਸੁ ਜਵਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khauf na khataa na taras javaal ||1||
verses.translation: There is no fear, blemish or downfall there. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੂਬ ਵਤਨ ਗਹ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ab moh khoob vatan geh paiee ||
verses.translation: Now, I have found this most excellent city.

verses.original: ਊਹਾਂ ਖੈਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: uoohaa(n) khair sadhaa mere bhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: There is lasting peace and safety there, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||
God's Kingdom is steady, stable and eternal.

verses.original: ਦੋਮ ਨ ਸੇਮ ਏਕ ਸੋ ਆਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhom na sem ek so aahee ||
verses.translation: There is no second or third status; all are equal there.
That city is populous and eternally famous.
Those who live there are wealthy and contented. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਸੈਲ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: tiau tiau sail kareh jiau bhaavai ||
verses.translation: They stroll about freely, just as they please.
They know the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and no one blocks their way.
Says Ravi Daas, the emancipated shoe-maker:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਮ ਸਹਰੀ ਸੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo ham saharee su meet hamaaraa ||3||2||
verses.translation: whoever is a citizen there, is a friend of mine. ||3||2||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Gauree Bairaagan, Ravi Daas Jee:

verses.original: ਘਟ ਅਵਘਟ ਡੂਗਰ ਘਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਬੈਲੁ ਹਮਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT avaghaT ddoogar ghanaa ik niragun bail hamaar ||
verses.translation: The path to God is very treacherous and mountainous, and all I have is this worthless ox.

verses.original: ਰਮਈਏ ਸਿਉ ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ramie'ee siau ik benatee meree poo(n)jee raakh muraar ||1||
verses.translation: I offer this one prayer to the Lord, to preserve my capital. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੋ ਬਨਜਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਟਾਂਡਾ ਲਾਦਿਆ ਜਾਇ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ko banajaaro raam ko meraa Taa(n)ddaa laadhiaa jai re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Is there any merchant of the Lord to join me? My cargo is loaded, and now I am leaving. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਨਜਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਸਹਜ ਕਰਉ ਬੵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hau banajaaro raam ko sahaj karau bayeaapaar ||
verses.translation: I am the merchant of the Lord; I deal in spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਲਾਦਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mai raam naam dhan laadhiaa bikh laadhee sa(n)saar ||2||
verses.translation: I have loaded the Wealth of the Lord's Name; the world has loaded poison. ||2||

verses.original: ਉਰਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਕੇ ਦਾਨੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਲ ਪਤਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: auravaar paar ke dhaaneeaa likh leh aal pataal ||
verses.translation: O you who know this world and the world beyond: write whatever nonsense you please about me.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਤਜੀਲੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: moh jam dda(n)dd na laagiee tajeele sarab ja(n)jaal ||3||
verses.translation: The club of the Messenger of Death shall not strike me, since I have cast off all entanglements. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaisaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bh kaa taisaa ih sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Love of this world is like the pale, temporary color of the safflower.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਮਈਏ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਕਾ ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: mere ramie'ee ra(n)g majeeTh kaa kahu ravidhaas chamaar ||4||1||
verses.translation: The color of my Lord's Love, however, is permanent, like the dye of the madder plant. So says Ravi Daas, the tanner. ||4||1||
Gauree Poorbee, Ravi Daas Jee:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕੂਪੁ ਭਰਿਓ ਜੈਸੇ ਦਾਦਿਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਬਿਦੇਸੁ ਨ ਬੂਝ ॥
verses.translit: koop bhario jaise dhaadhiraa kachh dhes bidhes na boojh ||
verses.translation: The frog in the deep well knows nothing of its own country or other lands;

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਛੁ ਆਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaise meraa man bikhiaa bimohiaa kachh aaraa paar na soojh ||1||
verses.translation: just so, my mind, infatuated with corruption, understands nothing about this world or the next. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਕੇ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal bhavan ke naikaa ik chhin dharas dhikhai jee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord of all worlds: reveal to me, even for an instant, the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਲਿਨ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਮਾਧਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: malin bhiee mat maadhavaa teree gat lakhee na jai ||
verses.translation: My intellect is polluted; I cannot understand Your state, O Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਈ ਮੈ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: karahu kirapaa bhram chookiee mai sumat dheh samajhai ||2||
verses.translation: Take pity on me, dispel my doubts, and teach me true wisdom. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀਸਰ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਤੁਅ ਗੁਣ ਕਥਨੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jogeesar paaveh nahee tua gun kathan apaar ||
verses.translation: Even the great Yogis cannot describe Your Glorious Virtues; they are beyond words.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਕਾਰਣੈ ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰ ॥੩॥੧॥
verses.translit: prem bhagat kai kaaranai kahu ravidhaas chamaar ||3||1||
verses.translation: I am dedicated to Your loving devotional worship, says Ravi Daas the tanner. ||3||1||
Gauree Bairaagan:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਤੁ ਤੇਤਾ ਜਗੀ ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਪੂਜਾਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: satajug sat tetaa jagee dhuaapar poojaachaar ||
verses.translation: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, was Truth; in the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga, charitable feasts; in the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga, there was worship.

verses.original: ਤੀਨੌ ਜੁਗ ਤੀਨੌ ਦਿੜੇ ਕਲਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: teenau jug teenau dhiRe kal keval naam adhaar ||1||
verses.translation: In those three ages, people held to these three ways. But in the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, the Name of the Lord is your only Support. ||1||
How can I swim across?

verses.original: ਮੋ ਸਉ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mo sau kouoo na kahai samajhai ||
verses.translation: No one has explained to me,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨੁ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa te aavaa gavan bilai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: so that I might understand how I can escape reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਰੂਪੀਐ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bahu bidh dharam niroopeeaai karataa dheesai sabh loi ||
verses.translation: So many forms of religion have been described; the whole world is practicing them.

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਜਿਹ ਸਾਧੇ ਸਭ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kavan karam te chhooTeeaai jeh saadhe sabh sidh hoi ||2||
verses.translation: What actions will bring emancipation, and total perfection? ||2||

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਅਕਰਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਸੰਕਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: karam akaram beechaareeaai sa(n)kaa sun bedh puraan ||
verses.translation: One may distinguish between good and evil actions, and listen to the Vedas and the Puraanas,

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾ ਸਦ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਿਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saa sadh hiradhai basai kaun hirai abhimaan ||3||
verses.translation: but doubt still persists. Skepticism continually dwells in the heart, so who can eradicate egotistical pride? ||3||

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਉਦਕਿ ਪਖਾਰੀਐ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: baahar udhak pakhaareeaai ghaT bheetar bibidh bikaar ||
verses.translation: Outwardly, he washes with water, but deep within, his heart is tarnished by all sorts of vices.

verses.original: ਸੁਧ ਕਵਨ ਪਰ ਹੋਇਬੋ ਸੁਚ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sudh kavan par hoibo such ku(n)char bidh biauhaar ||4||
verses.translation: So how can he become pure? His method of purification is like that of an elephant, covering himself with dust right after his bath! ||4||

verses.original: ਰਵਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਰਜਨੀ ਜਥਾ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਨਤ ਸਭ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: rav pragaas rajanee jathaa gat jaanat sabh sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: With the rising of the sun, the night is brought to its end; the whole world knows this.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਸ ਮਾਨੋ ਤਾਬੋ ਛੁਏ ਕਨਕ ਹੋਤ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: paaras maano taabo chhue kanak hot nahee baar ||5||
verses.translation: It is believed that with the touch of the Philosopher's Stone, copper is immediately transformed into gold. ||5||

verses.original: ਪਰਮ ਪਰਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: param paras gur bheTeeaai poorab likhat lilaaT ||
verses.translation: When one meets the Supreme Philosopher's Stone, the Guru, if such pre-ordained destiny is written on one's forehead,

verses.original: ਉਨਮਨ ਮਨ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਛੁਟਕਤ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aunaman man man hee mile chhuTakat bajar kapaaT ||6||
verses.translation: then the soul blends with the Supreme Soul, and the stubborn doors are opened wide. ||6||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat jugat mat sat karee bhram ba(n)dhan kaaT bikaar ||
verses.translation: Through the way of devotion, the intellect is imbued with Truth; doubts, entanglements and vices are cut away.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਬਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਏਕ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: soiee bas ras man mile gun niragun ek bichaar ||7||
verses.translation: The mind is restrained, and one attains joy, contemplating the One Lord, who is both with and without qualities. ||7||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੀਏ ਟਾਰੀ ਨ ਟਰੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਫਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: anik jatan nigreh ke'ee Taaree na Tarai bhram faas ||
verses.translation: I have tried many methods, but by turning it away, the noose of doubt is not turned away.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: prem bhagat nahee uoopajai taa te ravidhaas udhaas ||8||1||
verses.translation: Love and devotion have not welled up within me, and so Ravi Daas is sad and depressed. ||8||1||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa so dhar ||
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, First Mehla, First House, So Dar ~ That Gate:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: so dhar teraa kehaa so ghar kehaa jit beh sarab sam(h)aale ||
verses.translation: What is that Gate, and what is that Home, in which You sit and take care of all?

verses.original: ਵਾਜੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: vaaje tere naadh anek asa(n)khaa kete tere vaavanahaare ||
verses.translation: Countless musical instruments of so many various kinds vibrate there for You; so many are the musicians there for You.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kete tere raag paree siau kahe'eeh kete tere gaavanahaare ||
verses.translation: There are so many Ragas there for You, along with their accompanying harmonies; so many minstrels sing to You.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavani(h) tudhano paun paanee baisa(n)tar gaavai raajaa dharam dhuaare ||
verses.translation: The winds sing to You, as do water and fire; the Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavani(h) tudhano chit gupat likh jaanan likh likh dharam veechaare ||
verses.translation: Chitar and Gupat, the recording angels of the conscious and the subconscious, sing to You; they know, and they write, and on the basis of what they write, the Lord of Dharma passes judgement.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavani(h) tudhano ieesar brahamaa dhevee sohan tere sadhaa savaare ||
verses.translation: Shiva and Brahma and the Goddess Parvaati, so beautiful and ever adorned by You, sing to You.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavani(h) tudhano i(n)dhr i(n)dhraasan baiThe dhevatiaa dhar naale ||
verses.translation: The Indras, seated upon their celestial thrones, with the deities at Your Gate, sing to You.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਾਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavani(h) tudhano sidh samaadhee a(n)dhar gaavani(h) tudhano saadh beechaare ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing to You, and the Holy Saints, in their contemplative meditation, sing to You.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavani(h) tudhano jatee satee sa(n)tokhee gaavan tudhano veer karaare ||
verses.translation: The celibates, the truthful and the patient beings sing to You, and the mighty warriors sing to You.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜੇ ਰਖੀਸੁਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਬੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan tudhano pa(n)ddit paRe rakheesur jug jug bedhaa naale ||
verses.translation: The scholarly Pandits sing to You, along with the holy Rishis and the readers of the Vedas throughout the ages.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan tudhano mohaneeaa man mohan surag machh piaale ||
verses.translation: The Mohinis, the heavenly beauties who entice the heart in paradise, in this world and in the nether regions, sing to You.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੇਤੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavani(h) tudhano ratan upaae tere jete aThasaTh teerath naale ||
verses.translation: The fourteen priceless jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, sing to You.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavani(h) tudhano jodh mahaabal sooraa gaavani(h) tudhano khaanee chaare ||
verses.translation: The mighty warriors and the divine heroes sing to You, and the four sources of creation sing to You.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavani(h) tudhano kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal brahama(n)ddaa kar kar rakhe tere dhaare ||
verses.translation: The continents, the worlds and the solar systems, created and installed by Your Hand, sing to You.

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿੑ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: seiee tudhano gaavani(h) jo tudh bhaavani(h) rate tere bhagat rasaale ||
verses.translation: They alone sing to You, who are pleasing to Your Will, and who are imbued with the nectar of Your devotional worship.

verses.original: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: hor kete tudhano gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa beechaare ||
verses.translation: So many others sing to You, they do not come into my mind; how can Nanak think of them?

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: soiee soiee sadhaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naiee ||
verses.translation: That Lord and Master - He is True, forever True; He is True, and True is His Name.

verses.original: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hai bhee hosee jai na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaiee ||
verses.translation: He who created the creation is True, and He shall always be True; He shall not depart, even when the creation departs.

verses.original: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)gee ra(n)gee bhaatee jinasee maiaa jin upaiee ||
verses.translation: He created the world of Maya with its various colors and species.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar dhekhai keetaa apanaa jiau tis dhee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Having created the creation, He Himself watches over it, as it pleases His Greatness.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai soiee karasee fir hukam na karanaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases Him, that is what He does. No one can issue any commands to Him.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥੧॥
verses.translit: so paatisaahu saahaa pat saahib naanak rahan rajaiee ||1||1||
verses.translation: He is the King, the King of Kings, the Emperor of Kings! Nanak lives in surrender to His Will. ||1||1||
Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: so purakh nira(n)jan har purakh nira(n)jan har agamaa agam apaaraa ||
verses.translation: That Lord is Immaculate; the Lord God is Immaculate. The Lord is Unapproachable, Unfathomable and Incomparable.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh dhiaaveh sabh dhiaaveh tudh jee har sache sirajanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: All meditate, all meditate on You, O Dear Lord, O True Creator.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jeea tumaare jee too(n) jeeaa kaa dhaataaraa ||
verses.translation: All beings are Yours; You are the Giver of all beings.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har dhiaavahu sa(n)tahu jee sabh dhookh visaaranahaaraa ||
verses.translation: So meditate on the Lord, O Saints; He is the One who takes away all pain.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੀ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har aape Thaakur har aape sevak jee kiaa naanak ja(n)t vichaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is the Master, and He Himself is His own servant. O Nanak, how insignificant are mortal beings! ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) ghaT ghaT a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar jee har eko purakh samaanaa ||
verses.translation: You are totally pervading within each and every heart; O Lord, You are the One Primal Being, All-permeating.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhaate ik bhekhaaree jee sabh tere choj viddaanaa ||
verses.translation: Some are givers, and some are beggars; all of this is Your wondrous play!

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਜੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape dhaataa aape bhugataa jee hau tudh bin avar na jaanaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. I know of no other than You.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) paarabraham bea(n)t bea(n)t jee tere kiaa gun aakh vakhaanaa ||
verses.translation: You are the Supreme Lord God, Infinite and Eternal; what Glorious Praises of Yours should I speak and chant?

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo seveh jo seveh tudh jee jan naanak tin(h) kurabaanaa ||2||
verses.translation: Unto those who serve, unto those who serve You, slave Nanak is a sacrifice. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: har dhiaaveh har dhiaaveh tudh jee se jan jug meh sukh vaasee ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord, those who meditate on You, O Dear Lord, those humble beings dwell in peace in this world.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਟੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: se mukat se mukat bhe jin(h) har dhiaaiaa jeeau tin TooTee jam kee faasee ||
verses.translation: They are liberated, they are liberated, who meditate on the Lord; the noose of Death is cut away from them.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin nirabhau jin(h) har nirabhau dhiaaiaa jeeau tin kaa bhau sabh gavaasee ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Fearless One, on the Fearless Lord, all their fears are dispelled.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਸਮਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) seviaa jin(h) seviaa meraa har jeeau te har har roop samaasee ||
verses.translation: Those who have served, those who have served my Dear Lord, are absorbed into the Being of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: se dha(n)n se dha(n)n jin har dhiaaiaa jeeau jan naanak tin bal jaasee ||3||
verses.translation: Blessed are they, blessed are they, who have meditated on the Dear Lord; slave Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਜੀ ਭਰੇ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: teree bhagat teree bhagat bha(n)ddaar jee bhare bea(n)t bea(n)taa ||
verses.translation: Devotion to You, devotion to You, is a treasure, overflowing, infinite and endless.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tere bhagat tere bhagat salaahan tudh jee har anik anek ana(n)taa ||
verses.translation: Your devotees, Your devotees praise You, O Dear Lord, in many and various ways.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਹਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: teree anik teree anik kareh har poojaa jee tap taapeh japeh bea(n)taa ||
verses.translation: For You, so many, for You, so very many, O Dear Lord, perform worship and adoration; they practice penance and endlessly chant in meditation.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਪੜਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tere anek tere anek paReh bahu si(n)mirat saasat jee kar kiriaa khaT karam kara(n)taa ||
verses.translation: For You, many - for You, so very many read the various Simritees and Shaastras; they perform religious rituals and the six ceremonies.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਭਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: se bhagat se bhagat bhale jan naanak jee jo bhaaveh mere har bhagava(n)taa ||4||
verses.translation: Those devotees, those devotees are good, O servant Nanak, who are pleasing to my Lord God. ||4||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aadh purakh apara(n)par karataa jee tudh jevadd avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: You are the Primal Being, the Unrivalled Creator Lord; there is no other as Great as You.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) jug jug eko sadhaa sadhaa too(n) eko jee too(n) nihachal karataa soiee ||
verses.translation: You are the One, age after age; forever and ever, You are One and the same. You are the Eternal, Unchanging Creator.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape bhaavai soiee varatai jee too(n) aape kareh su hoiee ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. Whatever You Yourself do, happens.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape sirasaT sabh upaiee jee tudh aape siraj sabh goiee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself created the entire Universe, and having done so, You Yourself shall destroy it all.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੋਈ ॥੫॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak gun gaavai karate ke jee jo sabhasai kaa jaanoiee ||5||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Creator, the Knower of all. ||5||2||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa pehilaa chaupadhe ghar doojaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, First Mehla, Chaupadhay, Second House:
Hearing, everyone calls You Great,
but only one who has seen You, knows just how Great You are.
No one can measure Your Worth, or describe You.
Those who describe You, remain absorbed in You. ||1||

verses.original: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: vadde mere saahibaa gahir ga(n)bheeraa gunee gaheeraa ||
verses.translation: O my Great Lord and Master of Unfathomable Depth, You are the Ocean of Excellence.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਤਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਚੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koiee na jaanai teraa ketaa kevadd cheeraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: No one knows the greatness of Your expanse. ||1||Pause||
All the contemplators met together and practiced contemplation;
all the appraisers met together and tried to appraise You.
The theologians, the meditators and the teachers of teachers

verses.original: ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahan na jaiee teree til vaddiaaiee ||2||
verses.translation: could not express even an iota of Your Greatness. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sat sabh tap sabh cha(n)giaaieeaa ||
verses.translation: All Truth, all austerities, all goodness,
and the greatness of the Siddhas, the beings of perfect spiritual powers

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਿਧੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh vin sidhee kinai na paieeaa ||
verses.translation: without You, none has attained such spiritual powers.
They are obtained by Your Grace; their flow cannot be blocked. ||3||
What can the helpless speaker do?
Your bounties are overflowing with Your Praises.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis too(n) dheh tisai kiaa chaaraa ||
verses.translation: And the one, unto whom You give - why should he think of any other?
O Nanak, the True Lord is the Embellisher. ||4||1||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
Chanting the Name, I live; forgetting it, I die.
It is so difficult to chant the True Name.
If someone feels hunger for the True Name,
then that hunger shall consume his pains. ||1||
So how could I ever forget Him, O my Mother?
True is the Master, and True is His Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥ ਆਖਿ ਥਕੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saache naam kee til vaddiaaiee || aakh thake keemat nahee paiee ||
verses.translation: People have grown weary of trying to appraise the greatness of the True Name, but they have not been able to appraise even an iota of it.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਆਖਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: je sabh mil kai aakhan paeh ||
verses.translation: Even if they were all to meet together and recount them,

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vaddaa na hovai ghaaT na jai ||2||
verses.translation: You would not be made any greater or lesser. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: naa oh marai na hovai sog ||
verses.translation: He does not die - there is no reason to mourn.
He continues to give, but His Provisions are never exhausted.
This Glorious Virtue is His alone - no one else is like Him;

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naa ko hoaa naa ko hoi ||3||
verses.translation: there has never been anyone like Him, and there never shall be. ||3||
As Great as You Yourself are, so Great are Your Gifts.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਕੀਤੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin dhin kar kai keetee raat ||
verses.translation: It is You who created day and night as well.
Those who forget their Lord and Master are vile and despicable.
O Nanak, without the Name, people are wretched outcasts. ||4||2||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੇ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਂਗਤੁ ਕੂਕ ਕਰੇ ਮਹਲੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: je dhar maa(n)gat kook kare mahalee khasam sune ||
verses.translation: If a beggar cries out at the door, the Master hears it in His Mansion.

verses.original: ਭਾਵੈ ਧੀਰਕ ਭਾਵੈ ਧਕੇ ਏਕ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhaavai dheerak bhaavai dhake ek vaddaiee dhei ||1||
verses.translation: Whether He receives him or pushes him away, it is the Gift of the Lord's Greatness. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਨ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਤੀ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaanahu jot na poochhahu jaatee aagai jaat na he ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Recognize the Lord's Light within all, and do not consider social class or status; there are no classes or castes in the world hereafter. ||1||Pause||
He Himself acts, and He Himself inspires us to act.
He Himself considers our complaints.
Since You, O Creator Lord, are the Doer,
why should I submit to the world? ||2||
You Yourself created and You Yourself give.
You Yourself eliminate evil-mindedness;
by Guru's Grace, You come to abide in our minds,
and then, pain and darkness are dispelled from within. ||3||
He Himself infuses love for the Truth.
Unto others, the Truth is not bestowed.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਗੈ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਲੇਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: je kisai dhei vakhaanai naanak aagai poochh na lei ||4||3||
verses.translation: If He bestows it upon someone, says Nanak, then, in the world hereafter, that person is not called to account. ||4||3||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
The urges of the heart are like cymbals and ankle-bells;
the drum of the world resounds with the beat.
Naarad dances to the tune of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga;
where can the celibates and the men of truth place their feet? ||1||
Nanak is a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
The world is blind; our Lord and Master is All-seeing. ||1||Pause||
The disciple feeds on the Guru;
out of love for bread, he comes to dwell in his home.
If one were to live and eat for hundreds of years,
that day alone would be auspicious, when he recognizes his Lord and Master. ||2||
Beholding the sight of the petitioner, compassion is not aroused.

verses.original: ਲਏ ਦਿਤੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: le dhite vin rahai na koi ||
verses.translation: No one lives without give and take.
The king administers justice only if his palm is greased.
No one is moved by the Name of God. ||3||
O Nanak, they are human beings in form and name only;
by their deeds they are dogs - this is the Command of the Lord's Court.
By Guru's Grace, if one sees himself as a guest in this world,
then he gains honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||4||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੇਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਤੇਤੀ ਜੇਤਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jetaa sabadh surat dhun tetee jetaa roop kaiaa teree ||
verses.translation: As much as the Shabad is in the mind, so much is Your melody; as much as the form of the universe is, so much is Your body, Lord.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਸਨਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹਉ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape rasanaa aape basanaa avar na dhoojaa kahau maiee ||1||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the tongue, and You Yourself are the nose. Do not speak of any other, O my mother. ||1||
My Lord and Master is One;

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eko hai bhaiee eko hai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is the One and Only; O Siblings of Destiny, He is the One alone. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਛੋਡੈ ਆਪੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape maare aape chhoddai aape levai dhei ||
verses.translation: He Himself kills, and He Himself emancipates; He Himself gives and takes.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape vekhai aape vigasai aape nadhar karei ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself beholds, and He Himself rejoices; He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa avar na karanaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: Whatever He is to do, that is what He is doing. No one else can do anything.

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaisaa varatai taiso kaheeaai sabh teree vaddiaaiee ||3||
verses.translation: As He projects Himself, so do we describe Him; this is all Your Glorious Greatness, Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਲਾ ਪੀਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: kal kalavaalee maiaa madh meeThaa man matavaalaa peevat rahai ||
verses.translation: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the bottle of wine; Maya is the sweet wine, and the intoxicated mind continues to drink it in.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਰੂਪ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਂਤੀਂ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਏਵ ਕਹੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: aape roop kare bahu bhaa(n)tee(n) naanak bapuRaa ev kahai ||4||5||
verses.translation: He Himself assumes all sorts of forms; thus poor Nanak speaks. ||4||5||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
Make your intellect your instrument, and love your tambourine;
thus bliss and lasting pleasure shall be produced in your mind.
This is devotional worship, and this is the practice of penance.

verses.original: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eit ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh paau ||1||
verses.translation: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||1||
Know that the perfect beat is the Praise of the Lord;

verses.original: ਹੋਰੁ ਨਚਣਾ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hor nachanaa khuseeaa man maeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: other dances produce only temporary pleasure in the mind. ||1||Pause||
Play the two cymbals of truth and contentment.
Let your ankle bells be the lasting Vision of the Lord.
Let your harmony and music be the elimination of duality.

verses.original: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eit ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh paau ||2||
verses.translation: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||2||
Let the fear of God within your heart and mind be your spinning dance,
and keep up, whether sitting or standing.
To roll around in the dust is to know that the body is only ashes.

verses.original: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eit ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh paau ||3||
verses.translation: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||3||
Keep the company of the disciples, the students who love the teachings.
As Gurmukh, listen to the True Name.
O Nanak, chant it, over and over again.

verses.original: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪੈਰ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: eit ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh pair ||4||6||
verses.translation: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||4||6||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਉਣੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੀ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਜਲ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: paun upai dharee sabh dharatee jal aganee kaa ba(n)dh keeaa ||
verses.translation: He created the air, and He supports the whole world; he bound water and fire together.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਦਹਸਿਰਿ ਮੂੰਡੁ ਕਟਾਇਆ ਰਾਵਣੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhulai dhahasir moo(n)dd kaTaiaa raavan maar kiaa vaddaa bhiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The blind, ten-headed Raavan had his heads cut off, but what greatness was obtained by killing him? ||1||
What Glories of Yours can be chanted?

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) sarabe poor rahiaa liv lai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are totally pervading everywhere; You love and cherish all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹਥਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਕਾਲੀ ਨਥਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeea upai jugat hath keenee kaalee nath kiaa vaddaa bhiaa ||
verses.translation: You created all beings, and You hold the world in Your Hands; what greatness is it to put a ring in the nose of the black cobra, as Krishna did?

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜੋਰੂ ਕਉਣ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kis too(n) purakh joroo kaun kaheeaai sarab nira(n)tar rav rahiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Whose Husband are You? Who is Your wife? You are subtly diffused and pervading in all. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਲਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਵਰਦਾਤਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਭਾਲਣ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naal kuTa(n)b saath varadhaataa brahamaa bhaalan sirasaT giaa ||
verses.translation: Brahma, the bestower of blessings, entered the stem of the lotus, with his relatives, to find the extent of the universe.

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕੰਸੁ ਛੇਦਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aagai a(n)t na paio taa kaa ka(n)s chhedh kiaa vaddaa bhiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Proceeding on, he could not find its limits; what glory was obtained by killing Kansa, the king? ||3||

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੇ ਖੀਰੁ ਮਥਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ਭਖਲਾਏ ਜਿ ਅਸੀ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: ratan upai dhare kheer mathiaa hor bhakhalaae j asee keeaa ||
verses.translation: The jewels were produced and brought forth by churning the ocean of milk. The other gods proclaimed ""We are the ones who did this!""

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਛਪੈ ਕਿਉ ਛਪਿਆ ਏਕੀ ਏਕੀ ਵੰਡਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak chhapai kiau chhapiaa ekee ekee va(n)dd dheeaa ||4||7||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, by hiding, how can the Lord be hidden? He has given each their share, one by one. ||4||7||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਬੇਲਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: karam karatoot bel bisathaaree raam naam fal hooaa ||
verses.translation: The vine of good actions and character has spread out, and it bears the fruit of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਕੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis roop na rekh anaahadh vaajai sabadh nira(n)jan keeaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Name has no form or outline; it vibrates with the unstruck Sound Current; through the Word of the Shabad, the Immaculate Lord is revealed. ||1||
One can speak on this only when he knows it.
He alone drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਪੀਆ ਸੇ ਮਸਤ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਤੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਫਾਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) peeaa se masat bhe hai tooTe ba(n)dhan faahe ||
verses.translation: Those who drink it in are enraptured; their bonds and shackles are cut away.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਛੋਡੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਲਾਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jotee jot samaanee bheetar taa chhodde maiaa ke laahe ||2||
verses.translation: When one's light blends into the Divine Light, then the desire for Maya is ended. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sarab jot roop teraa dhekhiaa sagal bhavan teree maiaa ||
verses.translation: Among all lights, I behold Your Form; all the worlds are Your Maya.

verses.original: ਰਾਰੈ ਰੂਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raarai roop niraalam baiThaa nadhar kare vich chhaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Among the tumults and forms, He sits in serene detachment; He bestows His Glance of Grace upon those who are engrossed in the illusion. ||3||

verses.original: ਬੀਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: beenaa sabadh vajaavai jogee dharasan roop apaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Yogi who plays on the instrument of the Shabad gains the Blessed Vision of the Infinitely Beautiful Lord.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: sabadh anaahadh so sahu raataa naanak kahai vichaaraa ||4||8||
verses.translation: He, the Lord, is immersed in the Unstruck Shabad of the Word, says Nanak, the humble and meek. ||4||8||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਾ ਕੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: mai gun galaa ke sir bhaar ||
verses.translation: My virtue is that I carry the load of my words upon my head.
The real words are the Words of the Creator Lord.
How useless are eating, drinking and laughing,

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਯਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jab lag ridhai na aaveh yaadh ||1||
verses.translation: if the Lord is not cherished in the heart! ||1||
Why should someone care for anything else,

verses.original: ਜਨਮਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੀਜੀ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam kichh leejee leejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: if throughout his life, he gathers in that which is truly worth gathering? ||1||Pause||
The intellect of the mind is like a drunken elephant.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਖਤੋ ਖਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh boleeaai sabh khato khataa ||
verses.translation: Whatever one utters is totally false, the most false of the false.
So what face should we put on to offer our prayer,
when both virtue and vice are close at hand as witnesses? ||2||

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
