verses.translit: jaisaa too(n) kareh taisaa ko hoi ||
verses.translation: As You make us, so we become.
Without You, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਜੇਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੇਹੀ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jehee too(n) mat dheh tehee ko paavai ||
verses.translation: As is the understanding which You bestow, so do we receive.
As it pleases Your Will, so do You lead us. ||3||
The divine crystalline harmonies, their consorts, and their celestial families
from them, the essence of Ambrosial Nectar is produced.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak karate kaa ih dhan maal ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this is the wealth and property of the Creator Lord.
If only this essential reality were understood! ||4||9||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa apanai ghar aaiaa taa mil sakheeaa kaaj rachaiaa ||
verses.translation: When by His Grace He came to my home, then my companions met together to celebrate my marriage.

verses.original: ਖੇਲੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਹੁ ਵੀਆਹਣ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khel dhekh man anadh bhiaa sahu veeaahan aaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Beholding this play, my mind became blissful; my Husband Lord has come to marry me. ||1||
So sing - yes, sing the songs of wisdom and reflection, O brides.

verses.original: ਹਮਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hamarai ghar aaiaa jagajeevan bhataar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My spouse, the Life of the world, has come into my home. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹਮਰਾ ਵੀਆਹੁ ਜਿ ਹੋਆ ਜਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: guroo dhuaarai hamaraa veeaahu j hoaa jaa(n) sahu miliaa taa(n) jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: When I was married within the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, I met my Husband Lord, and I came to know Him.

verses.original: ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਹੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tih lokaa meh sabadh raviaa hai aap giaa man maaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Word of His Shabad is pervading the three worlds; when my ego was quieted, my mind became happy. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਹੋਰਨਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa kaaraj aap savaare horan kaaraj na hoiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself arranges His own affairs; His affairs cannot be arranged by anyone else.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jit kaaraj sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam hai gurmukh boojhai koiee ||3||
verses.translation: By the affair of this marriage, truth, contentment, mercy and faith are produced; but how rare is that Gurmukh who understands it! ||3||

verses.original: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhanat naanak sabhanaa kaa pir eko soi ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, that Lord alone is the Husband of all.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: jis no nadhar kare saa sohaagan hoi ||4||10||
verses.translation: She, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, becomes the happy soul-bride. ||4||10||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
Home and forest are the same, for one who dwells in the balance of intuitive peace and poise.
His evil-mindedness departs, and the Praises of God take its place.
To chant the True Name with one's mouth is the true ladder.
Serving the True Guru, one finds one's own place within the self. ||1||
To conquer the mind is the knowledge of the six Shaastras.
The Divine Light of the Lord God is perfectly pervading. ||1||Pause||
Excessive thirst for Maya makes people wear all sorts of religious robes.
The pain of corruption destroys the body's peace.
Sexual desire and anger steal the wealth of the self within.
But by abandoning duality, one is emancipated through the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
In the Lord's Praise and adoration is intuitive peace, poise and bliss.
The Love of the Lord God is one's family and friends.
He Himself is the Doer, and He Himself is the Forgiver.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tan man har peh aagai ji(n)dh ||3||
verses.translation: My body and mind belong to the Lord; my life is at His Command. ||3||
Falsehood and corruption cause terrible suffering.
All the religious robes and social classes look just like dust.
Whoever is born, continues to come and go.
O Nanak, only the Naam and the Lord's Command are eternal and everlasting. ||4||11||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
In the pool is the one incomparably beautiful lotus.
It blossoms continually; its form is pure and fragrant.
The swans pick up the bright jewels.
They take on the essence of the All-powerful Lord of the Universe. ||1||
Whoever is seen, is subject to birth and death.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin jal saravar kamal na dheesai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the pool without water, the lotus is not seen. ||1||Pause||
How rare are those who know and understand this secret.
The Vedas continually speak of the three branches.
One who merges into the knowledge of the Lord as absolute and related,
serves the True Guru and obtains the supreme status. ||2||
One who is imbued with the Love of the Lord and dwells continually upon Him is liberated.
He is the king of kings, and blossoms forth continually.
That one whom You preserve, by bestowing Your Mercy, O Lord,
even the sinking stone - You float that one across. ||3||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tirabhavan meh jot tirabhavan meh jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Your Light is pervading the three worlds; I know that You are permeating the three worlds.

verses.original: ਉਲਟ ਭਈ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aulaT bhiee ghar ghar meh aaniaa ||
verses.translation: When my mind turned away from Maya, I came to dwell in my own home.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: ahinis bhagat kare liv lai || naanak tin kai laagai pai ||4||12||
verses.translation: Nanak falls at the feet of that person who immerses himself in the Lord's Love, and performs devotional worship night and day. ||4||12||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
Receiving the True Teachings from the Guru, arguments depart.
But through excessive cleverness, one is only plastered with dirt.
The filth of attachment is removed by the True Name of the Lord.
By Guru's Grace, one remains lovingly attached to the Lord. ||1||
He is the Presence Ever-present; offer your prayers to Him.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh saach karate prabh paas ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Pain and pleasure are in the Hands of God, the True Creator. ||1||Pause||
One who practices falsehood comes and goes.
By speaking and talking, His limits cannot be found.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa dhekhaa soojh boojh na paavai ||
verses.translation: Whatever one sees, is not understood.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin naavai man tirapat na aavai ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Name, satisfaction does not enter into the mind. ||2||
Whoever is born is afflicted by disease,
tortured by the pain of egotism and Maya.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਬਾਚੇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: se jan baache jo prabh raakhe ||
verses.translation: They alone are saved, who are protected by God.
Serving the True Guru, they drink in the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||
The unstable mind is restrained by tasting this Nectar.
Serving the True Guru, one comes to cherish the Ambrosial Nectar of the Shabad.
Through the True Word of the Shabad, the state of liberation is obtained.
O Nanak, self-conceit is eradicated from within. ||4||13||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo tin keeaa so sach theeaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever He has done, has proved to be true.
The True Guru bestows the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.
With the Naam in the heart, the mind is not separated from the Lord.
Night and day, one dwells with the Beloved. ||1||
O Lord, please keep me in the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee har ras paiaa naam padhaarath nau nidh paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the sublime essence of the Lord; I have received the wealth of the Naam and the nine treasures. ||1||Pause||
Those whose karma and Dharma - whose actions and faith - are in the True Name of the True Lord
I am forever a sacrifice to them.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo har raate se jan paravaan ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Lord are accepted and respected.
In their company, the supreme wealth is obtained. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har var jin paiaa dhan naaree ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that bride, who has obtained the Lord as her Husband.
She is imbued with the Lord, and she reflects upon the Word of His Shabad.
She saves herself, and saves her family and friends as well.
She serves the True Guru, and contemplates the essence of reality. ||3||
The True Name is my social status and honor.
The love of the Truth is my karma and Dharma - my faith and my actions, and my self-control.
O Nanak, one who is forgiven by the Lord is not called to account.
The One Lord erases duality. ||4||14||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
Some come, and after they come, they go.
Some are imbued with the Lord; they remain absorbed in Him.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਧਰਨਿ ਗਗਨ ਮਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik dharan gagan meh Thaur na paaveh ||
verses.translation: Some find no place of rest at all, on the earth or in the sky.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: se karamaheen har naam na dhiaaveh ||1||
verses.translation: Those who do not meditate on the Name of the Lord are the most unfortunate. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore te gat mit paiee ||
verses.translation: From the Perfect Guru, the way to salvation is obtained.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਵਤ ਅਤਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eih sa(n)saar bikh vat at bhaujal gur sabadhee har paar la(n)ghaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This world is a terrifying ocean of poison; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord helps us cross over. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) kau aap le prabh mel ||
verses.translation: Those, whom God unites with Himself,

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਪੇਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: tin kau kaal na saakai pel ||
verses.translation: cannot be crushed by death.
The beloved Gurmukhs remain immaculately pure,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਮਲ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau jal a(n)bh uoopar kamal niraare ||2||
verses.translation: like the lotus in the water, which remains untouched. ||2||

verses.original: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: buraa bhalaa kahu kis no kaheeaai ||
verses.translation: Tell me: who should we call good or bad?
Behold the Lord God; the truth is revealed to the Gurmukh.
I speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord, contemplating the Guru's Teachings.
I join the Sangat, the Guru's Congregation, and I find God's limits. ||3||
The Shaastras, the Vedas, the Simritees and all their many secrets;
bathing at the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage - all this is found by enshrining the sublime essence of the Lord in the heart.
The Gurmukhs are immaculately pure; no filth sticks to them.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak hiradhai naam vadde dhur bhaagai ||4||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides in the heart, by the greatest pre-ordained destiny. ||4||15||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: niv niv pai lagau gur apune aatam raam nihaariaa ||
verses.translation: Bowing down, again and again, I fall at the Feet of my Guru; through Him, I have seen the Lord, the Divine Self, within.

verses.original: ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: karat beechaar hiradhai har raviaa hiradhai dhekh beechaariaa ||1||
verses.translation: Through contemplation and meditation, the Lord dwells within the heart; see this, and understand. ||1||
So speak the Lord's Name, which shall emancipate you.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੈ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh ratan har laabhai miTai agiaan hoi ujeeaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the jewel of the Lord is found; ignorance is dispelled, and the Divine Light shines forth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਵਨੀ ਰਵੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਨਹੀ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ravanee ravai ba(n)dhan nahee tooTeh vich haumai bharam na jaiee ||
verses.translation: By merely saying it with the tongue, one's bonds are not broken, and egotism and doubt do not depart from within.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੂਟੈ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta haumai tooTai taa ko lekhai paiee ||2||
verses.translation: But when one meets the True Guru, egotism departs, and then, one realizes his destiny. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam bhagat pria preetam sukh saagar ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet and dear to His devotees; it is the ocean of peace - enshrine it within the heart.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal jagajeevan dhaataa mat gurmat har nisataare ||3||
verses.translation: The Lover of His devotees, the Life of the World, the Lord bestows the Guru's Teachings upon the intellect, and one is emancipated. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੂਝਿ ਮਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: man siau joojh marai prabh paae manasaa maneh samaae ||
verses.translation: One who dies fighting against his own stubborn mind finds God, and the desires of the mind are quieted.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: naanak kirapaa kare jagajeevan sahaj bhai liv laae ||4||16||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if the Life of the World bestows His Mercy, one is intuitively attuned to the Love of the Lord. ||4||16||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ ਸਮਝਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: kis kau kaheh sunaaveh kis kau kis samajhaaveh samajh rahe ||
verses.translation: Unto whom do they speak? Unto whom do they preach? Who understands? Let them understand themselves.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੈ ਪੜਾਵਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਗੁਣਿ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kisai paRaaveh paR gun boojhe satigur sabadh sa(n)tokh rahe ||1||
verses.translation: Who do they teach? Through study, they come to realize the Lord's Glorious Virtues. Through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, they come to dwell in contentment. ||1||
Through the Guru's Teachings, realize that He is pervading in all bodies;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bhaj mere man gahir ga(n)bheeraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O my soul, vibrate on the Profound, Unfathomable Lord. ||1||Pause||
Loving devotion to the Lord brings endless waves of joy and delight.
One who dwells with the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day, is sanctified.
The birth into the world of the faithless cynic is totally useless.
The humble devotee of the Lord remains unattached. ||2||
The body which sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord is sanctified.
The soul remains conscious of the Lord, absorbed in His Love.
The Lord is the Infinite Primal Being, beyond the beyond, the priceless jewel.
My mind is totally content, imbued with my Beloved. ||3||
Those who speak and babble on and on, are truly dead.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੂੰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: so prabh dhoor naahee prabh too(n) hai ||
verses.translation: God is not far away - O God, You are right here.
I have seen that the whole world is engrossed in Maya.
O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||17||
Aasaa, First Mehla, Thi-Thukay:
One is a beggar, living on charity;
another is a king, absorbed in himself.
One receives honor, and another dishonor.
The Lord destroys and creates; He is enshrined in His meditation.
There is no other as great as You.
So whom should I present to You? Who is good enough? ||1||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my only Support.
You are the Great Giver, the Doer, the Creator. ||1||Pause||
I have not walked on Your Path; I have followed the crooked path.
In the Court of the Lord, I find no place to sit.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: man kaa a(n)dhulaa maiaa kaa ba(n)dh ||
verses.translation: I am mentally blind, in the bondage of Maya.
The wall of my body is breaking down, wearing away, growing weaker.
You have such high hopes of eating and living
- your breaths and morsels of food are already counted! ||2||
Night and day they are blind - please, bless them with Your Light.
They are drowning in the terrifying world-ocean, crying out in pain.

verses.original: ਕਹਹਿ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਜੋ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਨਾਉ ॥ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaheh suneh jo maaneh naau || hau balihaarai taa kai jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who chant, hear and believe in the Name.
Nanak utters this one prayer;
soul and body, all belong to You, Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਪੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) too(n) dheh japee teraa naau ||
verses.translation: When You bless me, I chant Your Name.
Thus I find my seat in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) tudh bhaavai taa dhuramat jai ||
verses.translation: When it pleases You, evil-mindedness departs,
and the jewel of spiritual wisdom comes to dwell in the mind.
When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then one comes to meet the True Guru.
Prays Nanak, carry us across the terrifying world-ocean. ||4||18||
Aasaa, First Mehla, Panch-Padhay:

verses.original: ਦੁਧ ਬਿਨੁ ਧੇਨੁ ਪੰਖ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਕਾਮਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhudh bin dhen pa(n)kh bin pa(n)khee jal bin utabhuj kaam naahee ||
verses.translation: A cow without milk; a bird without wings; a garden without water - all are totally useless.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਸਲਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਅੰਧੀ ਕੋਠੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kiaa sulataan salaam vihoonaa a(n)dhee koThee teraa naam naahee ||1||
verses.translation: What is an emperor, without respect? The chamber of the soul is so dark, without the Name of the Lord. ||1||
How could I ever forget You? It would be so painful!

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh laagai too(n) visar naahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I would suffer such pain - please do not let me forget you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਖੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਜੀਭ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੰਨੀ ਪਵਣੁ ਨ ਵਾਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: akhee a(n)dh jeebh ras naahee ka(n)nee pavan na vaajai ||
verses.translation: The eyes grow blind, the tongue does not taste, and the ears do not hear any sound.

verses.original: ਚਰਣੀ ਚਲੈ ਪਜੂਤਾ ਆਗੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: charanee chalai pajootaa aagai vin sevaa fal laage ||2||
verses.translation: He walks on his feet only when supported by someone else; without serving the Lord, such are the fruits of life. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਖਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਾਗ ਭੁਇ ਚੋਖੀ ਸਿੰਚਿਤ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: akhar birakh baag bhui chokhee si(n)chit bhaau karehee ||
verses.translation: The Word is the tree; the garden of the heart is the farm; tend it, and irrigate it with the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa fal laagai naam eko bin karamaa kaise lehee ||3||
verses.translation: All these trees bear the fruit of the Name of the One Lord; but without the karma of good actions, how can anyone obtain it? ||3||

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਫਲੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jete jeea tete sabh tere vin sevaa fal kisai naahee ||
verses.translation: As many living beings are there are, they are all Yours. Without selfless service, no one obtains any reward.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਰਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh bhaanaa teraa hovai vin naavai jeeau rahai naahee ||4||
verses.translation: Pain and pleasure come by Your Will; without the Name, the soul does not even exist. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਜਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਤਾਂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: mat vich maran jeevan hor kaisaa jaa jeevaa taa(n) jugat naahee ||
verses.translation: To die in the Teachings is to live. Otherwise, what is life? That is not the way.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਜੀਆ ਜਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੫॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak jeevaale jeeaa jeh bhaavai teh raakh tuhee ||5||19||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, He grants life to the living beings; O Lord, please keep me according to Your Will. ||5||19||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
Let the body be the Brahmin, and let the mind be the loin-cloth;
let spiritual wisdom be the sacred thread, and meditation the ceremonial ring.
I seek the Name of the Lord and His Praise as my cleansing bath.
By Guru's Grace, I am absorbed into God. ||1||
O Pandit, O religious scholar, contemplate God in such a way

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਚਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਪੜਉ ਨਾਮੇ ਚਜੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naame such naamo paRau naame chaj aachaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: that His Name may sanctify you, that His Name may be your study, and His Name your wisdom and way of life. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਨੇਊ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: baahar janeuoo jichar jot hai naal ||
verses.translation: The outer sacred thread is worthwhile only as long as the Divine Light is within.
So make the remembrance of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, your loin-cloth and the ceremonial mark on your forehead.
Here and hereafter, the Name alone shall stand by you.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vin naavai hor karam na bhaal ||2||
verses.translation: Do not seek any other actions, except the Name. ||2||
Worship the Lord in loving adoration, and burn your desire for Maya.
Behold only the One Lord, and do not seek out any other.
Become aware of reality, in the Sky of the Tenth Gate;
read aloud the Lord's Word, and contemplate it. ||3||
With the diet of His Love, doubt and fear depart.
With the Lord as your night watchman, no thief will dare to break in.
Let the knowledge of the One God be the ceremonial mark on your forehead.
Let the realization that God is within you be your discrimination. ||4||
Through ritual actions, God cannot be won over;
by reciting sacred scriptures, His value cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਅਸਟ ਦਸੀ ਚਹੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: asaT dhasee chahu bhedh na paiaa ||
verses.translation: The eighteen Puraanas and the four Vedas do not know His mystery.
O Nanak, the True Guru has shown me the Lord God. ||5||20||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
He alone is the selfless servant, slave and humble devotee,
who as Gurmukh, becomes the slave of his Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin sir saajee tin fun goiee ||
verses.translation: He, who created the Universe, shall ultimately destroy it.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis bin dhoojaa avar na koiee ||1||
verses.translation: Without Him, there is no other at all. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saach naam gur sabadh veechaar || gurmukh saache saachai dharabaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Gurmukh reflects upon the True Name; in the True Court, he is found to be true. ||1||Pause||
The true supplication, the true prayer
- within the Mansion of His Sublime Presence, the True Lord Master hears and applauds these.
He summons the truthful to His Heavenly Throne
and bestows glorious greatness upon them; that which He wills, comes to pass. ||2||
The Power is Yours; You are my only Support.
The Word of the Guru's Shabad is my true password.
One who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, goes to Him openly.
With the password of truth, his way is not blocked. ||3||
The Pandit reads and expounds on the Vedas,
but he does not know the secret of the thing within himself.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur bin sojhee boojh na hoi ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, understanding and realization are not obtained;
but still God is True, pervading everywhere. ||4||
What should I say, or speak or describe?
Only You Yourself know, O Lord of total wonder.
Nanak takes the Support of the Door of the One God.
There, at the True Door, the Gurmukhs sustain themselves. ||5||21||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਚੀ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaachee gaagar dheh dhuhelee upajai binasai dhukh paiee ||
verses.translation: The clay pitcher of the body is miserable; it suffers in pain through birth and death.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eih jag saagar dhutar kiau tareeaai bin har gur paar na paiee ||1||
verses.translation: How can this terrifying world-ocean be crossed over? Without the Lord - Guru, it cannot be crossed. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tujh bin avar na koiee mere piaare tujh bin avar na koi hare ||
verses.translation: Without You, there is no other at all, O my Beloved; without you, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਸਰਬੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਰੂਪੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarabee ra(n)gee roopee too(n)hai tis bakhase jis nadhar kare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are in all colors and forms; he alone is forgiven, upon whom You bestow Your Glance of Grace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਸੁ ਬੁਰੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਿਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਣ ਨ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: saas buree ghar vaas na dhevai pir siau milan na dhei buree ||
verses.translation: Maya, my mother-in-law, is evil; she does not let me live in my own home. The vicious one does not let me meet with my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਸਾਜਨੀ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਚਰਨ ਸਰੇਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sakhee saajanee ke hau charan sarevau har gur kirapaa te nadhar dharee ||2||
verses.translation: I serve at the feet of my companions and friends; the Lord has showered me with His Mercy, through Guru's Grace. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤੁਮ ਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਅਵਰੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aap beechaar maar man dhekhiaa tum saa meet na avar koiee ||
verses.translation: Reflecting upon my self, and conquering my mind, I have seen that there is no other friend like You.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau too(n) raakheh tiv hee rahanaa dhukh sukh dheveh kareh soiee ||3||
verses.translation: As You keep me, so do I live. You are the Giver of peace and pleasure. Whatever You do, comes to pass. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਦੋਊ ਬਿਨਾਸਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਭਈ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa manasaa dhouoo binaasat tirahu gun aas niraas bhiee ||
verses.translation: Hope and desire have both been dispelled; I have renounced my longing for the three qualities.

verses.original: ਤੁਰੀਆਵਸਥਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਲਹੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tureeaavasathaa gurmukh paieeaai sa(n)t sabhaa kee oT lahee ||4||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the state of ecstasy, taking to the Shelter of the Saints' Congregation. ||4||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: giaan dhiaan sagale sabh jap tap jis har hiradhai alakh abhevaa ||
verses.translation: All wisdom and meditation, all chanting and penance, come to one whose heart is filled with the Invisible, Inscrutable Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੫॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naanak raam naam man raataa gurmat paae sahaj sevaa ||5||22||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one whose mind is imbued with the Lord's Name, finds the Guru's Teachings, and intuitively serves. ||5||22||
Aasaa, First Mehla, Panch-Padhay:
Your attachment to your family, your attachment to all your affairs
- renounce all your attachments, for they are all corrupt. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੋਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਬੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: moh ar bharam tajahu tum(h) beer ||
verses.translation: Renounce your attachments and doubts, O brother,

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਰਵੈ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saach naam ridhe ravai sareer ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and dwell upon the True Name within your heart and body. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sach naam jaa nav nidh paiee ||
verses.translation: When one receives the nine treasures of the True Name,
his children do not weep, and his mother does not grieve. ||2||
In this attachment, the world is drowning.
Few are the Gurmukhs who swim across. ||3||
In this attachment, people are reincarnated over and over again.
Attached to emotional attachment, they go to the city of Death. ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੇ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur dheekhiaa le jap tap kamaeh ||
verses.translation: You have received the Guru's Teachings - now practice meditation and penance.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੂਟੈ ਨਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naa moh tooTai naa thai paeh ||5||
verses.translation: If attachment is not broken, no one is approved. ||5||

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare taa eh moh jai ||
verses.translation: But if He bestows His Glance of Grace, then this attachment departs.
O Nanak, then one remains merged in the Lord. ||6||23||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
He Himself does everything, the True, Invisible, Infinite Lord.
I am a sinner, You are the Forgiver. ||1||
By Your Will, everything comes to pass.
One who acts in stubborn-mindedness is ruined in the end. ||1||Pause||
The intellect of the self-willed manmukh is engrossed in falsehood.
Without the meditative remembrance of the Lord, it suffers in sin. ||2||
Renounce evil-mindedness, and you shall reap the rewards.
Whoever is born, comes through the Unknowable and Mysterious Lord. ||3||
Such is my Friend and Companion;
meeting with the Guru, the Lord, devotion was implanted within me. ||4||
In all other transactions, one suffers loss.
The Name of the Lord is pleasing to Nanak's mind. ||5||24||
Aasaa, First Mehla, Chau-Padhay:
Contemplate and reflect upon knowledge, and you will become a benefactor to others.

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਪੰਚ ਰਾਸੀ ਤਾਂ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) pa(n)ch raasee taa(n) teerath vaasee ||1||
verses.translation: When you conquer the five passions, then you shall come to dwell at the sacred shrine of pilgrimage. ||1||
You shall hear the vibrations of the tinkling bells, when your mind is held steady.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਜਮੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੋ ਸਿਉ ਆਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tau jam kahaa kare mo siau aagai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: So what can the Messenger of Death do to me hereafter? ||1||Pause||
When you abandon hope and desire, then you become a true Sannyaasi.

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਜਤੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾਂ ਕਾਇਆ ਭੋਗੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) jat jogee taa(n) kaiaa bhogee ||2||
verses.translation: When the Yogi practices abstinence, then he enjoys his body. ||2||
Through compassion, the naked hermit reflects upon his inner self.
He slays his own self, instead of slaying others. ||3||
You, O Lord, are the One, but You have so many Forms.
Nanak does not know Your wondrous plays. ||4||25||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨ ਭਰੀਆ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਿ ਧੋਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: ek na bhareeaa gun kar dhovaa ||
verses.translation: I am not stained by only one sin, that could be washed clean by virtue.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਵਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: meraa sahu jaagai hau nis bhar sovaa ||1||
verses.translation: My Husband Lord is awake, while I sleep through the entire night of my life. ||1||
In this way, how can I become dear to my Husband Lord?

verses.original: ਸਹੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਉ ਨਿਸ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sahu jaagai hau nis bhar sovaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My Husband Lord remains awake, while I sleep through the entire night of my life. ||1||Pause||
With hope and desire, I approach His Bed,

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਸਹ ਭਾਵਾ ਕਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aagai seh bhaavaa k na bhaavaa ||2||
verses.translation: but I do not know whether He will be pleased with me or not. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa jaanaa kiaa hoigaa ree maiee ||
verses.translation: How do I know what will happen to me, O my mother?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har dharasan bin rahan na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, I cannot survive. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਤਿਸ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: prem na chaakhiaa meree tis na bujhaanee ||
verses.translation: I have not tasted His Love, and my thirst is not quenched.
My beautiful youth has run away, and now I, the soul-bride, repent and regret. ||3||
Even now, I am held by hope and desire.
I am depressed; I have no hope at all. ||1||Pause||
She overcomes her egotism, and adorns herself;
the Husband Lord now ravishes and enjoys the soul-bride on His Bed. ||4||
Then, O Nanak, the bride becomes pleasing to the Mind of her Husband Lord;

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਅਪਣੇ ਖਸਮ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: chhodd vaddaiee apane khasam samaavai ||1|| rahaau ||26||
verses.translation: she sheds her self-conceit, and is absorbed in her Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||26||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
In this world of my father's house, I, the soul-bride, have been very childish;

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis seh kee mai saar na jaanee ||1||
verses.translation: I did not realize the value of my Husband Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sahu meraa ek dhoojaa nahee koiee ||
verses.translation: My Husband is the One; there is no other like Him.
If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then I shall meet Him. ||1||Pause||
In the next world of my in-law's house, I, the the soul-bride, shall realize Truth;
I shall come to know the celestial peace of my Husband Lord. ||2||
By Guru's Grace, such wisdom comes to me,
so that the soul-bride becomes pleasing to the Mind of the Husband Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭੈ ਭਾਵ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kahat naanak bhai bhaav kaa kare seegaar ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, she who adorns herself with the Love and the Fear of God,
enjoys her Husband Lord forever on His Bed. ||4||27||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਪੂਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: n kis kaa poot na kis kee maiee ||
verses.translation: No one is anyone else's son, and no one is anyone else's mother.
Through false attachments, people wander around in doubt. ||1||
O My Lord and Master, I am created by You.

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਪੀ ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) too(n) dheh japee naau teraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If You give it to me, I will chant Your Name. ||1||Pause||
That person who is filled with all sorts of sins may pray at the Lord's Door,
but he is forgiven only when the Lord so wills. ||2||
By Guru's Grace, evil-mindedness is destroyed.
Wherever I look, there I find the One Lord. ||3||
Says Nanak, if one comes to such an understanding,
then he is absorbed into the Truest of the True. ||4||28||
Aasaa, First Mehla, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਰਵਰੜੈ ਭਈਲੇ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: tit saravaraRai bhieele nivaasaa paanee paavak tineh keeaa ||
verses.translation: In that pool of the world, the people have their homes; there, the Lord has created water and fire.

verses.original: ਪੰਕਜੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਲੈ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਡੂਬੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pa(n)kaj moh pag nahee chaalai ham dhekhaa teh ddoobeeale ||1||
verses.translation: In the mud of earthly attachment, their feet have become mired, and I have seen them drowning there. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: man ek na chetas mooR manaa ||
verses.translation: O foolish people, why don't you remember the One Lord?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bisarat tere gun galiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Lord, your virtues shall wither away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naa hau jatee satee nahee paRiaa moorakh mugadhaa janam bhiaa ||
verses.translation: I am not a celibate, nor am I truthful, nor a scholar; I was born foolish and ignorant.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਤੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak tin(h) kee saranaa jin(h) too(n) naahee veesariaa ||2||29||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who do not forget You, Lord. ||2||29||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਛਿਅ ਘਰ ਛਿਅ ਗੁਰ ਛਿਅ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: chhia ghar chhia gur chhia upadhes ||
verses.translation: There are six systems of philosophy, six teachers, and six doctrines;
but the Teacher of teachers is the One Lord, who appears in so many forms. ||1||
That system, where the Praises of the Creator are sung

verses.original: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਤੋਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: so ghar raakh vaddaiee toh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: - follow that system; in it rests greatness. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਵਿਸੁਏ ਚਸਿਆ ਘੜੀਆ ਪਹਰਾ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਭਇਆ ॥ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: visue chasiaa ghaReeaa paharaa thitee vaaree maahu bhiaa || sooraj eko rut anek ||
verses.translation: As the seconds, minutes, hours, days, weekdays months and seasons all originate from the one sun,
O Nanak, so do all forms originate from the One Creator. ||2||30||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Aasaa, Third House, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਖ ਲਸਕਰ ਲਖ ਵਾਜੇ ਨੇਜੇ ਲਖ ਉਠਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: lakh lasakar lakh vaaje neje lakh uTh kareh salaam ||
verses.translation: You may have thousands of armies, thousands of marching bands and lances, and thousands of men to rise and salute you.

verses.original: ਲਖਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਲਖ ਉਠਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: lakhaa upar furamais teree lakh uTh raakheh maan ||
verses.translation: Your rule may extend over thousands of miles, and thousands of men may rise to honor you.

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਰਾਫਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) pat lekhai naa pavai taa(n) sabh niraafal kaam ||1||
verses.translation: But, if your honor is of no account to the Lord, then all of your ostentatious show is useless. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam binaa jag dha(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, the world is in turmoil.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਭੋਲਾ ਭੀ ਸੋ ਅੰਧੋ ਅੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: je bahutaa samajhaieeaai bholaa bhee so a(n)dho a(n)dhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Even though the fool may be taught again and again, he remains the blindest of the blind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਲਖ ਖਟੀਅਹਿ ਲਖ ਸੰਜੀਅਹਿ ਖਾਜਹਿ ਲਖ ਆਵਹਿ ਲਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: lakh khaTe'eeh lakh sa(n)je'eeh khaajeh lakh aaveh lakh jaeh ||
verses.translation: You may earn thousands, collect thousands, and spend thousands of dollars; thousands may come, and thousands may go.

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਅ ਕਿਥੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) pat lekhai naa pavai taa(n) jeea kithai fir paeh ||2||
verses.translation: But, if your honor is of no account to the Lord, then where will you go to find a safe haven? ||2||

verses.original: ਲਖ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ ਲਖ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
verses.translit: lakh saasat samajhaavanee lakh pa(n)ddit paReh puraan ||
verses.translation: Thousands of Shaastras may be explained to the mortal, and thousands of Pandits may read the Puraanas to him;

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭੇ ਕੁਪਰਵਾਣ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) pat lekhai naa pavai taa(n) sabhe kuparavaan ||3||
verses.translation: but, if his honor is of no account to the Lord, then all of this is unacceptable. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach naam pat uoopajai karam naam karataar ||
verses.translation: Honor comes from the True Name, the Name of the Merciful Creator.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜੇ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: ahinis hiradhai je vasai naanak nadharee paar ||4||1||31||
verses.translation: If it abides in the heart, day and night, O Nanak, then the mortal shall swim across, by His Grace. ||4||1||31||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੀਵਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: dheevaa meraa ek naam dhukh vich paiaa tel ||
verses.translation: The One Name is my lamp; I have put the oil of suffering into it.

verses.original: ਉਨਿ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਖਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aun chaanan oh sokhiaa chookaa jam siau mel ||1||
verses.translation: Its flame has dried up this oil, and I have escaped my meeting with the Messenger of Death. ||1||
O people, do not make fun of me.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਮੜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਏਕਠੇ ਏਕ ਰਤੀ ਲੇ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: lakh maRiaa kar ekaThe ek ratee le bhaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Thousands of wooden logs, piled up together, need only a tiny flame to burn. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਤਲਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਕੇਸਉ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: pi(n)dd patal meree kesau kiriaa sach naam karataar ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my festive dish, of rice balls on leafy plates; the True Name of the Creator Lord is my funeral ceremony.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਏਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaithai othai aagai paachhai eh meraa aadhaar ||2||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, in the past and in the future, this is my support. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੰਗ ਬਨਾਰਸਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਨਾਵੈ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ga(n)g banaaras sifat tumaaree naavai aatam raau ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Praise is my River Ganges and my city of Benares; my soul takes its sacred cleansing bath there.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਤਾਂ ਥੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sachaa naavan taa(n) theeaai jaa(n) ahinis laagai bhaau ||3||
verses.translation: That becomes my true cleansing bath, if night and day, I enshrine love for You. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਕ ਲੋਕੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਛਮਿਛਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਵਟਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik lokee hor chhamichharee braahaman vaT pi(n)dd khai ||
verses.translation: The rice balls are offered to the gods and the dead ancestors, but it is the Brahmins who eat them!

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਕਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨਿਖੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: naanak pi(n)dd bakhasees kaa kabahoo(n) nikhooTas naeh ||4||2||32||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the rice balls of the Lord are a gift which is never exhausted. ||4||2||32||
Aasaa, Fourth House, First Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhevatiaa dharasan kai taiee dhookh bhookh teerath ke'ee ||
verses.translation: The Gods, yearning for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, suffered through pain and hunger at the sacred shrines.

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਵੇ ਭੇਖ ਭਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jogee jatee jugat meh rahate kar kar bhagave bhekh bhe ||1||
verses.translation: The yogis and the celibates live their disciplined lifestyle, while others wear saffron robes and become hermits. ||1||
For Your sake, O Lord Master, they are imbued with love.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕਾ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕੇਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tere naam anekaa roop ana(n)taa kahan na jaahee tere gun kete ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your Names are so many, and Your Forms are endless. No one can tell how may Glorious Virtues You have. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਰ ਘਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਲਾਇਤਿ ਦੇਸ ਗਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhar ghar mahalaa hasatee ghoRe chhodd vilait dhes ge ||
verses.translation: Leaving behind hearth and home, palaces, elephants, horses and native lands, mortals have journeyed to foreign lands.

verses.original: ਪੀਰ ਪੇਕਾਂਬਰ ਸਾਲਿਕ ਸਾਦਿਕ ਛੋਡੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਥਾਇ ਪਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: peer pekaa(n)bar saalik saadhik chhoddee dhuneeaa thai pe ||2||
verses.translation: The spiritual leaders, prophets, seers and men of faith renounced the world, and became acceptable. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਦ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ ਕਾਪੜ ਛੋਡੇ ਚਮੜ ਲੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: saadh sahaj sukh ras kas tajeeale kaapaR chhodde chamaR le'ee ||
verses.translation: Renouncing tasty delicacies, comfort, happiness and pleasures, some have abandoned their clothes and now wear skins.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੀਏ ਦਰਦਵੰਦ ਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਭਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhukhe'ee dharadhava(n)dh dhar terai naam rate dharaves bhe ||3||
verses.translation: Those who suffer in pain, imbued with Your Name, have become beggars at Your Door. ||3||

verses.original: ਖਲੜੀ ਖਪਰੀ ਲਕੜੀ ਚਮੜੀ ਸਿਖਾ ਸੂਤੁ ਧੋਤੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ॥
verses.translit: khalaRee khaparee lakaRee chamaRee sikhaa soot dhotee keen(h)ee ||
verses.translation: Some wear skins, and carry begging bowls, bearing wooden staffs, and sitting on deer skins. Others raise their hair in tufts and wear sacred threads and loin-cloths.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹਉ ਸਾਂਗੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੈਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: too(n) saahib hau saa(n)gee teraa pranavai naanak jaat kaisee ||4||1||33||
verses.translation: You are the Lord Master, I am just Your puppet. Prays Nanak, what is my social status to be? ||4||1||33||
Aasaa, Fifth House, First Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The five evil passions dwell hidden within the mind.

verses.original: ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: thir na raheh jaise bhaveh udhaase ||1||
verses.translation: They do not remain still, but move around like wanderers. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: man meraa dhiaal setee thir na rahai ||
verses.translation: My soul does not stay held by the Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਲੋਭੀ ਕਪਟੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਧਿਕ ਲਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: lobhee kapaTee paapee paakha(n)ddee maiaa adhik lagai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It is greedy, deceitful, sinful and hypocritical, and totally attached to Maya. ||1||Pause||
I will decorate my neck with garlands of flowers.
When I meet my Beloved, then I will put on my decorations. ||2||
I have five companions and one Spouse.
It is ordained from the very beginning, that the soul must ultimately depart. ||3||
The five companions will lament together.

verses.original: ਸਾਹੁ ਪਜੂਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: saahu pajootaa pranavat naanak lekhaa dhehaa ||4||1||34||
verses.translation: When the soul is trapped, prays Nanak, it is called to account. ||4||1||34||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Aasaa, Sixth House, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਜੇ ਗਹਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਉਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੂਤ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: man motee je gahanaa hovai paun hovai soot dhaaree ||
verses.translation: If the pearl of the mind is strung like a jewel on the thread of the breath,

verses.original: ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਰਾਵੈ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khimaa seegaar kaaman tan pahirai raavai laal piaaree ||1||
verses.translation: and the soul-bride adorns her body with compassion, then the Beloved Lord will enjoy His lovely bride. ||1||
O my Love, I am fascinated by Your many glories;

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਅਵਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tere gun hoh na avaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your Glorious Virtues are not found in any other. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਲੇ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਦਾਮੋਦਰੁ ਦੰਤੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
verses.translit: har har haar ka(n)Th le pahirai dhaamodhar dha(n)t leiee ||
verses.translation: If the bride wears the garland of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, around her neck, and if she uses the toothbrush of the Lord;

verses.original: ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੰਗਨ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਧਰੇਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kar kar karataa ka(n)gan pahirai in bidh chit dhareiee ||2||
verses.translation: and if she fashions and wears the bracelet of the Creator Lord around her wrist, then she shall hold her consciousness steady. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਕਰ ਮੁੰਦਰੀ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਟੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
verses.translit: madhusoodhan kar mu(n)dharee pahirai paramesar paT leiee ||
verses.translation: She should make the Lord, the Slayer of demons, her ring, and take the Transcendent Lord as her silken clothes.

verses.original: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੜੀ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਰਮਾ ਦੇਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dheeraj dhaRee ba(n)dhaavai kaaman sreera(n)g suramaa dheiee ||3||
verses.translation: The soul-bride should weave patience into the braids of her hair, and apply the lotion of the Lord, the Great Lover. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਜੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਜਾਲੇ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੇਜ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
verses.translit: man ma(n)dhar je dheepak jaale kaiaa sej kareiee ||
verses.translation: If she lights the lamp in the mansion of her mind, and makes her body the bed of the Lord,

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਾਉ ਜਬ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਵੈ ਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: giaan raau jab sejai aavai ta naanak bhog kareiee ||4||1||35||
verses.translation: then, when the King of spiritual wisdom comes to her bed, He shall take her, and enjoy her. ||4||1||35||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa hovai kare karaiaa tis kiaa kaheeaai bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The created being acts as he is made to act; what can be said to him, O Siblings of Destiny?

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa keete kiaa chaturaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Whatever the Lord is to do, He is doing; what cleverness could be used to affect Him? ||1||
The Order of Your Will is so sweet, O Lord; this is pleasing to You.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naanak taa kau milai vaddaiee saache naam samaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone is honored with greatness, who is absorbed in the True Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kirat piaa paravaanaa likhiaa baahuR hukam na hoiee ||
verses.translation: The deeds are done according to pre-ordained destiny; no one can turn back this Order.

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤੈਸਾ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaisaa likhiaa taisaa paRiaa meT na sakai koiee ||2||
verses.translation: As it is written, so it comes to pass; no one can erase it. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਵੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: je ko dharageh bahutaa bolai naau pavai baajaaree ||
verses.translation: He who talks on and on in the Lord's Court is known as a joker.

verses.original: ਸਤਰੰਜ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਚੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satara(n)j baajee pakai naahee kachee aavai saaree ||3||
verses.translation: He is not successful in the game of chess, and his chessmen do not reach their goal. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa ko paRiaa pa(n)ddit beenaa naa ko moorakh ma(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: By himself, no one is literate, learned or wise; no one is ignorant or evil.

verses.original: ਬੰਦੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹੀਐ ਬੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhee a(n)dhar sifat karaae taa kau kaheeaai ba(n)dhaa ||4||2||36||
verses.translation: When, as a slave, one praises the Lord, only then is he known as a human being. ||4||2||36||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਖਿਮਾ ਹਢਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh manai meh mu(n)dhraa khi(n)thaa khimaa haddaavau ||
verses.translation: Let the Word of the Guru's Shabad be the ear-rings in your mind, and wear the patched coat of tolerance.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਉ ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo kichh karai bhalaa kar maanau sahaj jog nidh paavau ||1||
verses.translation: Whatever the Lord does, look upon that as good; thus you shall obtain the treasure of Sehj Yoga. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗ ਜੋਗੀ ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੰ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa jugataa jeeau jugeh jug jogee param ta(n)t meh joga(n) ||
verses.translation: O father, the soul which is united in union as a Yogi, remains united in the supreme essence throughout the ages.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit naam nira(n)jan paiaa giaan kaiaa ras bhoga(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who has obtained the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord - his body enjoys the pleasure of spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸਉ ਕਲਪ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਾਦੰ ॥
verses.translit: siv nagaree meh aasan baisau kalap tiaagee baadha(n) ||
verses.translation: In the Lord's City, he sits in his Yogic posture, and he forsakes his desires and conflicts.

verses.original: ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਦੰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: si(n)n(g)ee sabadh sadhaa dhun sohai ahinis poorai naadha(n) ||2||
verses.translation: The sound of the horn ever rings out its beautiful melody, and day and night, he is filled with the sound current of the Naad. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਬਿਭੂਤੰ ॥
verses.translit: pat veechaar giaan mat dda(n)ddaa varatamaan bibhoota(n) ||
verses.translation: My cup is reflective meditation, and spiritual wisdom is my walking stick; to dwell in the Lord's Presence is the ashes I apply to my body.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਅਤੀਤੰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har keerat raharaas hamaaree gurmukh pa(n)th ateeta(n) ||3||
verses.translation: The Praise of the Lord is my occupation; and to live as Gurmukh is my pure religion. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸੰਮਿਆ ਨਾਨਾ ਵਰਨ ਅਨੇਕੰ ॥
verses.translit: sagalee jot hamaaree sa(n)miaa naanaa varan aneka(n) ||
verses.translation: My arm-rest is to see the Lord's Light in all, although their forms and colors are so numerous.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਿਵ ਏਕੰ ॥੪॥੩॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sun bharathar jogee paarabraham liv eka(n) ||4||3||37||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, listen, O Bharthari Yogi: love only the Supreme Lord God. ||4||3||37||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਵੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: guR kar giaan dhiaan kar dhaavai kar karanee kas paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Make spiritual wisdom your molasses, and meditation your scented flowers; let good deeds be the herbs.

verses.original: ਭਾਠੀ ਭਵਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਾ ਪੋਚਾ ਇਤੁ ਰਸਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਚੁਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhaaThee bhavan prem kaa pochaa it ras amiau chuaaieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: Let devotional faith be the distilling fire, and your love the ceramic cup. Thus the sweet nectar of life is distilled. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜ ਰੰਗ ਰਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa man matavaaro naam ras peevai sahaj ra(n)g rach rahiaa ||
verses.translation: O Baba, the mind is intoxicated with the Naam, drinking in its Nectar. It remains absorbed in the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਬਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਗਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis banee prem liv laagee sabadh anaahadh gahiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Night and day, remaining attached to the Love of the Lord, the celestial music of the Shabad resounds. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪੀਆਏ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: pooraa saach piaalaa sahaje tiseh peeaae jaa kau nadhar kare ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Lord naturally gives the cup of Truth, to the one upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਦਿ ਛੂਛੈ ਭਾਉ ਧਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat kaa vaapaaree hovai kiaa madh chhoochhai bhaau dhare ||2||
verses.translation: One who trades in this Nectar - how could he ever love the wine of the world? ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਪੀਵਤ ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee saakhee a(n)mirat baanee peevat hee paravaan bhiaa ||
verses.translation: The Teachings of the Guru, the Ambrosial Bani - drinking them in, one becomes acceptable and renowned.

verses.original: ਦਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੈ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhar dharasan kaa preetam hovai mukat baiku(n)Thai karai kiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Unto the one who loves the Lord's Court, and the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, of what use is liberation or paradise? ||3||

verses.original: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਰਤਾ ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: sifatee rataa sadh bairaagee jooaai janam na haarai ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Praises, one is forever a Bairaagee, a renunciate, and one's life is not lost in the gamble.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਖੀਵਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sun bharathar jogee kheevaa a(n)mirat dhaarai ||4||4||38||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, listen, O Bharthari Yogi: drink in the intoxicating nectar of the Lord. ||4||4||38||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
Having attacked Khuraasaan, Baabar terrified Hindustan.

verses.original: ਆਪੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਗਲੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapai dhos na dheiee karataa jam kar mugal chaRaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself does not take the blame, but has sent the Mugal as the messenger of death.

verses.original: ਏਤੀ ਮਾਰ ਪਈ ਕਰਲਾਣੇ ਤੈਂ ਕੀ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: etee maar piee karalaane tai(n) kee dharadh na aaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: There was so much slaughter that the people screamed. Didn't You feel compassion, Lord? ||1||
O Creator Lord, You are the Master of all.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਕਤਾ ਸਕਤੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: je sakataa sakate kau maare taa man ros na hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If some powerful man strikes out against another man, then no one feels any grief in their mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਕਤਾ ਸੀਹੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੈ ਵਗੈ ਖਸਮੈ ਸਾ ਪੁਰਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sakataa seeh maare pai vagai khasamai saa purasaiee ||
verses.translation: But if a powerful tiger attacks a flock of sheep and kills them, then its master must answer for it.

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਵਿਗਾੜਿ ਵਿਗੋਏ ਕੁਤਂੀ ਮੁਇਆ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ratan vigaaR vigoe kuta(n)ee muiaa saar na kaiee ||
verses.translation: This priceless country has been laid waste and defiled by dogs, and no one pays any attention to the dead.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape joR vichhoRe aape vekh teree vaddiaaiee ||2||
verses.translation: You Yourself unite, and You Yourself separate; I gaze upon Your Glorious Greatness. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਏ ਵਡਾ ਸਾਦ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: je ko naau dharaae vaddaa saadh kare man bhaane ||
verses.translation: One may give himself a great name, and revel in the pleasures of the mind,

verses.original: ਖਸਮੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਕੀੜਾ ਆਵੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਚੁਗੈ ਦਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: khasamai nadharee keeRaa aavai jete chugai dhaane ||
verses.translation: but in the Eyes of the Lord and Master, he is just a worm, for all the corn that he eats.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥੩॥੫॥੩੯॥
verses.translit: mar mar jeevai taa kichh paae naanak naam vakhaane ||3||5||39||
verses.translation: Only one who dies to his ego while yet alive, obtains the blessings, O Nanak, by chanting the Lord's Name. ||3||5||39||

verses.translit: raag aasaa ghar doojaa mahalaa teejaa
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, Second House, Third Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan is obtained by great good fortune.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, true detachment is obtained.
The six systems of philosophy are pervasive,
but the Guru's system is profound and unequalled. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai dharasan mukat gat hoi ||
verses.translation: The Guru's system is the way to liberation.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa aap vasai man soi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Lord Himself comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||
Through the Guru's system, the world is saved,
if it is embraced with love and affection.
How rare is that person who truly loves the Guru's Way.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur kai dharasan sadhaa sukh hoi ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's system, everlasting peace is obtained. ||2||
Through the Guru's system, the Door of Salvation is obtained.
Serving the True Guru, one's family is saved.
There is no salvation for those who have no Guru.
Beguiled by worthless sins, they are struck down. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh sukh saa(n)t sareer ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the body finds peace and tranquility.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh taa kau lagai na peer ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is not afflicted by pain.
The Messenger of Death does not come near him.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh is absorbed in the True Lord. ||4||1||40||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, eradicates his self-conceit from within.
He serves the True Guru, with no iota of self-interest.
The Fearless Lord, the Great Giver, ever abides in his mind.
The True Bani of the Word is obtained only by good destiny. ||1||
So gather merits, and let your demerits depart from within you.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur kai sabadh samaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall be absorbed into the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: gunaa kaa gaahak hovai so gun jaanai ||
verses.translation: One who purchases merits, knows the value of these merits.
He chants the Ambrosial Nectar of the Word, and the Name of the Lord.
Through the True Bani of the Word, he becomes pure.
Through merit, the Name is obtained. ||2||
The invaluable merits cannot be acquired.
The pure mind is absorbed into the True Word of the Shabad.
How very fortunate are those who meditate on the Naam,
and ever enshrine in their minds the Lord, the Giver of merit. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo gun sa(n)grahai tin(h) balihaarai jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who gather merits.
At the Gate of Truth, I sing the Glorious Praises of the True One.
He Himself spontaneously bestows His gifts.
O Nanak, the value of the Lord cannot be described. ||4||2||41||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
Great is the greatness of the True Guru;
He merges in His Merger, those who have been separated for so long.
He Himself merges the merged in His Merger.
He Himself knows His own worth. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har kee keemat kin bidh hoi ||
verses.translation: How can anyone appraise the Lord's worth?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har apara(n)par agam agochar gur kai sabadh milai jan koi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one may merge with the Infinite, Unapproachable and Incomprehensible Lord. ||1||Pause||
Few are the Gurmukhs who know His worth.
How rare are those who receive the Lord's Grace.
Through the Sublime Bani of His Word, one becomes sublime.
The Gurmukh chants the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
Without the Name, the body suffers in pain;
but when one meets the True Guru, then that pain is removed.
Without meeting the Guru, the mortal earns only pain.
The self-willed manmukh receives only more punishment. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਅਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam meeThaa at ras hoi ||
verses.translation: The essence of the Lord's Name is so very sweet;
he alone drinks it, whom the Lord causes to drink it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te har ras paae ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the essence of the Lord is obtained.
O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, salvation is attained. ||4||3||42||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
My God is True, deep and profound.
Serving Him, the body acquires peace and tranquility.
Through the Word of the Shabad, His humble servants easily swim across.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਮ ਸਦ ਲਾਗਹ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin kai ham sadh laageh pai ||1||
verses.translation: I fall at their feet forever and ever. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo man raate har ra(n)g lai ||
verses.translation: Those being whose minds are imbued and drenched with the Lord's Love

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tin kaa janam maran dhukh laathaa te har dharageh mile subhai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: - their pains of birth and death are taken away. They are automatically ushered into the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
One who has tasted the Shabad, obtains the true flavor.
The Name of the Lord abides within his mind.
The Lord God is Eternal and All-pervading.
He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away. ||2||
Everyone talks and speaks through speech;
the Lord Himself forgives, and unites us with Himself.
By merely speaking and talking, He is not obtained.
By Guru's Grace, He comes to abide in the mind. ||3||
The Gurmukh eradicates his self-conceit from within.
He is imbued with the Lord's Love, having discarded worldly attachment.
He contemplates the utterly Immaculate Word of the Guru's Shabad.
O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is our Salvation. ||4||4||43||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
Attached to the love of duality, one only incurs pain.
Without the Word of the Shabad, one's life is wasted away in vain.
Serving the True Guru, understanding is obtained,
and then, one is not attached to the love of duality. ||1||
Those who hold fast to their roots, become acceptable.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin raam naam jap hiradhai gur sabadhee har eko jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Night and day, they meditate within their hearts on the Lord's Name; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they know the One Lord. ||1||Pause||
One who is attached to the branch, does not receive the fruits.
For blind actions, blind punishment is received.
The blind, self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bisaTaa kaa keeRaa bisaTaa maeh pachai ||2||
verses.translation: He is a maggot in manure, and in manure he shall rot away. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee sevaa sadhaa sukh paae ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, everlasting peace is obtained.
Joining the True Congregation, the Sat Sangat, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.
One who contemplates the Naam, the Name of the Lord,
saves himself, and his family as well. ||3||
Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, the Naam resounds;
O Nanak, through the Word of the Shabad, one finds the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within the home of the heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat sat sar har jal naiaa ||
verses.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, bathe in the Pool of Truth, in the Water of the Lord;
thus the filth of evil-mindedness and sin shall all be washed away. ||4||5||44||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
The self-willed manmukhs are dying; they are wasting away in death.
In the love of duality, they murder their own souls.
Crying out, ""Mine, mine!"", they are ruined.

verses.original: ਆਤਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aatam na cheen(h)ai bharamai vich sootaa ||1||
verses.translation: They do not remember their souls; they are asleep in superstition. ||1||
He alone dies a real death, who dies in the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮ ਜਾਣਾਈ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ausatat ni(n)dhaa gur sam jaanaiee is jug meh laahaa har jap lai jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru has inspired me to realize, that praise and slander are one and the same; in this world, the profit is obtained by chanting the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are dissolved within the womb.
Useless is the birth of those who are lured by duality.
Without the Naam, all are burning in pain.
The Perfect True Guru has given me this understanding. ||2||
The fickle mind is struck down so many times.
Having lost this opportunity, no place of rest shall be found.
Cast into the womb of reincarnation, the mortal lives in manure;
in such a home, the self-willed manmukh takes up residence. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: apune satigur kau sadhaa bal jaiee ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru;
the light of the Gurmukh blends with the Divine Light of the Lord.
Through the Immaculate Bani of the Word, the mortal dwells within the home of his own inner self.
O Nanak, he conquers his ego, and remains forever detached. ||4||6||45||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
The Lord's slave sets aside his own social status.
He dedicates his mind and body to the True Guru, and seeks His Sanctuary.
His greatest greatness is that the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is in his heart.
The Beloved Lord God is his constant companion. ||1||
He alone is the Lord's slave, who remains dead while yet alive.

verses.original: ਸੋਗੁ ਹਰਖੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sog harakh dhui sam kar jaanai gur parasaadhee sabadh udharai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He looks upon pleasure and pain alike; by Guru's Grace, he is saved through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||
He does his deeds according to the Lord's Primal Command.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕੋ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai ko thai na paiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, no one is approved.
Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, the Naam abides within the mind.
He Himself gives His gifts, without hesitation. ||2||
The self-willed manmukh wanders around the world in doubt.
Without any capital, he makes false transactions.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਵਖਰੁ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vin raasee vakhar palai na pai ||
verses.translation: Without any capital, he does not obtain any merchandise.
The mistaken manmukh wastes away his life. ||3||
One who serves the True Guru is the Lord's slave.
His social status is exalted, and his reputation is exalted.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਉੜੀ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur pauRee sabh dhoo uoochaa hoi ||
verses.translation: Climbing the Guru's Ladder, he becomes the most exalted of all.
O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, greatness is obtained. ||4||7||46||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
The self-willed manmukh practices falsehood, only falsehood.

verses.original: ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: khasamai kaa mahal kadhe na paavai ||
verses.translation: He never attains the Mansion of the Lord Presence.
Attached to duality, he wanders, deluded by doubt.
Entangled in worldly attachments, he comes and goes. ||1||
Behold, the decorations of the discarded bride!

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤਿ ਧਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਝੂਠੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾੳ ॥
verses.translit: putr kalat dhan maiaa chit laae jhooTh moh paakha(n)dd vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Her consciousness is attached to children, spouse, wealth, and Maya, falsehood, emotional attachment, hypocrisy and corruption. ||1||Pause||
She who is pleasing to God is forever a happy soul-bride.
She makes the Word of the Guru's Shabad her decoration.
Her bed is so comfortable; she enjoys her Lord, night and day.
Meeting her Beloved, the obtains eternal peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saa sohaagan saachee jis saach piaar ||
verses.translation: She is a true, virtuous soul-bride, who enshrines love for the True Lord.

verses.original: ਅਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: apanaa pir raakhai sadhaa ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: She keeps her Husband Lord always clasped to her heart.
She sees Him near at hand, ever-present.
My God is all-pervading everywhere. ||3||
Social status and beauty will not go with you hereafter.
As are the deeds done here, so does one become.
Through the Word of the Shabad, one becomes the highest of the high.
O Nanak, he is absorbed in the True Lord. ||4||8||47||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
The Lord's humble servant is imbued with devotional love, effortlessly and spontaneously.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bhai saachai saach samai ||
verses.translation: Through awe and fear of the Guru, he is truly absorbed in the True One.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur poore bhagat na hoi ||
verses.translation: Without the Perfect Guru, devotional love is not obtained.
The self-willed manmukhs lose their honor, and cry out in pain. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har jap sadhaa dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Lord's Name, and meditate on Him forever.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh hovai dhin raatee jo ichhai soiee fal pai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall always be in ecstasy, day and night, and you shall obtain the fruits of your desires. ||1||Pause||
Through the Perfect Guru, the Perfect Lord is obtained,
and the Shabad, the True Name, is enshrined in the mind.
One who bathes in the Pool of Ambrosial Nectar becomes immaculately pure within.
He becomes forever sanctified, and is absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||
He sees the Lord God ever-present.
By Guru's Grace, he sees the Lord permeating and pervading everywhere.
Wherever I go, there I see Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur bin dhaataa avar na koi ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, there is no other Giver. ||3||
The Guru is the ocean, the perfect treasure,
the most precious jewel and priceless ruby.
By Guru's Grace, the Great Giver blesses us;
O Nanak, the Forgiving Lord forgives us. ||4||9||48||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
The Guru is the Ocean; the True Guru is the Embodiment of Truth.
Through perfect good destiny, one serves the Guru.
He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself inspires to understand.
By Guru's Grace, one serves Him. ||1||
With the jewel of spiritual wisdom, total understanding is obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh agiaan binaasai anadhin jaagai vekhai sach soi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, ignorance is dispelled; one then remains wakeful, night and day, and beholds the True Lord. ||1||Pause||
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, attachment and pride are burnt away.
From the Perfect Guru, true understanding is obtained.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one realizes the Lord's Presence within.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan rahai thir naam samaane ||2||
verses.translation: Then, one's coming and going cease, and one becomes stable, absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
The world is tied to birth and death.
The unconscious, self-willed manmukh is enveloped in the darkness of Maya and emotional attachment.
He slanders others, and practices utter falsehood.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: visaTaa kaa keeRaa visaTaa maeh samaavai ||3||
verses.translation: He is a maggot in manure, and into manure he is absorbed. ||3||
Joining the True Congregation, the Sat Sangat, total understanding is obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh har bhagat dhiraRaae ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, devotional love for the Lord is implanted.
One who surrenders to the Lord's Will is peaceful forever.
O Nanak, he is absorbed into the True Lord. ||4||10||49||
Aasaa, Third Mehla, Panch-Padhay:
One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, finds eternal bliss.
He is united with the True Guru, the Guru, the Lord God.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naa fir marai na aavai jai ||
verses.translation: He does not die any more, and he does not come or go.
Through the Perfect Guru, he merges with the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) kau naam likhiaa dhur lekh ||
verses.translation: One who has the Naam, the Name of the Lord, written in his pre-ordained destiny,

verses.original: ਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: te anadhin naam sadhaa dhiaaveh gur poore te bhagat visekh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: night and day, meditates forever on the Naam; he obtains the wondrous blessing of devotional love from the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) kau har prabh le milai ||
verses.translation: Those, whom the Lord God has blended with Himself

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tin(h) kee gahan gat kahee na jai ||
verses.translation: their sublime state cannot be described.
The Perfect True Guru has given the Glorious Greatness,
of the most exalted order, and I am absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh kare su aape aap ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Lord does, He does all by Himself.
In an instant, He establishes, and disestablishes.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਣਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਘਾਲੇ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: keh keh kahanaa aakh sunaae || je sau ghaale thai na paae ||3||
verses.translation: By merely speaking, talking, shouting and preaching about the Lord, even hundreds of times, the mortal is not approved. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) kai potai pu(n)n tin(h)aa guroo milaae ||
verses.translation: The Guru meets with those, who take virtue as their treasure;
they listen to the True Word of the Guru's Bani, the Shabad.

verses.original: ਜਹਾਂ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਤਹਾਂ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jahaa(n) sabadh vasai tahaa(n) dhukh jaae ||
verses.translation: Pain departs, from that place where the Shabad abides.
By the jewel of spiritual wisdom, one is easily absorbed into the True Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naavai jevadd hor dhan naahee koi ||
verses.translation: No other wealth is as great as the Naam.
It is bestowed only by the True Lord.
Through the Perfect Word of the Shabad, it abides in the mind.
O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, peace is obtained. ||5||11||50||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
One may dance and play numerous instruments;

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਬੋਲਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eih man a(n)dhaa bolaa hai kis aakh sunaae ||
