verses.translation: but this mind is blind and deaf, so for whose benefit is this speaking and preaching?
Deep within is the fire of greed, and the dust-storm of doubt.
The lamp of knowledge is not burning, and understanding is not obtained. ||1||
The Gurmukh has the light of devotional worship within his heart.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aap pachhaan milai prabh soi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Understanding his own self, he meets God. ||1||Pause||
The Gurmukh's dance is to embrace love for the Lord;
to the beat of the drum, he sheds his ego from within.
My God is True; He Himself is the Knower of all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh a(n)tar braham pachhaan ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, recognize the Creator Lord within yourself. ||2||
The Gurmukh is filled with devotional love for the Beloved Lord.
He intuitively reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
For the Gurmukh, loving devotional worship is the way to the True Lord.
But the dances and the worship of the hypocrites bring only pain. ||3||
True Devotion is to remain dead while yet alive.
By Guru's Grace, one crosses over the terrible world-ocean.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan bhagat thai pai ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, one's devotion is accepted,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: har jeeau aap vasai man aai ||4||
verses.translation: and then, the Dear Lord Himself comes to dwell in the mind. ||4||
When the Lord bestows His Mercy, He leads us to meet the True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: nihachal bhagat har siau chit laae ||
verses.translation: Then, one's devotion becomes steady, and the consciousness is centered upon the Lord.
Those who are imbued with Devotion have truthful reputations.
O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, peace is obtained. ||5||12||51||

verses.translit: aasaa ghar atthvaa kaafee mahalaa teejaa
verses.translation: Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Third Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har kai bhaanai satigur milai sach sojhee hoiee ||
verses.translation: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, one meets the True Guru, and true understanding is obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee man vasai har boojhai soiee ||1||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Lord abides in the mind, and one comes to understand the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਸਹੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: mai sahu dhaataa ek hai avar naahee koiee ||
verses.translation: My Husband Lord, the Great Giver, is One. There is no other at all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te man vasai taa sadhaa sukh hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's merciful favor, He abides in the mind, and then, a lasting peace ensues. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: eis jug meh nirabhau har naam hai paieeaai gur veechaar ||
verses.translation: In this age, the Lord's Name is fearless; it is obtained by meditative reflection upon the Guru.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin naavai jam kai vas hai manmukh a(n)dh gavaar ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Name, the blind, foolish, self-willed manmukh is under Death's power. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har kai bhaanai jan sevaa karai boojhai sach soiee ||
verses.translation: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, the humble being performs His service, and understands the True Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har kai bhaanai saalaaheeaai bhaanai ma(n)niaai sukh hoiee ||3||
verses.translation: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, He is to be praised; surrendering to His Will, peace ensues. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har kai bhaanai janam padhaarath paiaa mat uootam hoiee ||
verses.translation: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, the prize of this human birth is obtained, and the intellect is exalted.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੧੩॥੫੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam salaeh too(n) gurmukh gat hoiee ||4||39||13||52||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, you shall be emancipated. ||4||39||13||52||
Aasaa, Fourth Mehla, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
You are the True Creator, my Lord Master.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥੀਸੀ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo tau bhaavai soiee theesee jo too(n) dheh soiee hau paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: That which is pleasing to Your Will, comes to pass. Whatever You give, that is what I receive. ||1||Pause||
All are Yours; all meditate on You.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis no kirapaa kareh tin naam ratan paiaa ||
verses.translation: He alone, whom You bless with Your Mercy, obtains the jewel of the Naam.
The Gurmukhs obtain it, and the self-willed manmukhs lose it.
You Yourself separate the mortals, and You Yourself unite them. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) dhareeaau sabh tujh hee maeh ||
verses.translation: You are the River - all are within You.
Other than You, there is no one at all.
All beings and creatures are your play-things.
The united ones are separated, and the separated ones are re-united. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no too jaanaieh soiee jan jaanai ||
verses.translation: That humble being, whom You inspire to understand, understands;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: har gun sadh hee aakh vakhaanai ||
verses.translation: he continually speaks and chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin har seviaa tin sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: One who serves the Lord, obtains peace.
He is easily absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: too aape karataa teraa keeaa sabh hoi ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Creator; by Your doing, all things come to be.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bin dhoojaa avar na koi ||
verses.translation: Without You, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: too kar kar vekheh jaaneh soi ||
verses.translation: You watch over the creation, and understand it.
O servant Nanak, the Lord is revealed to the Gurmukh. ||4||1||53||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.translit: raag aasaa ghar doojaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, Second House, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kis hee dhaRaa keeaa mitr sut naal bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Some form alliances with friends, children and siblings.

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਕੁੜਮ ਸਕੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਜਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kis hee dhaRaa keeaa kuRam sake naal javaiee ||
verses.translation: Some form alliances with in-laws and relatives.

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਚਉਧਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: kis hee dhaRaa keeaa sikadhaar chaudharee naal aapanai suaaiee ||
verses.translation: Some form alliances with chiefs and leaders for their own selfish motives.
My alliance is with the Lord, who is pervading everywhere. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: ham har siau dhaRaa keeaa meree har Tek ||
verses.translation: I have formed my alliance with the Lord; the Lord is my only support.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਖੁ ਧੜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai har bin pakh dhaRaa avar na koiee hau har gun gaavaa asa(n)kh anek ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Other than the Lord, I have no other faction or alliance; I sing of the countless and endless Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਧੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) siau dhaRe kareh se jaeh ||
verses.translation: Those with whom you form alliances, shall perish.
Making false alliances, the mortals repent and regret in the end.

verses.original: ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: thir na raheh man khoT kamaeh ||
verses.translation: Those who practice falsehood shall not last.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ham har siau dhaRaa keeaa jis kaa koiee samarath naeh ||2||
verses.translation: I have formed my alliance with the Lord; there is no one more powerful than Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਏਹ ਸਭਿ ਧੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: eh sabh dhaRe maiaa moh pasaaree ||
verses.translation: All these alliances are mere extensions of the love of Maya.
Only fools argue over Maya.
They are born, and they die, and they lose the game of life in the gamble.

verses.original: ਹਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਜਿ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hamarai har dhaRaa j halat palat sabh savaaree ||3||
verses.translation: My alliance is with the Lord, who embellishes all, in this world and the next. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਧੜੇ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਝਗੜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kalijug meh dhaRe pa(n)ch chor jhagaRaae ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the five thieves instigate alliances and conflicts.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh moh abhimaan vadhaae ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger, greed, emotional attachment and self-conceit have increased.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis no kirapaa kare tis satasa(n)g milaae ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed by the Lord's Grace, joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਹਮਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਧੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: hamaraa har dhaRaa jin eh dhaRe sabh gavaae ||4||
verses.translation: My alliance is with the Lord, who has destroyed all these alliances. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਧੜੇ ਬਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: mithiaa dhoojaa bhaau dhaRe beh paavai ||
verses.translation: In the false love of duality, people sit and form alliances.

verses.original: ਪਰਾਇਆ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਅਟਕਲੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: paraiaa chhidhr aTakalai aapanaa aha(n)kaar vadhaavai ||
verses.translation: They complain about other peoples' faults, while their own self-conceit only increases.
As they plant, so shall they harvest.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੫॥੨॥੫੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kaa har dhaRaa dharam sabh sirasaT jin aavai ||5||2||54||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has joined the Lord's alliance of Dharma, which shall conquer the whole world. ||5||2||54||
Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai sun sun man a(n)mrit bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Constantly listening to the Ambrosial Gurbani in the heart, it becomes pleasing to the mind.
Through Gurbani, the Incomprehensible Lord is comprehended. ||1||
As Gurmukh, listen to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my sisters.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eko rav rahiaa ghaT a(n)tar mukh bolahu gur a(n)mirat bainaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is pervading and permeating deep within the heart; with your mouth, recite the Ambrosial Hymns of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: mai man tan prem mahaa bairaag ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are filled with divine love, and great sadness.
By great good fortune, I have obtained the True Guru, the Primal Being. ||2||
In the love of duality, the mortals wander through poisonous Maya.
The unfortunate ones do not meet the True Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit har ras har aap peeaaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself inspires us to drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Elixir.
Through the Perfect Guru, O Nanak, the Lord is obtained. ||4||3||55||
Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: merai man tan prem naam aadhaar ||
verses.translation: The Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of my mind and body.
I chant the Naam; the Naam is the essence of peace. ||1||
So chant the Naam, O my friends and companions.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam binaa mai avar na koiee vaddai bhaag gurmukh har lainaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, there is nothing else for me. By great good fortune, as Gurmukh, I have received the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
Without the Naam, I cannot live.
By great good fortune, the Gurmukhs obtain the Naam. ||2||
Those who lack the Naam have their faces rubbed in the dirt of Maya.
Without the Naam, cursed, cursed are their lives. ||3||

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਵਡਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਗ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaa vaddaa har bhaag kar paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Great Lord is obtained by great good destiny.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh is blessed with the Naam. ||4||4||56||
Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:
I sing His Glorious Praises, and through the Word of His Bani, I speak His Glorious Praises.
As Gurmukh, I chant and recite the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap jap naam man bhiaa ana(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: Chanting and meditating on the Naam, my mind becomes blissful.

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sat sat satigur naam dhiRaiaa ras gaae gun paramaana(n)dhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has implanted the True Name of the True Lord within me; I sing His Glorious Praises, and taste the supreme ecstasy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaavai har jan logaa ||
verses.translation: The humble servants of the Lord sing the Lord's Glorious Praises.
By great good fortune, the detached, absolute Lord is obtained. ||2||
Those without virtue are stained by Maya's filth.
Lacking virtue, the egotistical die, and suffer reincarnation. ||3||
The ocean of the body yields pearls of virtue.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh churns this ocean, and discovers this essence. ||4||5||57||
Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:
I listen to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Naam is pleasing to my mind.
By great good fortune, the Gurmukh obtains the Lord. ||1||
Chant the Naam, as Gurmukh, and be exalted.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam binaa mai dhar nahee kaiee naam raviaa sabh saas giraasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, I have no other support; the Naam is woven into all my breaths and morsels of food. ||1||Pause||
The Naam illuminates my mind; listening to it, my mind is pleased.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo naam sunaavai so meraa meet sakhaiee ||2||
verses.translation: One who speaks the Naam - he alone is my friend and companion. ||2||
Without the Naam, the fools depart naked.

verses.original: ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pach pach mue bikh dhekh pata(n)gaa ||3||
verses.translation: They burn away to death, chasing the poison of Maya, like the moth chasing the flame. ||3||
He Himself establishes, and, having established, disestablishes.
O Nanak, the Lord Himself bestows the Naam. ||4||6||58||
Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:
The vine of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, has taken root in the Gurmukh.
It bears the fruit of the Lord; its taste is so tasty! ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam jap anat tara(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in endless waves of joy.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jap jap naam gurmat saalaahee maariaa kaal jamaka(n)kar bhuia(n)gaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chant and repeat the Naam; through the Guru's Teachings praise the Lord, and slay the horrible serpent of the Messenger of Death. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har har gur meh bhagat rakhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord has implanted His devotional worship in the Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur tuThaa sikh dhevai mere bhaiee ||2||
verses.translation: When the Guru is pleased, He bestows it upon His Sikh, O my siblings of Destiny. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: haumai karam kichh bidh nahee jaanai ||
verses.translation: One who acts in ego, knows nothing about the Way.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਨਾਇ ਖਾਕੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau ku(n)char nai khaak sir chhaanai ||3||
verses.translation: He acts like an elephant, who takes a bath, and then throws dust on his head. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ॥
verses.translit: je vadd bhaag hoveh vadd uooche ||
verses.translation: If one's destiny is great and exalted,
O Nanak, one chants the Naam, the Name of the Immaculate, True Lord. ||4||7||59||
Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam kee man bhookh lagaiee ||
verses.translation: My mind suffers hunger for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਨਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam suniaai man tirapatai mere bhaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Hearing the Naam, my mind is satisfied, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||1||
Chant the Naam, O my friends, O GurSikhs.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam japahu naame sukh paavahu naam rakhahu gurmat man cheetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chant the Naam, and through the Naam, obtain peace; through the Guru's Teachings, enshrine the Naam in your heart and mind. ||1||Pause||
Hearing the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind is in bliss.
Reaping the profit of the Naam, through the Guru's Teachings, my soul has blossomed forth. ||2||
Without the Naam, the mortal is a leper, blinded by emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਦੁਖੁ ਧੰਧਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh nihafal karam ke'ee dhukh dha(n)dhaa ||3||
verses.translation: All his actions are fruitless; they lead only to painful entanglements. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਪੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har har jas japai vaddabhaagee ||
verses.translation: The very fortunate ones chant the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, one embraces love for the Naam. ||4||8||60||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa raag aasaa ghar chhayvaa ke 3 ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla, Raag Aasaa, 3 Of Sixth House :

verses.original: ਹਥਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਥੋਥਰ ਵਾਜੈ ਬੇਨ ॥
verses.translit: hath kar ta(n)t vajaavai jogee thothar vaajai ben ||
verses.translation: You may pluck the strings with your hand, O Yogi, but your playing of the harp is in vain.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੇਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmat har gun bolahu jogee ih manooaa har ra(n)g bhen ||1||
verses.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O Yogi, and this mind of yours shall be imbued with the Lord's Love. ||1||
O Yogi, give your intellect the Teachings of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਹਮ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jug jug har har eko varatai tis aagai ham aadhes ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the One Lord, is pervading throughout all the ages; I humbly bow down to Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਗ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਖੇਲ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh raag bhaat bahu boleh ih manooaa khelai khel ||
verses.translation: You sing in so many Ragas and harmonies, and you talk so much, but this mind of yours is only playing a game.

verses.original: ਜੋਵਹਿ ਕੂਪ ਸਿੰਚਨ ਕਉ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਉਠਿ ਬੈਲ ਗਏ ਚਰਿ ਬੇਲ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: joveh koop si(n)chan kau basudhaa uTh bail ge char bel ||2||
verses.translation: You work the well and irrigate the fields, but the oxen have already left to graze in the jungle. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਮੈ ਹਰਿਆ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa nagar meh karam har bovahu har jaamai hariaa khet ||
verses.translation: In the field of the body, plant the Lord's Name, and the Lord will sprout there, like a lush green field.

verses.original: ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਬੈਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜੇਤੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: manooaa asathir bail man jovahu har si(n)chahu gurmat jet ||3||
verses.translation: O mortal, hook up your unstable mind like an ox, and irrigate your fields with the Lord's Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਜੋ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਚੇਲ ॥
verses.translit: jogee ja(n)gam sirasaT sabh tumaree jo dheh matee tit chel ||
verses.translation: The Yogis, the wandering Jangams, and all the world is Yours, O Lord. According to the wisdom which You give them, so do they follow their ways.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਪੇਲ ॥੪॥੯॥੬੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ke prabh a(n)tarajaamee har laavahu manooaa pel ||4||9||61||
verses.translation: O Lord God of servant Nanak, O Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts, please link my mind to You. ||4||9||61||
Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਬ ਕੋ ਭਾਲੈ ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਤਾਲਾ ਕਬ ਕੋ ਬਜਾਵੈ ਰਬਾਬੁ ॥
verses.translit: kab ko bhaalai ghu(n)gharoo taalaa kab ko bajaavai rabaab ||
verses.translation: How long must one search for angle bells and cymbals, and how long must one play the guitar?

verses.original: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਾਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਉ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਮਾਰਉ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aavat jaat baar khin laagai hau tab lag samaarau naam ||1||
verses.translation: In the brief instant between coming and going, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਐਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: merai man aaisee bhagat ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: Such is the devotional love which has been produced in my mind.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau har bin khin pal reh na sakau jaise jal bin meen mar jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, I cannot live even for an instant, like the fish which dies without water. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਬ ਕੋਊ ਮੇਲੈ ਪੰਚ ਸਤ ਗਾਇਣ ਕਬ ਕੋ ਰਾਗ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਠਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kab kouoo melai pa(n)ch sat gain kab ko raag dhun uThaavai ||
verses.translation: How long must one tune the five strings, and assemble the seven singers, and how long will they raise their voices in song?

verses.original: ਮੇਲਤ ਚੁਨਤ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਚਸਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: melat chunat khin pal chasaa laagai tab lag meraa man raam gun gaavai ||2||
verses.translation: In the time it takes to select and assemble these musicians, a moment elapses, and my mind sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਬ ਕੋ ਨਾਚੈ ਪਾਵ ਪਸਾਰੈ ਕਬ ਕੋ ਹਾਥ ਪਸਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kab ko naachai paav pasaarai kab ko haath pasaarai ||
verses.translation: How long must one dance and stretch out one's feet, and how long must one reach out with one's hands?

verses.original: ਹਾਥ ਪਾਵ ਪਸਾਰਤ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: haath paav pasaarat bilam til laagai tab lag meraa man raam sam(h)aarai ||3||
verses.translation: Stretching out one's hands and feet, there is a moment's delay; and then, my mind meditates on the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਬ ਕੋਊ ਲੋਗਨ ਕਉ ਪਤੀਆਵੈ ਲੋਕਿ ਪਤੀਣੈ ਨਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kab kouoo logan kau pateeaavai lok pateenai naa pat hoi ||
verses.translation: How long must one satisfy the people, in order to obtain honor?

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੬੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har hiradhai sadh dhiaavahu taa jai jai kare sabh koi ||4||10||62||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, meditate forever in your heart on the Lord, and then everyone will congratulate you. ||4||10||62||
Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat mileeaai har saadhoo mil sa(n)gat har gun gai ||
verses.translation: Join the Sat Sangat, the Lord's True Congregation; joining the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਲਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: giaan ratan baliaa ghaT chaanan agiaan a(n)dheraa jai ||1||
verses.translation: With the sparkling jewel of spiritual wisdom, the heart is illumined, and ignorance is dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: har jan naachahu har har dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O humble servant of the Lord, let your dancing be meditation on the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਹਮ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaise sa(n)t mileh mere bhaiee ham jan ke dhoveh pai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If only I cold meet such Saints, O my Siblings of Destiny; I would wash the feet of such servants. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japahu man mere anadhin har liv lai ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my mind; night and day, center your consciousness on the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo ichhahu soiee fal paavahu fir bhookh na laagai aai ||2||
verses.translation: You shall have the fruits of your desires, and you shall never feel hunger again. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape har apara(n)par karataa har aape bol bulai ||
verses.translation: The Infinite Lord Himself is the Creator; the Lord Himself speaks, and causes us to speak.

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: seiee sa(n)t bhale tudh bhaaveh jin(h) kee pat paaveh thai ||3||
verses.translation: The Saints are good, who are pleasing to Your Will; their honor is approved by You. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਰਾਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਿਉ ਆਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak aakh na raajai har gun jiau aakhai tiau sukh pai ||
verses.translation: Nanak is not satisfied by chanting the Lord's Glorious Praises; the more he chants them, the more he is at peace.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਵਣਜਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੬੩॥
verses.translit: bhagat bha(n)ddaar dhe'ee har apune gun gaahak vanaj lai jai ||4||11||63||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself has bestowed the treasure of devotional love; His customers purchase virtues, and carry them home. ||4||11||63||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕੇ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: raag aasaa ghar atthvaa ke kaafee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Fourth Mehla:
Death is ordained from the very beginning, and yet ego makes us cry.
Meditating on the Naam, as Gurmukh, one becomes stable and steady. ||1||
Blessed is the Perfect Guru, through whom the way of Death is known.

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: laahaa naamu su saar sabadh samaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The sublime people earn the profit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they are absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਡੇਹ ਸਿ ਆਏ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: poorab likhe ddeh s aae maiaa ||
verses.translation: The days of one's life are pre-ordained; they will come to their end, O mother.

verses.original: ਚਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲਿੑ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chalan aj k kali(h) dhurahu furamaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: One must depart, today or tomorrow, according to the Lord's Primal Order. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: birathaa janam tinaa jin(h)ee naam visaariaa ||
verses.translation: Useless are the lives of those, who have forgotten the Naam.

verses.original: ਜੂਐ ਖੇਲਣੁ ਜਗਿ ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jooaai khelan jag k ih man haariaa ||3||
verses.translation: They play the game of chance in this world, and lose their mind to vices. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan maran sukh hoi jin(h)aa gur paiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who have found the Guru are at peace, in life and in death.
O Nanak, the true ones are truly absorbed into the True Lord. ||4||12||64||
Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:
Having obtained the treasure of this human birth, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
By Guru's Grace, I understand, and I am absorbed into the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) dhur likhiaa lekh tin(h)ee naam kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny practice the Naam.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhar sachai sachiaar mahal bulaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Lord summons the truthful to the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||
Deep within is the treasure of the Naam; it is obtained by the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anadhin naam dhiaai har gun gaieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar vasat anek manmukh nahee paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Deep within are infinite substances, but the self-willed manmukh does not find them.
In egotism and pride, the mortal's proud self consumes him. ||3||
O Nanak, his identity consumes his identical identity.
Through the Guru's Teachings, the mind is illumined, and meets the True Lord. ||4||13||65||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੬ ਕੇ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸੁਧੰਗ
verses.translit: raag aasaavaree ghar solavaa ke 2 mahalaa chauthhaa sudha(n)g
verses.translation: Raag Aasaavaree, 2 Of Sixteenth House, Fourth Mehla, Sudhang:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau anadhin har naam keeratan karau ||
verses.translation: Night and day, I sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur mo kau har naam bataiaa hau har bin khin pal reh na sakau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has revealed to me the Name of the Lord; without the Lord, I cannot live, for a moment, even an instant. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਹਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: hamarai sravan simaran har keeratan hau har bin reh na sakau hau ik khin ||
verses.translation: My ears hear the Lord's Kirtan, and I contemplate Him; without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਹੰਸੁ ਸਰਵਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaise ha(n)s saravar bin reh na sakai taise har jan kiau rahai har sevaa bin ||1||
verses.translation: As the swan cannot live without the lake, how can the Lord's slave live without serving Him? ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਰਿਦ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਮੋਹ ਅਪਮਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: kinahoo(n) preet laiee dhoojaa bhaau ridh dhaar kinahoo(n) preet laiee moh apamaan ||
verses.translation: Some enshrine love for duality in their hearts, and some pledge love for worldly attachments and ego.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੬੬॥
verses.translit: har jan preet laiee har nirabaan padh naanak simarat har har bhagavaan ||2||14||66||
verses.translation: The Lord's servant embraces love for the Lord and the state of Nirvaanaa; Nanak contemplates the Lord, the Lord God. ||2||14||66||
Aasaavaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਮੋਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: maiee moro preetam raam bataavahu ree maiee ||
verses.translation: O mother, my mother, tell me about my Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਹਲੁ ਬੇਲਿ ਰੀਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau har bin khin pal reh na sakau jaise karahal bel reejhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, I cannot live for a moment, even an instant; I love Him, like the camel loves the vine. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਬਿਰਕਤੁ ਭਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਮੀਤ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hamaraa man bairaag birakat bhio har dharasan meet kai taiee ||
verses.translation: My mind has become sad and distant, longing for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my Friend.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaise al kamalaa bin reh na sakai taise moh har bin rahan na jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: As the bumblebee cannot live without the lotus, I cannot live without the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਖੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: raakh saran jagadheesur piaare moh saradhaa poor har gusaiee ||
verses.translation: Keep me under Your Protection, O Beloved Master of the Universe; fulfill my faith, O Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੩੯॥੧੩॥੧੫॥੬੭॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kai man anadh hot hai har dharasan nimakh dhikhaiee ||2||39||13||15||67||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak's mind is filled with bliss, when he beholds the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, even for an instant. ||2||39||13||15||67||

verses.translit: raag aasaa ghar doojaa mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, Second House, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin laiee preet soiee fir khaiaa ||
verses.translation: One who loves her, is ultimately devoured.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬੈਠਾਲੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin sukh baiThaalee tis bhau bahut dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: One who seats her in comfort, is totally terrified by her.
Siblings, friends and family, beholding her, argue.
But she has come under my control, by Guru's Grace. ||1||
Beholding her, all are bewitched:

verses.original: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਨੁਖਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਭਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹਨਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhik sidh suradhev manukhaa bin saadhoo sabh dhrohan dhrohe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: the strivers, the Siddhas, the demi-gods, angels and mortals. All, except the Saadhus, are deceived by her deception. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: eik fireh udhaasee tin(h) kaam viaapai ||
verses.translation: Some wander around as renunciates, but they are engrossed in sexual desire.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: eik sa(n)cheh girahee tin(h) hoi na aapai ||
verses.translation: Some grow rich as householders, but she does not belong to them.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਸਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਲਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: eik satee kahaaveh tin(h) bahut kalapaavai ||
verses.translation: Some call themselves men of charity, and she torments them terribly.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਲਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ham har raakhe lag satigur paavai ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord has saved me, by attaching me to the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||
She leads astray the penitents who practice penance.
The scholarly Pandits are all seduced by greed.
The world of the three qualities is enticed, and the heavens are enticed.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ham satigur raakhe dhe kar haath ||3||
verses.translation: The True Guru has saved me, by giving me His Hand. ||3||
She is the slave of those who are spiritually wise.
With her palms pressed together, she serves them and offers her prayer:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo too(n) kaheh su kaar kamaavaa ||
verses.translation: "Whatever you wish, that is what I shall do."

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak gurmukh neR na aavaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, she does not draw near to the Gurmukh. ||4||1||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
I have been separated from my Beloved by Maya (my mother-in-law).
Hope and desire (my younger brother-in-law and sister-in-law) are dying of grief.

verses.original: ਘਰ ਕੇ ਜਿਠੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ke jiThere kee chookee kaan ||
verses.translation: I am no longer swayed by the fear of Death (my elder brother-in-law).
I am protected by my All-knowing, Wise Husband Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sunahu lokaa mai prem ras paiaa ||
verses.translation: Listen, O people: I have tasted the elixir of love.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਵੈਰੀ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhurajan maare vairee sa(n)ghaare satigur mo kau har naam dhivaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The evil ones are dead, and my enemies are destroyed. The True Guru has given me the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
First, I renounced my egotistical love of myself.
Second, I renounced the ways of the world.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun tiaag dhurajan meet samaane ||
verses.translation: Renouncing the three qualities, I look alike upon friend and enemy.
And then, the fourth state of bliss was revealed to me by the Holy One. ||2||
In the cave of celestial bliss, I have obtained a seat.
The Lord of Light plays the unstruck melody of bliss.
I am in ecstasy, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤੀ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pria siau raatee dhan sohaagan naar ||3||
verses.translation: Imbued with my Beloved Husband Lord, I am the blessed, happy soul-bride. ||3||
Servant Nanak chants the wisdom of God;

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo sune kamaavai su utarai paar ||
verses.translation: one who listens and practices it, is carried across and saved.

verses.original: ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: janam na marai na aavai na jai ||
verses.translation: He is not born, and he does not die; he does not come or go.
He remains blended with the Lord. ||4||2||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The bride shows such special devotion, and has such an agreeable disposition.
Her beauty is incomparable, and her character is perfect.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jit gireh vasai so girahu sobhaava(n)taa ||
verses.translation: The house in which she dwells is such a praiseworthy house.
But rare are those who, as Gurmukh, attain that state||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਮ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sukaranee kaaman gur mil ham paiee ||
verses.translation: As the soul-bride of pure actions, I have met with the Guru.
In worship, marriage and in the next world, such a soul-bride looks beautiful. ||1||Pause||
As long as she lived with her father,
her Husband wandered around in sadness.
I served and surrendered to the Lord, the True Being;

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਆਣੀ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਤਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur aanee ghar meh taa sarab sukh paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: the Guru brought my bride to my home, and I obtained total happiness. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਤੀਹ ਸੁਲਖਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਤਤਿ ਪੂਤ ॥ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸੁਘੜ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
verses.translit: bateeh sulakhanee sach sa(n)tat poot || aagiaakaaree sughaR saroop ||
verses.translation: She is blessed with all sublime attributes, and her generations are unblemished.
Her Husband, her Lord and Master, fulfills her heart's desires.
Hope and desire (my younger brother-in-law and sister-in-law) are now totally content. ||3||
She is the most noble of all the family.
She counsels and advises her hope and desire.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su girahu jit pragaTee aai ||
verses.translation: How blessed is that household, in which she has appeared.
O servant Nanak, she passes her time in perfect peace and comfort. ||4||3||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਤਾ ਕਰਉ ਸੋ ਪਕਨਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ ॥
verses.translit: mataa karau so pakan na dheiee ||
verses.translation: Whatever I resolve, she does not allow it to come to pass.
She stands blocking the way of goodness and self-discipline.
She wears many disguises, and assumes many forms,

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਸਨਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਵਖਿ ਵਖਿ ਭਰਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gireh basan na dheiee vakh vakh bharamaavai ||1||
verses.translation: and she does not allow me to dwell in my own home. She forces me to wander around in different directions. ||1||

verses.original: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਇਕਿ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ghar kee naik ghar vaas na dhevai ||
verses.translation: She has become the mistress of my home, and she does not allow me to live in it.
If I try, she fights with me. ||1||Pause||
In the beginning, she was sent as a helper,

verses.original: ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਜੀਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰ ॥
verses.translit: nau kha(n)dd jeete sabh thaan thana(n)tar ||
verses.translation: but she has overwhelmed the nine continents, all places and interspaces.

verses.original: ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਜੋਗ ਸੰਨਿਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: taT teerath na chhoddai jog sa(n)niaas ||
verses.translation: She has not spared even the river banks, the sacred shrines of pilgrimage, the Yogis and Sannyaasees,
or those who tirelessly read the Simritees and study the Vedas. ||2||
Wherever I sit, she sits there with me.
She has imposed her power upon the whole world.

verses.original: ਹੋਛੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hochhee saran piaa rahan na paiee ||
verses.translation: Seeking meager protection, I am not protected from her.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਮੀਤਾ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu meetaa hau kai peh jaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Tell me, O my friend: unto whom should I turn for protection? ||3||
I heard of His Teachings, and so I have come to the True Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur har har naam moh ma(n)tr dhiraRaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has implanted the Mantra of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, within me.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: nij ghar vasiaa gun gai ana(n)taa ||
verses.translation: And now, I dwell in the home of my own inner self; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.
I have met God, O Nanak, and I have become care-free. ||4||
My home is now my own, and she is now my mistress.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਆਮਰਿ ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਦਰਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: eeh aamar ham gur ke'ee dharabaaree ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||4||4||
verses.translation: She is now my servant, and the Guru has made me intimate with the Lord. ||1||Second Pause||4||4||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
First, they advised me to send a letter.
Second, they advised me to send two men.
Third, they advised me to make the effort and do something.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਹੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mai sabh kichh chhodd prabh tuhee dhiaaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: But I have renounced everything, and I meditate only on You, God. ||1||
Now, I am totally blissful, carefree and at ease.

verses.original: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਤ ਮੁਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhusaman dhoot mue sukh paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The enemies and evil-doers have perished, and I have obtained peace. ||1||Pause||
The True Guru has imparted the Teachings to me.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh har kaa dhes ||
verses.translation: My soul, body and everything belong to the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੀ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh karee su teraa taan ||
verses.translation: Whatever I do, is by Your Almighty Power.
You are my only Support, You are my only Court. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੁਧਨੋ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈਂ ਧਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tudhano chhodd jaieeaai prabh kai(n) dhar ||
verses.translation: If I were to renounce You, God, unto whom could I turn?
There is no other, comparable to You.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: tere sevak kau kis kee kaan ||
verses.translation: Who else is Your servant to serve?
The faithless cynics are deluded; they wander around in the wilderness. ||3||
Your Glorious Greatness cannot be described.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਕਹ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh keh raakh laih gal lai ||
verses.translation: Wherever I am, you save me, hugging me close in Your embrace.
Nanak, Your slave, has entered Your Sanctuary.
God has preserved his honor, and congratulations are pouring in. ||4||5||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Having wandered through foreign lands, I have come here to do business.
I heard of the incomparable and profitable merchandise.
I have gathered in my pockets my capital of virtue, and I have brought it here with me.
Beholding the jewel, this mind is fascinated. ||1||
I have come to the door of the Trader.
Please display the merchandise, so that the business may be transacted. ||1||Pause||
The Trader has sent me to the Banker.
The jewel is priceless, and the capital is priceless.
O my gentle brother, mediator and friend
- I have obtained the merchandise, and my consciousness is now steady and stable. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਤਸਕਰ ਪਉਣ ਨ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhau nahee tasakar paun na paanee ||
verses.translation: I have no fear of thieves, of wind or water.
I have easily made my purchase, and I easily take it away.

verses.original: ਸਤ ਕੈ ਖਟਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sat kai khaTiaai dhukh nahee paiaa ||
verses.translation: I have earned Truth, and I shall have no pain.
I have brought this merchandise home, safe and sound. ||3||
I have earned the profit, and I am happy.
Blessed is the Banker, the Perfect Bestower.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eih saudhaa gurmukh kinai viralai paiaa ||
verses.translation: How rare is the Gurmukh who obtains this merchandise;
Nanak has brought this profitable merchandise home. ||4||6||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: gun avagan mero kachh na beechaaro ||
verses.translation: He does not consider my merits or demerits.
He does not look at my beauty, color or decorations.

verses.original: ਚਜ ਅਚਾਰ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: chaj achaar kichh bidh nahee jaanee ||
verses.translation: I do not know the ways of wisdom and good conduct.
But taking me by the arm, my Husband Lord has led me to His Bed. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿਬੋ ਸਖੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਕੀਅਲੋ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sunibo sakhee ka(n)t hamaaro keealo khasamaanaa ||
verses.translation: Hear, O my companions, my Husband, my Lord Master, possesses me.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨੈ ਇਹੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਅਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar masatak dhaar raakhio kar apunaa kiaa jaanai ih lok ajaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Placing His Hand upon my forehead, He protects me as His Own. What do these ignorant people know? ||1||Pause||
My married life now appears so beauteous;

verses.original: ਕੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮੇਰੋ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜੋਹਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)t milio mero sabh dhukh johio ||
verses.translation: my Husband Lord has met me, and He sees all my pains.
Within the courtyard of my heart, the glory of the moon shines.
Night and day, I have fun with my Beloved. ||2||
My clothes are dyed the deep crimson color of the poppy.
All the ornaments and garlands around my neck adorn me.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪੇਖੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: pria pekhee dhirasaT paae sagal nidhaan ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon my Beloved with my eyes, I have obtained all treasures;
I have shaken off the power of the evil demons. ||3||
I have obtained eternal bliss, and I constantly celebrate.

verses.original: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: nau nidh naam gireh meh tirapataane ||
verses.translation: With the nine treasures of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am satisfied in my own home.
Says Nanak, when the happy soul-bride is adorned by her Beloved,
she is forever happy with her Husband Lord. ||4||7||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
They give you donations and worship you.
You take from them, and then deny that they have given anything to you.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jit dhar tum(h) hai braahaman jaanaa ||
verses.translation: That door, through which you must ultimately go, O Brahmin
- at that door, you will come to regret and repent. ||1||
Such Brahmins shall drown, O Siblings of Destiny;
they think of doing evil to the innocent. ||1||Pause||
Within them is greed, and they wander around like mad dogs.
They slander others and carry loads of sin upon their heads.
Intoxicated by Maya, they do not think of the Lord.
Deluded by doubt, they wander off on many paths. ||2||
Outwardly, they wear various religious robes,
but within, they are enveloped by poison.
They instruct others, but do not understand themselves.
Such Brahmins will never be emancipated. ||3||
O foolish Brahmin, reflect upon God.
He watches and hears, and is always with you.
Says Nanak, if this is your destiny,
renounce your pride, and grasp the Guru's Feet. ||4||8||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਭਏ ਗਤੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh rog bhe gat tan te man niramal har har gun gai ||
verses.translation: Pain and disease have left my body, and my mind has become pure; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਬ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhe ana(n)dh mil saadhoo sa(n)g ab meraa man kat hee na jai ||1||
verses.translation: I am in bliss, meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and now, my mind does not go wandering. ||1||
My burning desires are quenched, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, O mother.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਓ ਤਾਪ ਸਭ ਸਹਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: binas gio taap sabh sahasaa gur seetal milio sahaj subhai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The fever of doubt has been totally eliminated; meeting the Guru, I am cooled and soothed, with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹੇ ਏਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਆਇ ਬਸੇ ਅਬ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavat rahe ek ik boojhiaa aai base ab nihachal thai ||
verses.translation: My wandering has ended, since I have realized the One and Only Lord; now, I have come to dwell in the eternal place.

verses.original: ਜਗਤੁ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jagat udhaaran sa(n)t tumaare dharasan pekhat rahe aghai ||2||
verses.translation: Your Saints are the Saving Grace of the world; beholding the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, I remain satisfied. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਦੋਖ ਪਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਾਛੈ ਅਬ ਪਕਰੇ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: janam dhokh pare mere paachhai ab pakare nihachal saadhoo pai ||
verses.translation: I have left behind the sins of countless incarnations, now that I have grasped the feet of the eternal Holy Guru.
My mind sings the celestial melody of bliss,

verses.original: ਅਬ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ab taa kau fun kaal na khai ||3||
verses.translation: and death shall no longer consume it. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath hamaare sukhadhaiee mere har har rai ||
verses.translation: My Lord, the Cause of all causes, is All-powerful, the Giver of peace; He is my Lord, my Lord King.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: naam teraa jap jeevai naanak ot pot merai sa(n)g sahai ||4||9||
verses.translation: Nanak lives by chanting Your Name, O Lord; You are my helper, with me, through and through. ||4||9||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The slanderer cries out and bewails.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham paramesar bisariaa apanaa keetaa paavai ni(n)dhak ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has forgotten the Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Lord; the slanderer reaps the rewards of his own actions. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਲੇ ਲਏ ਸਿਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: je koiee us kaa sa(n)gee hovai naale le sidhaavai ||
verses.translation: If someone is his companion, then he shall be taken along with him.

verses.original: ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਅਜਗਰੁ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਏ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anahodhaa ajagar bhaar uThaae ni(n)dhak aganee maeh jalaavai ||1||
verses.translation: Like the dragon, the slanderer carries his huge, useless loads, and burns in his own fire. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਜਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਤੀਤੈ ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: paramesar kai dhuaarai j hoi biteetai su naanak aakh sunaavai ||
verses.translation: Nanak proclaims and announces what happens at the Door of the Transcendent Lord.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ਬਿਗਸਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kau sadhaa ana(n)dh hai har keeratan gai bigasaavai ||2||10||
verses.translation: The humble devotees of the Lord are forever in bliss; singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, they blossom forth. ||2||10||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Even though I totally decorated myself,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਭੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tau bhee meraa man na pateeaaraa ||
verses.translation: still, my mind was not satisfied.
I applied various scented oils to my body,

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: oh sukh til samaan nahee paavau ||
verses.translation: and yet, I did not obtain even a tiny bit of pleasure from this.
Within my mind, I hold such a desire,
that I may live only to behold my Beloved, O my mother. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਧੀਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: maiee kahaa karau ih man na dheerai ||
verses.translation: O mother, what should I do? This mind cannot rest.
It is bewitched by the tender love of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||
Garments, ornaments, and such exquisite pleasures

verses.original: ਓਇ ਭੀ ਜਾਨਉ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: oi bhee jaanau kitai na lekhai ||
verses.translation: I look upon these as of no account.
Likewise, honor, fame, dignity and greatness,
obedience by the whole world,
and a household as beautiful as a jewel.
If I am pleasing to God's Will, then I shall be blessed, and forever in bliss. ||2||
With foods and delicacies of so many different kinds,
and such abundant pleasures and entertainments,
power and property and absolute command

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨ ਜਾਇਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: man nahee dhraapai tirasanaa na jais ||
verses.translation: with these, the mind is not satisfied, and its thirst is not quenched.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਇਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਨ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: bin milabe ih dhin na bihaavai ||
verses.translation: Without meeting Him, this day does not pass.

verses.original: ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਾ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: milai prabhoo taa sabh sukh paavai ||3||
verses.translation: Meeting God, I find peace. ||3||
By searching and seeking, I have heard this news,
that without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, no one swims across.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis masatak bhaag tin satigur paiaa ||
verses.translation: One who has this good destiny written upon his forehead, finds the True Guru.
His hopes are fulfilled, and his mind is satisfied.
When one meets God, then his thirst is quenched.
Nanak has found the Lord, within his mind and body. ||4||11||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Panch-Padhay:
First, your social status is high.
Second, you are honored in society.
Third, your home is beautiful.
But you are so ugly, with self-conceit in your mind. ||1||
O beautiful, attractive, wise and clever woman:

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਗਰਬੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਫਾਕੀ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: at garabai moh faakee too(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: you have been trapped by your pride and attachment. ||1||Pause||
Your kitchen is so clean.
You take your bath, and worship, and apply the crimson mark upon your forehead;
with your mouth you speak wisdom, but you are destroyed by pride.
The dog of greed has ruined you in every way. ||2||
You wear your robes and enjoy pleasures;
you practice good conduct to impress people;
you apply scented oils of sandalwood and musk,
but your constant companion is the demon of anger. ||3||
Other people may be your water-carriers;
in this world, you may be a ruler.
Gold, silver and wealth may be yours,
but the goodness of your conduct has been destroyed by sexual promiscuity. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau dhirasaT miaa har rai ||
verses.translation: That soul, upon whom the Lord has bestowed His Glance of Grace,
is delivered from bondage.
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord's sublime essence is obtained.
Says Nanak, how fruitful is that body. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਬਨੇ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh roop sabh sukh bane suhaagan ||
verses.translation: All graces and all comforts shall come to you, as the happy soul-bride;

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਬਿਚਖਨਿ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: at su(n)dhar bichakhan too(n) ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||12||
verses.translation: you shall be supremely beautiful and wise. ||1||Second Pause||12||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Ek-Thukay 2 :
One who is seen to be alive, shall surely die.
But he who is dead shall remain ever-lasting. ||1||
Those who die while yet alive, shall through this death, live on.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam avakhadh mukh paiaa gur sabadhee ras a(n)mrit peeve ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They place the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, as medicine in their mouths, and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
The clay pot of the body shall be broken.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis chhooTai tirakuTee tis nij ghar vaasaa ||2||
verses.translation: One who has eliminated the three qualities dwells in the home of his inner self. ||2||
One who climbs high, shall fall into the nether regions of the underworld.

verses.original: ਧਰਨਿ ਪੜੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਕਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dharan paRai tis lagai na kaalaa ||3||
verses.translation: One who lies upon the ground, shall not be touched by death. ||3||

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhramat fire tin kichhoo na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who continue to wander around, achieve nothing.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: se asathir jin gur sabadh kamaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: Those who practice the Guru's Teachings, become steady and stable. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh har kaa maal ||
verses.translation: This body and soul all belong to the Lord.
O Nanak, meeting the Guru, I am enraptured. ||5||13||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The puppet of the body has been fashioned with great skill.
Know for sure that it shall turn to dust. ||1||
Remember your origins, O thoughtless fool.

verses.original: ਇਤਨੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eitane kau tum(h) kiaa garabe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Why are you so proud of yourself? ||1||Pause||
You are a guest, given three meals a day;
other things are entrusted to you. ||2||
you are just excrement, bones and blood, wrapped up in skin
- this is what you are taking such pride in! ||3||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਤਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਪਾਕ ॥
verses.translit: ek vasat boojheh taa hoveh paak ||
verses.translation: If you could understand even one thing, then you would be pure.
Without understanding, you shall be forever impure. ||4||
Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru;

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥੫॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: jis te paieeaai har purakh sujaan ||5||14||
verses.translation: through Him, I obtain the Lord, the All-knowing Primal Being. ||5||14||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Ek-Thukay, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: eik ghaRee dhinas mo kau bahut dhihaare ||
verses.translation: One moment, one day, is for me many days.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਿਲਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man na rahai kaise milau piaare ||1||
verses.translation: My mind cannot survive - how can I meet my Beloved? ||1||

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਪਲੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: eik pal dhinas mo kau kabahu na bihaavai ||
verses.translation: I cannot endure one day, even one instant without Him.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਘਨੇਰੀ ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan kee man aas ghaneree koiee aaisaa sa(n)t mo kau pireh milaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind's desire for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is so great. Is there any Saint who can lead me to meet my Beloved? ||1||Pause||
The four watches of the day are like the four ages.

verses.original: ਰੈਣਿ ਭਈ ਤਬ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: rain bhiee tab a(n)t na jaane ||2||
verses.translation: And when night comes, I think that it shall never end. ||2||
The five demons have joined together, to separate me from my Husband Lord.
Wandering and rambling, I cry out and wring my hands. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau har dharas dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord has revealed the Blessed Vision of His Darshan to servant Nanak;
realizing his own self, he has obtained supreme peace. ||4||15||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
In the Lord's service, are the greatest treasures.
Serving the Lord, the Ambrosial Naam comes into one's mouth. ||1||
The Lord is my Companion; He is with me, as my Help and Support.

verses.original: ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਤਹ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ਜਮੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਡਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh simaree teh maujoodh jam bapuraa mo kau kahaa ddaraiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In pain and pleasure, whenever I remember Him, He is present. How can the poor Messenger of Death frighten me now? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: har meree oT mai har kaa taan ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my Support; the Lord is my Power.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har meraa sakhaa man maeh dheebaan ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord is my Friend; He is my mind's advisor. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: har meree poo(n)jee meraa har vesaahu ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my capital; the Lord is my credit.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh dhan khaTee har meraa saahu ||3||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I earn the wealth, with the Lord as my Banker. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te ieh mat aavai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, this wisdom has come.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har kai a(n)k samaavai ||4||16||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has merged into the Being of the Lord. ||4||16||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh hoi kirapaal ta ih man laiee ||
verses.translation: When God shows His Mercy, then this mind is focused on Him.
Serving the True Guru, all rewards are obtained. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਕਰਹਿਗਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: man kiau bairaag karahigaa satigur meraa pooraa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, why are you so sad? My True Guru is Perfect.

verses.original: ਮਨਸਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: manasaa kaa dhaataa sabh sukh nidhaan a(n)mirat sar sadh hee bharapooraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is the Giver of blessings, the treasure of all comforts; His Ambrosial Pool of Nectar is always overflowing. ||1||Pause||
One who enshrines His Lotus Feet within the heart,
meets the Beloved Lord; the Divine Light is revealed to him. ||2||
The five companions have met together to sing the songs of joy.
The unstruck melody, the sound current of the Naad, vibrates and resounds. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur naanak tuThaa miliaa har rai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when the Guru is totally pleased, one meets the Lord, the King.
Then, the night of one's life passes in peace and natural ease. ||4||17||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Showing His Mercy, the Lord has revealed Himself to me.
Meeting the True Guru, I have received the perfect wealth. ||1||
Gather such a wealth of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਲੈ ਜਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ ਸੰਗੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhaeh na jaalai jal nahee ddoobai sa(n)g chhodd kar katahu na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It cannot be burned by fire, and water cannot drown it; it does not forsake society, or go anywhere else. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: toT na aavai nikhuT na jai ||
verses.translation: It does not run short, and it does not run out.
Eating and consuming it, the mind remains satisfied. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: so sach saahu jis ghar har dhan sa(n)chaanaa ||
verses.translation: He is the true banker, who gathers the wealth of the Lord within his own home.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਸਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eis dhan te sabh jag varasaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: With this wealth, the whole world profits. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: tin har dhan paiaa jis purab likhe kaa lahanaa ||
verses.translation: He alone receives the Lord's wealth, who is pre-ordained to receive it.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਾਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: jan naanak a(n)t vaar naam gahanaa ||4||18||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, at that very last moment, the Naam shall be your only decoration. ||4||18||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Just like the farmer, He plants His crop,
and, whether it is ripe or unripe, He cuts it down. ||1||
Just so, you must know this well, that whoever is born, shall die.

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਗਤੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: govi(n)dh bhagat asathir hai theeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Only the devotee of the Lord of the Universe becomes stable and permanent. ||1||Pause||
The day shall certainly be followed by the night.
And when the night passes, the morning shall again dawn. ||2||
In the love of Maya, the unfortunate ones remain in sleep.
By Guru's Grace, a rare few remain awake and aware. ||3||
Says Nanak, sing continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Your face shall be radiant, and your consciousness shall be immaculately pure. ||4||19||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The nine treasures are Yours - all treasures are Yours.
The Fulfiller of desires saves mortals in the end. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਤਾ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੂਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) mero piaaro taa kaisee bhookhaa ||
verses.translation: You are my Beloved, so what hunger can I have?

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਦੂਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) man vasiaa lagai na dhookhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When You dwell within my mind, pain does not touch me. ||1||Pause||
Whatever You do, is acceptable to me.
O True Lord and Master, True is Your Order. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tudh bhaavai taa har gun gaau ||
verses.translation: When it is pleasing to Your Will, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਆਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: terai ghar sadhaa sadhaa hai niaau ||3||
verses.translation: Within Your Home, there is justice, forever and ever. ||3||
O True Lord and Master, You are unknowable and mysterious.
Nanak is committed to Your service. ||4||20||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: nikaT jeea kai sadh hee sa(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: He is near at hand; He is the eternal Companion of the soul.
His Creative Power is all-pervading, in form and color. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰ੍ਹੈ ਨ ਝੁਰੈ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: karhai na jhurai naa man rovanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: My mind does not worry; it does not grieve, or cry out.

verses.original: ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avinaasee avigat agochar sadhaa salaamat khasam hamaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Imperishable, Unshakable, Unapproachable and forever safe and sound is my Husband Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਰੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: tere dhaasare kau kis kee kaan ||
verses.translation: Unto whom does Your servant pay homage?
His King preserves his honor. ||2||
That slave, whom God has released from the restrictions of social status

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਲਉਡੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਤਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tis laudde kau kis kee taat ||3||
verses.translation: - who can now hold him in bondage? ||3||
The Lord is absolutely independent, and totally care-free;
O servant Nanak, chant His Glorious Praises. ||4||21||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਹੋਛੈ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har ras chhodd hochhai ras maataa ||
verses.translation: Forsaking the Lord's sublime essence, the mortal is intoxicated with false essences.

verses.original: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ghar meh vasat baahar uTh jaataa ||1||
verses.translation: The substance is within the home of the self, but the mortal goes out to find it. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: sunee na jaiee sach a(n)mirat kaathaa ||
verses.translation: He cannot hear the true ambrosial discourse.

verses.original: ਰਾਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਝੂਠੀ ਲਗਿ ਗਾਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raar karat jhooThee lag gaathaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Attached to false scriptures, he is engaged in argument. ||1||Pause||
He takes his wages from his Lord and Master, but he serves another.
With such sins, the mortal is engrossed. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਕ ਜੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: tis siau look jo sadh hee sa(n)gee ||
verses.translation: He tries to hide from the One who is always with him.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੰਗੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kaam na aavai so fir fir ma(n)gee ||3||
verses.translation: He begs from Him, again and again. ||3||
Says Nanak, God is merciful to the meek.
As it pleases Him, He cherishes us. ||4||22||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeea praan dhan har ko naam ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my soul, my life, my wealth.
Here and hereafter, it is with me, to help me. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਵਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਥੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin har naam avar sabh thoraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, everything else is useless.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tirapat aghaavai har dharasan man moraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind is satisfied and satiated by the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||Pause||
Gurbani is the jewel, the treasure of devotion.
Singing, hearing and acting upon it, one is enraptured. ||2||
My mind is attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet.
The True Guru, in His Pleasure, has given this gift. ||3||
Unto Nanak, the Guru has revealed these instructions:
recognize the Imperishable Lord God in each and every heart. ||4||23||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The All-pervading Lord has established joys and celebrations.
He Himself embellishes His own works. ||1||
Perfect is the Creation of the Perfect Lord Master.

verses.original: ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਸੋਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bharipur dhaar rahee sobh jaa kee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: His magnificent greatness is totally all-pervading. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan jaa kee niramal soi ||
verses.translation: His Name is the treasure; His reputation is immaculate.
He Himself is the Creator; there is no other. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh taa kai haath ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures are in His Hands.

verses.original: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: rav rahiaa prabh sabh kai saath ||3||
verses.translation: God is pervading in all, and is always with them. ||3||
The Perfect Guru has fashioned His perfect fashion.
O Nanak, the Lord's devotees are blessed with glorious greatness. ||4||24||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬਨਾਵਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh banaavahu ih man ||
verses.translation: I have shaped this mind in the mold of the Guru's Word.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur kaa dharasan sa(n)chahu har dhan ||1||
verses.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I have gathered the wealth of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਤੂੰ ਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: uootam mat merai ridhai too(n) aau ||
verses.translation: O sublime understanding, come, enter into my mind,

verses.original: ਧਿਆਵਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaavau gaavau gun govi(n)dhaa at preetam moh laagai naau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: that I may meditate and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and love so dearly the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
I am satisfied and satiated by the True Name.
My cleansing bath at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage is the dust of the Saints. ||2||
I recognize that the One Creator is contained in all.
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my understanding is refined. ||3||
I have become the servant of all; I have renounced my ego and pride.
The Guru has given this gift to Nanak. ||4||25||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
My intellect has been enlightened, and my understanding is perfect.
Thus my evil-mindedness, which kept me far from Him, has been removed. ||1||
Such are the Teachings which I have received from the Guru;

verses.original: ਬੂਡਤ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: booddat ghor a(n)dh koop meh nikasio mere bhaiee re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: while I was drowning in the pitch black well, I was saved, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਾਹ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mahaa agaeh agan kaa saagar || gur bohith taare ratanaagar ||2||
verses.translation: The Guru is the boat to cross over the totally unfathomable ocean of fire; He is treasure of jewels. ||2||
This ocean of Maya is dark and treacherous.
The Perfect Guru has revealed the way to cross over it. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਕਛੁ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaap taap kachh ukat na moree ||
verses.translation: I do not have the ability to chant or practice intense meditation.
Guru Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||4||26||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Thi-Padhay:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har ras peevat sadh hee raataa ||
verses.translation: One who drinks in the Lord's sublime essence is forever imbued with it,

verses.original: ਆਨ ਰਸਾ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aan rasaa khin meh leh jaataa ||
verses.translation: while other essences wear off in an instant.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: har ras ke maate man sadhaa ana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Intoxicated with the Lord's sublime essence, the mind is forever in ecstasy.
Other essences bring only anxiety. ||1||
One who drinks in the Lord's sublime essence, is intoxicated and enraptured;

verses.original: ਆਨ ਰਸਾ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਛੇ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aan rasaa sabh hochhe re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: all other essences have no effect. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har ras kee keemat kahee na jai ||
verses.translation: The value of the Lord's sublime essence cannot be described.
The Lord's sublime essence permeates the homes of the Holy.
One may spend thousands and millions, but it cannot be purchased.
He alone obtains it, who is so pre-ordained. ||2||
Tasting it, Nanak is wonder-struck.
Through the Guru, Nanak has obtained this taste.

verses.original: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: e'eet uoot kat chhodd na jai ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, it does not leave him.
Nanak is imbued and enraptured with the Lord's subtle essence. ||3||27||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh moh miTaavai chhuTakai dhuramat apunee dhaaree ||
verses.translation: If she renounces and eliminates her sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment, and her evil-mindedness and self-conceit as well;

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hoi nimaanee sev kamaaveh taa preetam hoveh man piaaree ||1||
verses.translation: and if, becoming humble, she serves Him, then she becomes dear to her Beloved's Heart. ||1||
Listen, O beautiful soul-bride: By the Word of the Holy Saint, you shall be saved.

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਮਿਟੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖਮਨਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh bhookh miTai tero sahasaa sukh paaveh too(n) sukhaman naaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your pain, hunger and doubt shall vanish, and you shall obtain peace, O happy soul-bride. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਧੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਿਆਸ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: charan pakhaar karau gur sevaa aatam sudh bikh tiaas nivaaree ||
verses.translation: Washing the Guru's feet, and serving Him, the soul is sanctified, and the thirst for sin is quenched.

verses.original: ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਿ ਦਾਸਰੀ ਤਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhaasan kee hoi dhaas dhaasaree taa paaveh sobhaa har dhuaaree ||2||
verses.translation: If you become the slave of the slave of the Lord's slaves, then you shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਹੀ ਅਚਾਰ ਇਹੀ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: eihee achaar ihee biauhaaraa aagiaa maan bhagat hoi tum(h)aaree ||
verses.translation: This is right conduct, and this is the correct lifestyle, to obey the Command of the Lord's Will; this is your devotional worship.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਹੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: jo ih ma(n)tr kamaavai naanak so bhaujal paar utaaree ||3||28||
verses.translation: One who practices this Mantra, O Nanak, swims across the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||28||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay:
You have been blessed with this human body.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh milan kee ieh teree bareeaa ||
verses.translation: This is your chance to meet the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
