verses.translit: avar kaaj terai kitai na kaam ||
verses.translation: Other efforts are of no use to you.
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, vibrate and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Make the effort, and cross over the terrifying world ocean.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam birathaa jaat ra(n)g maiaa kai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This human life is passing away in vain, in the love of Maya. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam dharam na kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have not practiced meditation, penance, self-restraint or righteous living;

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa saadh na jaaniaa har raiaa ||
verses.translation: I have not served the Holy Saints, and I do not know the Lord, my King.
Says Nanak, my actions are vile and despicable;
O Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary - please, preserve my honor. ||2||29||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: tujh bin avar naahee mai dhoojaa too(n) mere man maahee ||
verses.translation: Without You, there is no other for me; You alone are in my mind.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਜੀਅ ਡਰਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too(n) saajan sa(n)gee prabh meraa kaahe jeea ddaraahee ||1||
verses.translation: You are my Friend and Companion, God; why should my soul be afraid? ||1||
You are my support, You are my hope.

verses.original: ਬੈਠਤ ਊਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: baiThat uooThat sovat jaagat visar naahee too(n) saas giraasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: While sitting down or standing up, while sleeping or waking, with every breath and morsel of food, I never forget You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਵਿਕਰਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: raakh raakh saran prabh apanee agan saagar vikaraalaa ||
verses.translation: Protect me, please protect me, O God; I have come to Your Sanctuary; the ocean of fire is so horrible.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਮ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: naanak ke sukhadhaate satigur ham tumare baal gupaalaa ||2||30||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Giver of peace to Nanak; I am Your child, O Lord of the World. ||2||30||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The Lord God has saved me, His slave.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਾਪੁ ਮੁਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: preetam siau mero man maaniaa taap muaa bikh khai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind has surrendered to my Beloved; my fever has taken poison and died. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਾਲਾ ਤਾਊ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: paalaa taauoo kachhoo na biaapai raam naam gun gai ||
verses.translation: Cold and heat do not touch me at all, when I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਡਾਕੀ ਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ddaakee ko chit kachhoo na laagai charan kamal saranai ||1||
verses.translation: My consciousness is not affected by the witch, Maya; I take to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh bhe kirapaalaa hoe aap sahai ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, the Lord has shown His Mercy to me; He Himself is my Help and Support.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਤਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥੨॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan nit gaavai naanak sahasaa dhukh miTai ||2||31||
verses.translation: Nanak ever sings the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of excellence; his doubts and pains are eliminated. ||2||31||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
I have taken the medicine of the Name of the Lord.
I have found peace, and the seat of pain has been removed. ||1||
The fever has been broken, by the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadh bhiaa sabh miTe visoore ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am in ecstasy, and all of my sorrows have been dispelled. ||1||Pause||
All beings and creatures obtain peace,
O Nanak, meditating on the Supreme Lord God. ||2||32||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
That time, which the mortal does not wish for, eventually comes.
Without the Lord's Command, how can understanding be understood? ||1||
The body is consumed by water, fire and earth.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਬਾਲਾ ਬੂਢਾ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: oh na baalaa booddaa bhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: But the soul is neither young nor old, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||
Servant Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Holy.
By Guru's Grace, he has shaken off the fear of death. ||2||33||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Forever and ever, the soul is illumined;
in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, it dwells at the Feet of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam nit jap man mere ||
verses.translation: Chant the Lord's Name each and every day, O my mind.

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਸਭੇ ਮਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: seetal saa(n)t sadhaa sukh paaveh kilavikh jaeh sabhe man tere ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall find lasting peace, contentment and tranquility, and all your sins shall depart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jaa ke pooran karam ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, one who is blessed with perfect good karma,
meets the True Guru, and obtains the Perfect Supreme Lord God. ||2||34||
Thirty-four Shabads in Second House. ||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੇਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa har suaamee prabh belee ||
verses.translation: She who has the Lord God as her Friend

verses.original: ਪੀੜ ਗਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: peeR giee fir nahee dhuhelee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: her pain is dispelled, and she shall not become sad again. ||1||Pause||
Showing His Mercy, He joins her with His Feet,
and she attains celestial peace, joy and comfort. ||1||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, she sings the Glorious Praises of the Immeasurable Lord.
Remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak, she becomes invaluable. ||2||35||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਏ ਖੇਲਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh maiaa madh matasar e khelat sabh jooaai haare ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger, intoxication with Maya and jealousy - I have lost all of these in the game of chance.

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਇਹ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam sach ieh apunai gireh bheetar vaare ||1||
verses.translation: Purity, contentment, compassion, faith and truthfulness - I have ushered these into the home of my self. ||1||
All the loads of birth and death have been removed.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਇਓ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਲੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: milat sa(n)g bhio man niramal gur poorai lai khin meh taare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Joining the Saints' Society, my mind has become pure; the Perfect Guru has saved me in an instant. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kee ren hoi rahai manooaa sagale dheeseh meet piaare ||
verses.translation: My mind has become the dust of all, and everyone seems a sweet friend to me.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਧੇ ਰਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabh madhe raviaa meraa Thaakur dhaan dhet sabh jeea sam(h)aare ||2||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is contained in all. He gives His Gifts to all beings, and cherishes them. ||2||

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਇਕੁ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਹੈ ਸਗਲਾ ਪਾਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: eko ek aap ik ekai ekai hai sagalaa paasaare ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the One and only; from the One, the One and only, came the expanse of the entire creation.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jap jap hoe sagal saadh jan ek naam dhiaai bahut udhaare ||3||
verses.translation: Chanting and meditating, all the humble beings have become Holy; meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, so many have been saved. ||3||

verses.original: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gahir ga(n)bheer bia(n)t gusaiee a(n)t nahee kichh paaraavaare ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is deep, profound and infinite; He has no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ree kirapaa te gun gaavai naanak dhiaai dhiaai prabh kau namasakaare ||4||36||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises; meditating, meditating, he humbly bows to God. ||4||36||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: too bia(n)t avigat agochar ih sabh teraa aakaar ||
verses.translation: You are Infinite, Eternal and Incomprehensible; all this is Your Creation.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਕਰਹ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਜਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kiaa ham ja(n)t kareh chaturaiee jaa(n) sabh kichh tujhai majhaar ||1||
verses.translation: What clever games can we play, when everything is contained in You? ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਬਾਲਿਕ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲੀਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: mere satigur apane baalik raakhahu leelaa dhaar ||
verses.translation: O my True Guru, protect me, Your child, through the power of Your play.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheh sumat sadhaa gun gaavaa mere Thaakur agam apaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Grant me the good sense to ever sing Your Glorious Praises, O my Inaccessible and Infinite Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਨਨਿ ਜਠਰ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਓਹੁ ਰਹਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaise janan jaThar meh praanee oh rahataa naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: The mortal is preserved in the womb of his mother, by the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord;

verses.original: ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ਨਾ ਪੋਹੈ ਅਗਨਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anadh karai saas saas sam(h)aarai naa pohai aganaar ||2||
verses.translation: he makes merry, and with each and every breath he remembers the Lord, and the fire does not touch him. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: par dhan par dhaaraa par ni(n)dhaa in siau preet nivaar ||
verses.translation: Others' wealth, others' wives, and the slander of others - renounce your craving for these.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੇਵੀ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੈ ਆਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: charan kamal sevee ridh a(n)tar gur poore kai aadhaar ||3||
verses.translation: Serve the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart, and hold to the Support of the Perfect Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਜੋ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਸੰਗਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: girahu ma(n)dhar mahalaa jo dheeseh naa koiee sa(n)gaar ||
verses.translation: Houses, mansions and palaces which you see - none of these shall go with you.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: jab lag jeeveh kalee kaal meh jan naanak naam sam(h)aar ||4||37||
verses.translation: As long as you live in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O servant Nanak, remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||37||
Aasaa, Third House, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਕ ਜੋਬਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੋਭਾ ਰੂਪਵੰਤੁ ਜੋੁਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: raaj milak joban gireh sobhaa roopava(n)t juoaanee ||
verses.translation: Power, property, youth, household, fame and the beauty of youth;

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਹਸਤੀ ਅਰੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਲਾਲ ਲਾਖ ਬੈ ਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: bahut dharab hasatee ar ghoRe laal laakh bai aanee ||
verses.translation: great wealth, elephants, horses and jewels, purchased with tens of thousands of dollars;

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aagai dharageh kaam na aavai chhodd chalai abhimaanee ||1||
verses.translation: hereafter, these shall be of no avail in the Court of the Lord; the proud must depart, leaving them behind. ||1||
Why center your consciousness on any other than the Lord?

verses.original: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: uooThat baiThat sovat jaagat sadhaa sadhaa har dhiaaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Sitting down, standing up, sleeping and waking, forever and ever, meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਆਖਾੜੇ ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਤੇ ਪਵਾੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa bachitr su(n)dhar aakhaaRe ran meh jite pavaaRe ||
verses.translation: He may have the most wondrous and beautiful arenas, and be victorious on the field of battle.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮਾਰਉ ਹਉ ਬੰਧਉ ਛੋਡਉ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਏਵ ਬਬਾੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: hau maarau hau ba(n)dhau chhoddau mukh te ev babaaRe ||
verses.translation: He may proclaim, ""I can kill anyone, I can capture anyone, and I can release anyone.""

verses.original: ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਏਕ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaiaa hukam paarabraham kaa chhodd chaliaa ek dhihaaRe ||2||
verses.translation: But when the Order comes from the Supreme Lord God, he departs and leaves in a day. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharam jugat bahu karataa karanaihaar na jaanai ||
verses.translation: He may perform all sorts of religious rituals and good actions, but he does not know the Creator Lord, the Doer of all.

verses.original: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਤੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: aupadhes karai aap na kamaavai tat sabadh na pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: He teaches, but does not practice what he preaches; he does not realize the essential reality of the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਂਗਾ ਆਇਆ ਨਾਂਗੋ ਜਾਸੀ ਜਿਉ ਹਸਤੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naa(n)gaa aaiaa naa(n)go jaasee jiau hasatee khaak chhaanai ||3||
verses.translation: Naked he came, and naked he shall depart; he is like an elephant, throwing dust on himself. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਝੂਠਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sajan sunahu sabh meetaa jhooThaa eh pasaaraa ||
verses.translation: O Saints, and friends, listen to me: all this world is false.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਡੂਬੇ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: meree meree kar kar ddoobe khap khap mue gavaaraa ||
verses.translation: Continually claiming, ""Mine, mine"", the mortals are drowned; the fools waste away and die.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: gur mil naanak naam dhiaaiaa saach naam nisataaraa ||4||1||38||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, O Nanak, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the True Name, I am emancipated. ||4||1||38||

verses.translit: raag aasaa ghar panjavaa mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, Fifth House, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤ ਧੰਧ ਅੰਧ ॥
verses.translit: bhram meh soiee sagal jagat dha(n)dh a(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The whole world is asleep in doubt; it is blinded by worldly entanglements.
How rare is that humble servant of the Lord who is awake and aware. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮਗਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa mohanee magan pria preet praan ||
verses.translation: The mortal is intoxicated with the great enticement of Maya, which is dearer to him than life.
How rare is the one who renounces it. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਨੂਪ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal aanoop har sa(n)t ma(n)t ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Lotus Feet are incomparably beautiful; so is the Mantra of the Saint.
How rare is that holy person who is attached to them. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak saadhoo sa(n)g jaage giaan ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the love of divine knowledge is awakened;
the Lord's Mercy is bestowed upon those who are blessed with such good destiny. ||4||1||39||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.translit: raag aasaa ghar chhayvaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, Sixth House, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai so paravaanaa sookh sahaj man soiee ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You is acceptable to me; that alone brings peace and ease to my mind.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath apaaraa avar naahee re koiee ||1||
verses.translation: You are the Doer, the Cause of causes, All-powerful and Infinite; there is none other than You. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tere jan rasak rasak gun gaaveh ||
verses.translation: Your humble servants sing Your Glorious Praises with enthusiasm and love.

verses.original: ਮਸਲਤਿ ਮਤਾ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: masalat mataa siaanap jan kee jo too(n) kareh karaaveh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: That alone is good advice, wisdom and cleverness for Your humble servant, which You do or cause to be done. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit naam tumaaraa piaare saadhasa(n)g ras paiaa ||
verses.translation: Your Name is Ambrosial Nectar, O Beloved Lord; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have obtained its sublime essence.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tirapat aghai seiee jan poore sukh nidhaan har gaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Those humble beings are satisfied and fulfilled, singing the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau Tek tum(h)aaree suaamee taa kau naahee chi(n)taa ||
verses.translation: One who has Your Support, O Lord Master, is not afflicted by anxiety.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਭਲੇ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa kau dhiaa tumaaree hoiee se saeh bhale bhagava(n)taa ||3||
verses.translation: One who is blessed by Your Kind Mercy, is the best, the most fortunate king. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਜਬ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bharam moh dhroh sabh nikase jab kaa dharasan paiaa ||
verses.translation: Doubt, attachment, and deceit have all disappeared, since I obtained the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਵਰਤਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੦॥
verses.translit: varatan naam naanak sach keenaa har naame ra(n)g samaiaa ||4||1||40||
verses.translation: Dealing in the Naam, O Nanak, we become truthful, and in the Love of the Lord's Name, we are absorbed. ||4||1 | 40||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਪਰਾਈ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam kee mal dhovai paraiee aapanaa keetaa paavai ||
verses.translation: He washes off the filth of other peoples' incarnations, but he obtains the rewards of his own actions.

verses.original: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਢੋਈ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਚਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: e'eehaa sukh nahee dharageh ddoiee jam pur jai pachaavai ||1||
verses.translation: He has no peace in this world, and he has no place in the Court of the Lord. In the City of Death, he is tortured. ||1||
The slanderer loses his life in vain.

verses.original: ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤੈ ਆਗੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pahuch na saakai kaahoo baatai aagai Thaur na paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He cannot succeed in anything, and in the world hereafter, he finds no place at all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kirat piaa ni(n)dhak bapure kaa kiaa oh karai bichaaraa ||
verses.translation: Such is the fate of the wretched slanderer - what can the poor creature do?

verses.original: ਤਹਾ ਬਿਗੂਤਾ ਜਹ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਓਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tahaa bigootaa jeh koi na raakhai oh kis peh kare pukaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: He is ruined there, where no one can protect him; with whom should he lodge his complaint? ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak kee gat katahoo(n) naahee khasamai evai bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: The slanderer shall never attain emancipation; this is the Will of the Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਤਿਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo jo ni(n)dh kare sa(n)tan kee tiau sa(n)tan sukh maanaa ||3||
verses.translation: The more the Saints are slandered, the more they dwell in peace. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa Tek tumaaree suaamee too(n) sa(n)tan kaa sahaiee ||
verses.translation: The Saints have Your Support, O Lord and Master; You are the Saints' Help and Support.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੀਏ ਰੁੜਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sa(n)t har raakhe ni(n)dhak dhe'ee ruRaiee ||4||2||41||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Saints are saved by the Lord; the slanderers are drowned in the deep. ||4||2||41||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਧੋਇ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਠਉਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਖੋਏ ॥
verses.translit: baahar dhoi a(n)tar man mailaa dhui Thaur apune khoe ||
verses.translation: He washes outwardly, but within, his mind is filthy; thus he loses his place in both worlds.

verses.original: ਈਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਆਗੈ ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਿ ਰੋਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: e'eehaa kaam karodh moh viaapiaa aagai mus mus roe ||1||
verses.translation: Here, he is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment; hereafter, he shall sigh and weep. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਹੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: govi(n)dh bhajan kee mat hai horaa ||
verses.translation: The way to vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe is different.

verses.original: ਵਰਮੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਸਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਰਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸੁਨਈ ਡੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: varamee maaree saap na mariee naam na suniee ddoraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Destroying the snake-hole, the snake is not killed; the deaf person does not hear the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa kee kirat chhodd gavaiee bhagatee saar na jaanai ||
verses.translation: He renounces the affairs of Maya, but he does not appreciate the value of devotional worship.

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਉ ਤਰਕਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਤੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bedh saasatr kau tarakan laagaa tat jog na pachhaanai ||2||
verses.translation: He finds fault with the Vedas and the Shaastras, and does not know the essence of Yoga. ||2||

verses.original: ਉਘਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਜੈਸਾ ਖੋਟਾ ਢਬੂਆ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aughar giaa jaisaa khoTaa ddabooaa nadhar saraafaa aaiaa ||
verses.translation: He stands exposed, like a counterfeit coin, when inspected by the Lord, the Assayer.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee sabh kichh jaanai us te kahaa chhapaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything; how can we hide anything from Him? ||3||

verses.original: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਬੰਚਿ ਨਿੰਮੁਨੀਆਦਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ ਤਤਕਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: kooR kapaT ba(n)ch ni(n)muneeaadhaa binas giaa tatakaale ||
verses.translation: Through falsehood, fraud and deceit, the mortal collapses in an instant - he has no foundation at all.

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਅਪਨੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੨॥
verses.translit: sat sat sat naanak kahiaa apanai hiradhai dhekh samaale ||4||3||42||
verses.translation: Truly, truly, truly, Nanak speaks; look within your own heart, and realize this. ||4||3||42||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: audham karat hovai man niramal naachai aap nivaare ||
verses.translation: Making the effort, the mind becomes pure; in this dance, the self is silenced.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਲੇ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch janaa le vasagat raakhai man meh eka(n)kaare ||1||
verses.translation: The five passions are kept under control, and the One Lord dwells in the mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: teraa jan nirat kare gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: Your humble servant dances and sings Your Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਰਬਾਬੁ ਪਖਾਵਜ ਤਾਲ ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rabaab pakhaavaj taal ghu(n)gharoo anahadh sabadh vajaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He plays upon the guitar, tambourine and cymbals, and the unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਾਛੈ ਅਵਰ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: prathame man parabodhai apanaa paachhai avar reejhaavai ||
verses.translation: First, he instructs his own mind, and then, he leads others.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਾਪੈ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਸਗਲ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raam naam jap hiradhai jaapai mukh te sagal sunaavai ||2||
verses.translation: He chants the Lord's Name and meditates on it in his heart; with his mouth, he announces it to all. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੈ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kar sa(n)g saadhoo charan pakhaarai sa(n)t dhoor tan laavai ||
verses.translation: He joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and washes their feet; he applies the dust of the Saints to his body

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man tan arap dhare gur aagai sat padhaarath paavai ||3||
verses.translation: He surrenders his mind and body, and places them before the Guru; thus, he obtains the true wealth. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਪੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ਸਰਧਾ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo sunai pekhai lai saradhaa taa kaa janam maran dhukh bhaagai ||
verses.translation: Whoever listens to, and beholds the Guru with faith, shall see his pains of birth and death taken away.

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੪੩॥
verses.translit: aaisee nirat narak nivaarai naanak gurmukh jaagai ||4||4||43||
verses.translation: Such a dance eliminates hell; O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains wakeful. ||4||4||43||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਧਮ ਚੰਡਾਲੀ ਭਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੀ ਸੂਦੀ ਤੇ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: adham cha(n)ddaalee bhiee brahamanee soodhee te sresaTaiee re ||
verses.translation: The lowly outcaste becomes a Brahmin, and the untouchable sweeper becomes pure and sublime. The castes mentioned here refer to stages of spiritual evolution.

verses.original: ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਸਖਨੀ ਲਹਬਰ ਬੂਝੀ ਖਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paataalee aakaasee sakhanee lahabar boojhee khaiee re ||1||
verses.translation: The burning desire of the nether regions and the etheric realms is finally quenched and extinguished. ||1||

verses.original: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਲਾਈ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਖਾਈ ਮੂਸਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਡਰਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ghar kee bilaiee avar sikhaiee moosaa dhekh ddaraiee re ||
verses.translation: The house-cat has been taught otherwise, and is hesitant upon seeing the mouse. The house cat is symbolic of the mind in this body and the mouse is symbolic of material gains.

verses.original: ਅਜ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਕੇਹਰਿ ਕੂਕਰ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aj kai vas gur keeno kehar kookar tineh lagaiee re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru has put the tiger under the control of the goat, and now, the dog eats grass. ||1||Pause|| Tiger is symbolic of Ego, goat is symbolic of humility. Dog represents the dark attributes (tamo gun) and grass represents the harmonious attributes (sato gun).

verses.original: ਬਾਝੁ ਥੂਨੀਆ ਛਪਰਾ ਥਾਮਿੑਆ ਨੀਘਰਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: baajh thooneeaa chhaparaa thaami(h)aa neeghariaa ghar paiaa re ||
verses.translation: Without pillars, the roof is supported, and the homeless wandering mind has found a home. Pillars represent material rewards, roof represents the stability of mind.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਜੜੀਏ ਲੈ ਜੜਿਓ ਜੜਾਵਾ ਥੇਵਾ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin jaRe'e lai jaRio jaRaavaa thevaa acharaj laiaa re ||2||
verses.translation: Without any jeweler, the jewelry has been set, and the wonderful stone of naam shines forth. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਾਦੀ ਦਾਦਿ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ਚੂਪੀ ਨਿਰਨਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaadhee dhaadh na pahuchanahaaraa choopee niranau paiaa re ||
verses.translation: The claimant who keeps on complaining does not find justice, but by becoming calm he understands the justice in creation.

verses.original: ਮਾਲਿ ਦੁਲੀਚੈ ਬੈਠੀ ਲੇ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਨੈਨ ਦਿਖਾਲਨੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: maal dhuleechai baiThee le mritak nain dhikhaalan dhaiaa re ||3||
verses.translation: The ego that used to sit on costly carpets has died and the tendency to glare at others has gone away. ||3|| costly carpets is symbolism for place of consequence.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਾ ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਛਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: soiee ajaan kahai mai jaanaa jaananahaar na chhaanaa re ||
verses.translation: One who claims to know, is ignorant; The one who understands, cannot remain hidden.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਪੀਆਇਆ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥੪੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur amiau peeaaiaa rasak rasak bigasaanaa re ||4||5||44||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has given me the Ambrosial Nectar to drink in; savoring it and relishing it, I blossom forth in bliss. ||4||5||44||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ਅਉਗਨ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan kaaT bisaare aaugan apanaa biradh sam(h)aariaa ||
verses.translation: He has cut away my bonds, and overlooked my shortcomings, and so He has confirmed His nature.

verses.original: ਹੋਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤ ਨਿਆਈ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hoe kirapaal maat pit niaaiee baarik jiau pratipaariaa ||1||
verses.translation: Becoming merciful to me, like a mother or a father, he has come to cherish me as His own child. ||1||
The GurSikhs are preserved by the Guru, by the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਮਹਾ ਭਵਜਲ ਤੇ ਅਪਨੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaadd le'ee mahaa bhavajal te apanee nadhar nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He rescues them from the terrible world ocean, casting His Glance of Grace upon them. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran jam te chhuTeeaai halat palat sukh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on Him, we escape from the Messenger of Death; here and hereafter, we obtain peace.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saas giraas japahu jap rasanaa neet neet gun gaieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: With every breath and morsel of food, meditate, and chant with your tongue, continually, each and every day; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat prem param padh paiaa saadhasa(n)g dhukh naaThe ||
verses.translation: Through loving devotional worship, the supreme status is obtained, and in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sorrows are dispelled.

verses.original: ਛਿਜੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗਾਠੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: chhijai na jai kichh bhau na biaape har dhan niramal gaaThe ||3||
verses.translation: I am not worn down, I do not die, and nothing strikes fear in me, since I have the wealth of the Lord's Immaculate Name in my purse. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaal prabh bhe sahaiee it ut raakhanahaare ||
verses.translation: At the very last moment, God becomes the mortal's Help and Support; here and hereafter, He is the Savior Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੀਤ ਹੀਤ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੪੫॥
verses.translit: praan meet heet dhan merai naanak sadh balihaare ||4||6||45||
verses.translation: He is my breath of life, my friend, support and wealth; O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||6||45||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa too(n) saahib taa bhau kehaa hau tudh bin kis saalaahee ||
verses.translation: Since You are my Lord and Master, what is there for me to fear? Other than You, who else should I praise?

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਮੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek too(n) taa sabh kichh hai mai tudh bin dhoojaa naahee ||1||
verses.translation: You are the One and only, and so do all things exist; without You, there is nothing at all for me. ||1||
O Father, I have seen that the world is poison.

verses.original: ਰਖਿਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rakhiaa karahu gusaiee mere mai naam teraa aadhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Save me, O Lord of the Universe! Your Name is my only Support. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਭਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jaaneh birathaa sabhaa man kee hor kis peh aakh sunaieeaai ||
verses.translation: You know completely the condition of my mind; who else could I go to tell of it?

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vin naavai sabh jag bauraiaa naam milai sukh paieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the whole world has gone crazy; obtaining the Naam, it finds peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ਜਿ ਕਹਣਾ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa kaheeaai kis aakh sunaieeaai j kahanaa su prabh jee paas ||
verses.translation: What shall I say? Unto whom shall I speak? What I have to say, I say to God.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh keetaa teraa varatai sadhaa sadhaa teree aas ||3||
verses.translation: Everything which exists was created by You. You are my hope, forever and ever. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: je dheh vaddiaaiee taa teree vaddiaaiee it ut tujheh dhiaau ||
verses.translation: If you bestow greatness, then it is Your greatness; here and hereafter, I meditate on You.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੬॥
verses.translit: naanak ke prabh sadhaa sukhadhaate mai taan teraa ik naau ||4||7||46||
verses.translation: The Lord God of Nanak is forever the Giver of peace; Your Name is my only strength. ||4||7||46||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਏਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਜਨਹਿ ਪੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit naam tum(h)aaraa Thaakur eh mahaa ras janeh peeo ||
verses.translation: Your Name is Ambrosial Nectar, O Lord Master; Your humble servant drinks in this supreme elixir.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਚੂਕੇ ਭੈ ਭਾਰੇ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਬਿਨਾਸਿਓ ਭਰਮੁ ਬੀਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam janam chooke bhai bhaare dhurat binaasio bharam beeo ||1||
verses.translation: The fearful load of sins from countless incarnations has vanished; doubt and duality are also dispelled. ||1||
I live by beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਰੁ ਥੀਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sun kar bachan tum(h)aare satigur man tan meraa Thaar theeo ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Listening to Your Words, O True Guru, my mind and body are cooled and soothed. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਏਹੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ree kirapaa te bhio saadhasa(n)g eh kaaj tum(h) aap keeo ||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, I have joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; You Yourself have caused this to happen.

verses.original: ਦਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਭਈ ਖੀਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhiR kar charan gahe prabh tum(h)re sahaje bikhiaa bhiee kheeo ||2||
verses.translation: Holding fast to Your Feet, O God, the poison is easily neutralized. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਏਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਲੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: sukh nidhaan naam prabh tumaraa eh abinaasee ma(n)tr leeo ||
verses.translation: Your Name, O God, is the treasure of peace; I have received this everlasting Mantra.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਤਾਪੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੈਰੁ ਗੀਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa moh satigur dheenaa taap sa(n)taap meraa bair geeo ||3||
verses.translation: Showing His Mercy, the True Guru has given it to me, and my fever and pain and hatred are annulled. ||3||

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su maanas dhehee paiee jit prabh apanai mel leeo ||
verses.translation: Blessed is the attainment of this human body, by which God blends Himself with me.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੀਓ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੭॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su kalijug saadhasa(n)g keeratan gaieeaai naanak naam adhaar heeo ||4||8||47||
verses.translation: Blessed, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, is the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.O Nanak, the Naam is my only Support. ||4||8||47||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੂਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aagai hee te sabh kichh hooaa avar k jaanai giaanaa ||
verses.translation: Everything is pre-ordained; what else can be known through study?

verses.original: ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhool chook apanaa baarik bakhasiaa paarabraham bhagavaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: The errant child has been forgiven by the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur meraa sadhaa dhiaalaa moh dheen kau raakh leeaa ||
verses.translation: My True Guru is always merciful; He has saved me, the meek one.

verses.original: ਕਾਟਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaaTiaa rog mahaa sukh paiaa har a(n)mrit mukh naam dheeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has cured me of my disease, and I have obtained the greatest peace; He has placed the Ambrosial Name of the Lord in my mouth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਪ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ॥
verses.translit: anik paap mere parahariaa ba(n)dhan kaaTe mukat bhe ||
verses.translation: He has washed away my countless sins; He has cut away my bonds, and I am liberated.

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਾ ਘੋਰ ਤੇ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop mahaa ghor te baeh pakar gur kaadd le'ee ||2||
verses.translation: He has taken me by the arm, and pulled me out of the terrible, deep dark pit. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਰਾਖੇ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau bhe sagal bhau miTiaa raakhe raakhanahaare ||
verses.translation: I have become fearless, and all my fears have been erased. The Savior Lord has saved me.

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aaisee dhaat teree prabh mere kaaraj sagal savaare ||3||
verses.translation: Such is Your generosity, O my God, that You have resolved all my affairs. ||3||
My mind has met with my Lord and Master, the treasure of excellence.
Taking to His Sanctuary, Nanak has become blissful. ||4||9||48||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੂ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) visareh taa(n) sabh ko laagoo cheet aaveh taa(n) sevaa ||
verses.translation: If I forget You, then everyone becomes my enemy. When You come to mind, then they serve me.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਦੂਜਾ ਸੂਝੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: avar na kouoo dhoojaa soojhai saache alakh abhevaa ||1||
verses.translation: I do not know any other at all, O True, Invisible, Inscrutable Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਲੋਗਨ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: cheet aavai taa(n) sadhaa dhiaalaa logan kiaa vechaare ||
verses.translation: When You come to mind, You are always merciful to me; what can the poor people do to me?

verses.original: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: buraa bhalaa kahu kis no kaheeaai sagale jeea tum(h)aare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Tell me, who should I call good or bad, since all beings are Yours? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: teree Tek teraa aadhaaraa haath dhei too(n) raakheh ||
verses.translation: You are my Shelter, You are my Support; giving me Your hand, You protect me.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਿਪੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਭਾਖੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis jan uoopar teree kirapaa tis kau bip na kouoo bhaakhai ||2||
verses.translation: That humble being, upon whom You bestow Your Grace, is not touched by slander or suffering. ||2||

verses.original: ਓਹੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਓਹਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: oho sukh ohaa vaddiaaiee jo prabh jee man bhaanee ||
verses.translation: That is peace, and that is greatness, which is pleasing to the mind of the Dear Lord God.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਦ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: too(n) dhaanaa too(n) sadh miharavaanaa naam milai ra(n)g maanee ||3||
verses.translation: You are all-knowing, You are forever compassionate; obtaining Your Name, I revel in it and make merry. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aagai aradhaas hamaaree jeeau pi(n)dd sabh teraa ||
verses.translation: I offer my prayer before You: my body and soul are all Yours.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੯॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sabh teree vaddiaaiee koiee naau na jaanai meraa ||4||10||49||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, this is all Your greatness; no one even knows my name. ||4||10||49||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh a(n)tarajaamee saadhasa(n)g har paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Show Your Mercy, O God, O Searcher of hearts, that in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I might obtain You, Lord.

verses.original: ਖੋਲਿ ਕਿਵਾਰ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khol kivaar dhikhaale dharasan punarap janam na aaieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: When You open Your Door, and reveal the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, the mortal is not relegated to reincarnation again. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਿਲਉ ਪਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਹਰਉ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: milau pareetam suaamee apune sagale dhookh harau re ||
verses.translation: Meeting with my Beloved Lord and Master, all my pains are taken away.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਨਿੑ ਰਿਦੈ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham jini(h) ridhai araadhiaa taa kai sa(n)g tarau re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am saved and carried across, in the company of those who remember the Supreme Lord God in their hearts. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਪਾਵਕ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਏ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa udhiaan paavak saagar bhe harakh sog meh basanaa ||
verses.translation: This world is a great wilderness, an ocean of fire, in which mortals abide, in pleasure and pain.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਪਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur bheT bhiaa man niramal jap a(n)mrit har rasanaa ||2||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, the mortal becomes immaculately pure; with his tongue, he chants the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਕੀਓ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੋਮਲ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tan dhan thaap keeo sabh apanaa komal ba(n)dhan baa(n)dhiaa ||
verses.translation: He preserves his body and wealth, and takes everything as his own; such are the subtle bonds which bind him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh bhe jan mukate har har naam araadhiaa ||3||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the mortal becomes liberated, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: raakh le'ee prabh raakhanahaarai jo prabh apune bhaane ||
verses.translation: God, the Savior, has saved those, who are pleasing to the Will of God.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਦਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੫੦॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tum(h)raa dhaate naanak sadh kurabaane ||4||11||50||
verses.translation: The soul and body are all Yours, O Great Giver; O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice. ||4||11||50||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਮਲਨ ਨੀਦ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਭਇਓ ਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: moh malan needh te chhuTakee kaun anugrahu bhio ree ||
verses.translation: You have avoided the slumber of attachment and impurity - by whose favor has this happened?

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਗਇਓ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa mohanee tudh na viaapai teraa aalas kahaa gio ree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The great enticer does not affect you. Where has your laziness gone? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਗਾਖਰੋ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਕਉਨ ਛੁਟਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar gaakharo sa(n)jam kaun chhuTio ree ||
verses.translation: How have you escaped from the treachery of sexual desire, anger and egotism?

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਅਸੁਰ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨੀਆ ਸਗਲੋ ਭਵਨੁ ਲੁਟਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sur nar dhev asur trai guneeaa sagalo bhavan luTio ree ||1||
verses.translation: The holy beings, angels and demons of the three qualities, and all the worlds have been plundered. ||1||

verses.original: ਦਾਵਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਜਾਲੇ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿਆ ਬੂਟੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavaa agan bahut tiran jaale koiee hariaa booT rahio ree ||
verses.translation: The forest fire has burnt down so much of the grass; how rare are the plants which have remained green.

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਵਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaiso samarath varan na saakau taa kee upamaa jaat na kahio ree ||2||
verses.translation: He is so All-powerful, that I cannot even describe Him; no one can chant His Praises. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਜਰ ਕੋਠ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਨ ਕਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਰਨੁ ਬਨਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaajar koTh meh bhiee na kaaree niramal baran banio ree ||
verses.translation: In the store-room of the lamp-black, I did not turn black; my color remained immaculate and pure.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਿਓ ਅਚਰਜ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mahaa ma(n)tr gur hiradhai basio acharaj naam sunio ree ||3||
verses.translation: The Guru has implanted the Maha Mantra, the Great Mantra, within my heart, and I have heard the wondrous Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਦਰਿ ਅਵਲੋਕਨ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਚਰਣਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh nadhar avalokan apunai charan lagaiee ||
verses.translation: Showing His Mercy, God has looked upon me with favor, and He has attached me to His feet.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੫੧॥
verses.translit: prem bhagat naanak sukh paiaa saadhoo sa(n)g samaiee ||4||12||51||
verses.translation: Through loving devotional worship, O Nanak, I have obtained peace; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am absorbed into the Lord. ||4||12||51||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.translit: raag aasaa ghar satvaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, Seventh House, Fifth Mehla:
That red dress looks so beautiful on your body.
Your Husband Lord is pleased, and His heart is enticed. ||1||
Whose handiwork is this red beauty of yours?

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਤੂੰ ਭਈ ਗੁਲਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kavan ra(n)g too(n) bhiee gulaalee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whose love has rendered the poppy so red? ||1||Pause||
You are so beautiful; you are the happy soul-bride.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tum ghar laalan tum ghar bhaag ||2||
verses.translation: Your Beloved is in your home; good fortune is in your home. ||2||
You are pure and chaste, you are most distinguished.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਨੀ ਤੁਹੀ ਸੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: too(n) preetam bhaanee tuhee sur giaan ||3||
verses.translation: You are pleasing to Your Beloved, and you have sublime understanding. ||3||
I am pleasing to my Beloved, and so I am imbued with the deep red color.
Says Nanak, I have been totally blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ਇਹ ਹਮਰੀ ਘਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sun ree sakhee ieh hamaree ghaal ||
verses.translation: Listen, O companions: this is my only work;

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ਸਵਾਰਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੫੨॥
verses.translit: prabh aap seegaar savaaranahaar ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||1||52||
verses.translation: God Himself is the One who embellishes and adorns. ||1||Second Pause||1||52||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
I suffered in pain, when I thought He was far away;
but now, He is Ever-present, and I receive His instructions. ||1||
My pride is gone, O friends and companions;

verses.original: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bharam giaa gur pir sa(n)g meree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: my doubt is dispelled, and the Guru has united me with my Beloved. ||1||Pause||
My Beloved has drawn me near to Him, and seated me on His Bed;
I have escaped the clutches of others. ||2||
In the mansion of my heart, shines the Light of the Shabad.
My Husband Lord is blissful and playful. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: masatak bhaag mai pir ghar aaiaa ||
verses.translation: According to the destiny written upon my forehead, my Husband Lord has come home to me.
Servant Nanak has obtained the eternal marriage. ||4||2||53||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
My mind is attached to the True Name.
My dealings with other people are only superficial. ||1||
Outwardly, I am on good terms with all;

verses.original: ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਉਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: alipat rahau jaise jal meh kaulaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: but I remain detached, like the lotus upon the water. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੁਖ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: mukh kee baat sagal siau karataa ||
verses.translation: By word of mouth, I talk with everyone;
but I keep God clasped to my heart. ||2||
I may appear utterly terrible,

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਚਰਨ ਕੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sagal charan kee ih man raalaa ||3||
verses.translation: but my mind is the dust of all men's feet.
Servant Nanak has found the Perfect Guru.
Inwardly and outwardly, He has shown me the One Lord. ||4||3||54||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The mortal revels in joy, in the vigor of youth;
but without the Name, he mingles with dust. ||1||
He may wear ear-rings and fine clothes,
and have a comfortable bed, and his mind may be so proud. ||1||Pause||
He may have elephants to ride, and golden umbrellas over his head;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਲੇ ਧਰਨਿ ਗਡਲੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har bhagat binaa le dharan gaddaleeaa ||2||
verses.translation: but without devotional worship to the Lord, he is buried beneath the dirt. ||2||
He may enjoy many women, of exquisite beauty;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਆਦ ਫਿਕਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har ras bin sabh suaadh fikareeaa ||3||
verses.translation: but without the sublime essence of the Lord, all tastes are tasteless. ||3||
Deluded by Maya, the mortal is led into sin and corruption.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the All-powerful, Compassionate Lord. ||4||4||55||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
There is a garden, in which so many plants have grown.
They bear the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam as their fruit. ||1||
Consider this, O wise one,
by which you may attain the state of Nirvaanaa.

verses.original: ਆਸਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਿਖੂਆ ਕੇ ਕੁੰਟਾ ਬੀਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aas paas bikhooaa ke ku(n)Taa beech a(n)mrit hai bhaiee re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: All around this garden are pools of poison, but within it is the Ambrosial Nectar, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||
There is only one gardener who tends it.

verses.original: ਖਬਰਿ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਤ ਪਤ ਡਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: khabar karat hai paat pat ddaalee ||2||
verses.translation: He takes care of every leaf and branch. ||2||
He brings all sorts of plants and plants them there.
They all bear fruit - none is without fruit. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat fal naam jin gur te paiaa ||
verses.translation: One who receives the Ambrosial Fruit of the Naam from the Guru
- O Nanak, such a servant crosses over the ocean of Maya. ||4||5||56||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The pleasures of royalty are derived from Your Name.
I attain Yoga, singing the Kirtan of Your Praises. ||1||
All comforts are obtained in Your Shelter.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਪਰਦੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਖੋਲੑੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhram ke paradhe satigur khol(h)e ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has removed the veil of doubt. ||1||Pause||
Understanding the Command of the Lord's Will, I revel in pleasure and joy.
Serving the True Guru, I obtain the supreme state of Nirvaanaa. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin too(n) jaataa so girasat udhaasee paravaan ||
verses.translation: One who recognizes You is recognized as a householder, and as a renunciate.
Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he dwells in Nirvaanaa. ||3||
One who has obtained the treasure of the Naam

verses.original: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਪੂਰ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੫੭॥
verses.translit: bhanat naanak taa kaa poor khajaanaa ||4||6||57||
verses.translation: - prays Nanak, his treasure-house is filled to overflowing. ||4||6||57||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਜਾਉ ਤ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: teerath jaau ta hau hau karate ||
verses.translation: Journeying to sacred shrines of pilgrimage, I see the mortals acting in ego.
If I ask the Pandits, I find them tainted by Maya. ||1||
Show me that place, O friend,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai har har keeratan neetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are forever sung. ||1||Pause||
The Shaastras and the Vedas speak of sin and virtue;
they say that mortals are reincarnated into heaven and hell, over and over again. ||2||
In the householder's life, there is anxiety, and in the life of the renunciate, there is egotism.
Performing religious rituals, the soul is entangled. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kirapaa te man vas aaiaa ||
verses.translation: By God's Grace, the mind is brought under control;
O Nanak, the Gurmukh crosses over the ocean of Maya. ||4||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭॥੫੮॥
verses.translit: eih asathaan guroo te paieeaai ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||7||58||
verses.translation: This place is found through the Guru. ||1||Second Pause||7||58||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghar meh sookh baahar fun sookhaa ||
verses.translation: Within my home there is peace, and outwardly there is peace as well.
Remembering the Lord in meditation, all pains are erased. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਂਵੈਂ ॥
verses.translit: sagal sookh jaa(n) too(n) chit aa(n)vai(n) ||
verses.translation: There is total peace, when You come into my mind.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: so naam japai jo jan tudh bhaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He alone is pleasing to Your Will, who chants the Naam. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tan man seetal jap naam teraa ||
verses.translation: My body and mind are cooled and soothed, chanting the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਢਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har har japat ddahai dhukh dderaa ||2||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, the house of pain is demolished. ||2||
He alone, who understands the Command of the Lord's Will, is approved.
The True Shabad of the Word of God is his trademark and insignia. ||3||
The Perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me.

verses.original: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੫੯॥
verses.translit: bhanat naanak merai man sukh paiaa ||4||8||59||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, my mind has found peace. ||4||8||59||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Wherever You send me, there I go.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾੲਂੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo tum dheh soiee sukh paae(n)ee ||1||
verses.translation: Whatever You give me, brings me peace. ||1||
I am forever the chaylaa, the humble disciple, of the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World.

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾੲਂੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ree kirapaa te tirapat aghaae(n)ee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, I am satisfied and satiated. ||1||Pause||
Whatever You give me, I wear and eat.
By Your Grace, O God, my life passes peacefully. ||2||
Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on You.
I recognize none as equal to You. ||3||
Says Nanak, this is my continual meditation:
that I may be emancipated, clinging to the Feet of the Saints. ||4||9||60||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
While standing up, and sitting down, and even while asleep, meditate on the Lord.
Walking on the Way, sing the Praises of the Lord. ||1||
With your ears, listen to the Ambrosial Sermon.

verses.original: ਜਾਸੁ ਸੁਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਮਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaas sunee man hoi ana(n)dhaa dhookh rog man sagale lathaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Listening to it, your mind shall be filled with bliss, and the troubles and diseases of your mind shall all depart. ||1||Pause||
While you work at your job, on the road and at the beach, meditate and chant.
By Guru's Grace, drink in the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord. ||2||
The humble being who sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, day and night,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਵਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: so jan jam kee vaaT na paieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: does not have to go with the Messenger of Death. ||3||
One who does not forget the Lord, twenty-four hours a day, is emancipated;

verses.original: ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੬੧॥
verses.translit: gat hovai naanak tis lag paiee ||4||10||61||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I fall at his feet. ||4||10||61||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Remembering Him in meditation, one abides in peace;
one becomes happy, and suffering is ended. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: anadh karahu prabh ke gun gaavahu ||
verses.translation: Celebrate, make merry, and sing God's Glories.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur apanaa sadh sadhaa manaavahu ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, surrender to the True Guru. ||1||Pause||
Act in accordance with the Shabad, the True Word of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: thir ghar baiThe prabh apanaa paavahu ||2||
verses.translation: Remain steady and stable within the home of your own self, and find God. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਰ ਕਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਚੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: par kaa buraa na raakhahu cheet ||
verses.translation: Do not harbor evil intentions against others in your mind,

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tum kau dhukh nahee bhaiee meet ||3||
verses.translation: and you shall not be troubled, O Siblings of Destiny, O friends. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har ta(n)t ma(n)t gur dheen(h)aa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the Tantric exercise, and the Mantra, given by the Guru.
Nanak knows this peace alone, night and day. ||4||11||62||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨੀਚ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis neech kau koiee na jaanai ||
verses.translation: That wretched being, whom no one knows

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਉਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam japat uh chahu ku(n)T maanai ||1||
verses.translation: - chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he is honored in the four directions. ||1||
I beg for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please, give it to me, O Beloved!

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਨ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tumaree sevaa kaun kaun na taare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Serving You, who, who has not been saved? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai nikaT na aavai koiee ||
verses.translation: That person, whom no one wants to be near

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਆ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sagal sirasaT uaa ke charan mal dhoiee ||2||
verses.translation: - the whole world comes to wash the dirt of his feet. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਕਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jo praanee kaahoo na aavat kaam ||
verses.translation: That mortal, who is of no use to anyone at all

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh taa ko japeeaai naam ||3||
verses.translation: - by the Grace of the Saints, he meditates on the Naam. ||3||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the sleeping mind awakens.
Then, O Nanak, God seems sweet. ||4||12||63||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
With my eyes, I behold the One and Only Lord.
Forever and ever, I contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
I sing the Praises of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prataap saadh kai sa(n)ge har har naam dhiaavau re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By the graceful favor of the Saints, I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sagal samagree jaa kai soot paroiee ||
verses.translation: Everything is strung on His string.
He is contained in each and every heart. ||2||
He creates and destroys in an instant.
He Himself remains unattached, and without attributes. ||3||
He is the Creator, the Cause of causes, the Searcher of hearts.
Nanak's Lord and Master celebrates in bliss. ||4||13||64||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
My wandering through millions of births has ended.
I have won, and not lost, this human body, so difficult to obtain. ||1||
My sins have been erased, and my sufferings and pains are gone.

verses.original: ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhe puneet sa(n)tan kee dhoor ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have been sanctified by the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||Pause||
The Saints of God have the ability to save us;
they meet with those of us who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||
My mind is filled with bliss, since the Guru gave me the Mantra of the Lord's Name.
My thirst has been quenched, and my mind has become steady and stable. ||3||
The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is for me the nine treasures, and the spiritual powers of the Siddhas.
O Nanak, I have obtained understanding from the Guru. ||4||14||65||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
My thirst, and the darkness of ignorance have been removed.
Serving the Holy Saints, countless sins are obliterated. ||1||
I have obtained celestial peace and immense joy.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te bhe man niramal har har har har naam sunaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, my mind has become immaculately pure, and I have heard the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
The stubborn foolishness of my mind is gone;
God's Will has become sweet to me. ||2||
I have grasped the Feet of the Perfect Guru,
and the sins of countless incarnations have been washed away. ||3||
The jewel of this life has become fruitful.
Says Nanak, God has shown mercy to me. ||4||15||66||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
I contemplate, forever and ever, the True Guru;

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕੇਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਝਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan kes sa(n)g jhaare ||1||
verses.translation: with my hair, I dust the feet of the Guru. ||1||
Be wakeful, O my awakening mind!

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਆਵਸਿ ਕਾਮਾ ਝੂਠਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin har avar na aavas kaamaa jhooThaa moh mithiaa pasaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, nothing else shall be of use to you; false is emotional attachment, and useless are worldly entanglements. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee baanee siau ra(n)g lai ||
verses.translation: Embrace love for the Word of the Guru's Bani.
When the Guru shows His Mercy, pain is destroyed. ||2||
Without the Guru, there is no other place of rest.
The Guru is the Giver, the Guru gives the Name. ||3||
The Guru is the Supreme Lord God; He Himself is the Transcendent Lord.
Twenty-four hours a day, O Nanak, meditate on the Guru. ||4||16||67||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
He Himself is the tree, and the branches extending out.
He Himself preserves His own crop. ||1||
Wherever I look, I see that One Lord alone.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar aape soiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Deep within each and every heart, He Himself is contained. ||1||Pause||
He Himself is the sun, and the rays emanating from it.
He is concealed, and He is revealed. ||2||
He is said to be of the highest attributes, and without attributes.
Both converge onto His single point. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur bhram bhau khoiaa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt and fear.
With my eyes, I perceive the Lord, the embodiment of bliss, to be everywhere. ||4||17||68||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
I know nothing of arguments or cleverness.
Day and night, I chant Your Name. ||1||
I am worthless; I have no virtue at all.
God is the Creator, the Cause of all causes. ||1||Pause||
I am foolish, stupid, ignorant and thoughtless;

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam tere kee aas man dhaaree ||2||
verses.translation: Your Name is my mind's only hope. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam karam na saadhaa ||
verses.translation: I have not practiced chanting, deep meditation, self-discipline or good actions;
but within my mind, I have worshipped God's Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kichhoo na jaanaa mat meree thoree ||
verses.translation: I know nothing, and my intellect is inadequate.
Prays Nanak, O God, You are my only Support. ||4||18||69||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਖਰ ਦੁਇ ਇਹ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har akhar dhui ieh maalaa ||
verses.translation: These two words, Har, Har, make up my maalaa.
Continually chanting and reciting this rosary, God has become merciful to me, His humble servant. ||1||
I offer my prayer to the True Guru.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa raakhahu saranaiee mo kau dheh hare har japanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Shower Your Mercy upon me, and keep me safe in Your Sanctuary; please, give me the maalaa, the rosary of Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
One who enshrines this rosary of the Lord's Name within his heart,
is freed of the pains of birth and death. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai samaalai mukh har har bolai ||
verses.translation: The humble being who contemplates the Lord within his heart, and chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har, with his mouth,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: so jan it ut kateh na ddolai ||3||
verses.translation: never wavers, here or hereafter. ||3||
Says Nanak, one who is imbued with the Name,

verses.translit: har maalaa taa kai sa(n)g jai ||4||19||70||
verses.translation: goes to the next world with the maalaa of the Lord's Name. ||4||19||70||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa sabh kichh tis kaa hoi ||
verses.translation: All things belong to Him - let yourself belong to Him as well.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis jan lep na biaapai koi ||1||
verses.translation: No stain clings to such a humble being. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa sevak sadh hee mukataa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's servant is liberated forever.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh karai soiee bhal jan kai at niramal dhaas kee jugataa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever He does, is pleasing to His servant; the way of life of His slave is immaculately pure. ||1||Pause||
One who renounces everything, and enters the Lord's Sanctuary
- how can Maya cling to him? ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan jaa ke man maeh ||
verses.translation: With the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in his mind,
he suffers no anxiety, even in dreams. ||3||
Says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Guru.
My doubts and attachments have been totally obliterated. ||4||20||71||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
When my God is totally pleased with me,

verses.original: ਤਾਂ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taa(n) dhookh bharam kahu kaise neraa ||1||
verses.translation: then, tell me, how can suffering or doubt draw near me? ||1||
Continually listening to Your Glory, I live.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਉ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: moh niragun kau leh udhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am worthless - save me, O Lord! ||1||Pause||
My suffering has been ended, and my anxiety is forgotten.
I have obtained my reward, chanting the Mantra of the True Guru. ||2||
He is True, and True is His glory.
Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, keep Him clasped to your heart. ||3||
Says Nanak, what action is there left to do,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੭੨॥
verses.translit: jaa kai man vasiaa har naamaa ||4||21||72||
verses.translation: by one whose mind is filled with the Lord's Name? ||4||21||72||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Sexual desire, anger, and egotism lead to ruin.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har simaran kar har jan chhooTe ||1||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, the Lord's humble servants are redeemed. ||1||
The mortals are asleep, intoxicated with the wine of Maya.

verses.original: ਜਾਗਤ ਭਗਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaagat bhagat simarat har raate ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The devotees remain awake, imbued with the Lord's meditation. ||1||Pause||
In emotional attachment and doubt, the mortals wander through countless incarnations.
The devotees remain ever-stable, meditating on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||2||
Bound to household and possessions, the mortals are lost in the deep, dark pit.
The Saints are liberated, knowing the Lord to be near at hand. ||3||
Says Nanak, one who has taken to God's Sanctuary,
obtains peace in this world, and salvation in the world hereafter. ||4||22||73||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਰੰਗੁ ਹਮ ਮੀਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: too meraa tara(n)g ham meen tumaare ||
verses.translation: You are my waves, and I am Your fish.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too meraa Thaakur ham terai dhuaare ||1||
verses.translation: You are my Lord and Master; I wait at Your Door. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਹਉ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) meraa karataa hau sevak teraa ||
verses.translation: You are my Creator, and I am Your servant.

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saran gahee prabh gunee gaheraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have taken to Your Sanctuary, O God, most profound and excellent. ||1||Pause||
You are my life, You are my Support.
Beholding You, my heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਤੂ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: too meree gat pat too paravaan ||
verses.translation: You are my salvation and honor; You make me acceptable.
You are All-powerful, You are my strength. ||3||
Night and day, I chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the treasure of excellence.
This is Nanak's prayer to God. ||4||23||74||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The mourner practices falsehood;
he laughs with glee, while mourning for others. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੋ ਮੂਆ ਕਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: ko mooaa kaa kai ghar gaavan ||
verses.translation: Someone has died, while there is singing in someone else's house.

verses.original: ਕੋ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੋ ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਪਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ko rovai ko has has paavan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One mourns and bewails, while another laughs with glee. ||1||Pause||
From childhood to old age,
the mortal does not attain his goals, and he comes to regret in the end. ||2||
The world is under the influence of the three qualities.
The mortal is reincarnated, again and again, into heaven and hell. ||3||
Says Nanak, one who is attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord,
becomes acceptable, and his life becomes fruitful. ||4||24||75||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋਇ ਰਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: soi rahee prabh khabar na jaanee ||
verses.translation: She remains asleep, and does not know the news of God.
The day dawns, and then, she regrets. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਧਰਉ ਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: pria prem sahaj man anadh dharau ree ||
verses.translation: Loving the Beloved, the mind is filled with celestial bliss.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕੀ ਲਾਲਸਾ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabh milabe kee laalasaa taa te aalas kahaa karau ree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You yearn to meet with God, so why do you delay? ||1||Pause||
He came and poured His Ambrosial Nectar into your hands,
but it slipped through your fingers, and fell onto the ground. ||2||
You are burdened with desire, emotional attachment and egotism;
it is not the fault of God the Creator. ||3||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the darkness of doubt is dispelled.
O Nanak, the Creator Lord blends us with Himself. ||4||25||76||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
I long for the Lotus Feet of my Beloved Lord.
The wretched Messenger of Death has run away from me. ||1||
You enter into my mind, by Your Kind Mercy.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮ ਸਗਲ ਰੋਗ ਖਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: simarat naam sagal rog khiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all diseases are destroyed. ||1||Pause||
Death gives so much pain to others,

verses.original: ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pahuch na saakeh jan tere kau ||2||
verses.translation: but it cannot even come near Your slave. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਰਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: dharas tere kee piaas man laagee ||
verses.translation: My mind thirsts for Your Vision;
in peaceful ease and bliss, I dwell in detachment. ||3||
Hear this prayer of Nanak:
please, infuse Your Name into his heart. ||4||26||77||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
My mind is satisfied, and my entanglements have been dissolved.
God has become merciful to me. ||1||
By the Grace of the Saints, everything has turned out well.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸੋ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai gireh sabh kichh hai pooran so bheTiaa nirabhai dhanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: His House is overflowing with all things; I have met Him, the Fearless Master. ||1||Pause||
By the Kind Mercy of the Holy Saints, the Naam has been implanted within me.
The most dreadful desires have been eliminated. ||2||
My Master has given me a gift;
the fire has been extinguished, and my mind is now at peace. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਭਾਲ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: miT giee bhaal man sahaj samaanaa ||
verses.translation: My search has ended, and my mind is absorbed in celestial bliss.
Nanak has obtained the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||27||78||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur siau jaa kee ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to their Lord and Master
are satisfied and fulfilled with the perfect food. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਛੂ ਨ ਥੋਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ॥
verses.translit: kachhoo na thoraa har bhagatan kau ||
verses.translation: The Lord's devotees never run short of anything.

verses.original: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਬਿਲਛਤ ਦੇਵਨ ਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: khaat kharachat bilachhat dhevan kau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They have plenty to eat, spend, enjoy and give. ||1||Pause||
One who has the Unfathomable Lord of the Universe as his Master
- how can any mere mortal stand up to him? ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee sevaa dhas asaT sidhaiee ||
verses.translation: One who is served by the eighteen supernatural powers of the Siddhas

verses.original: ਪਲਕ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: palak dhisaT taa kee laagahu paiee ||3||
verses.translation: - grasp his feet, even for an instant. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau dhiaa karahu mere suaamee ||
verses.translation: That one, upon whom You have showered Your Mercy, O my Lord Master
- says Nanak, he does not lack anything. ||4||28||79||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
When I meditate on my True Guru,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tab merai man mahaa sukh paiaa ||1||
verses.translation: my mind becomes supremely peaceful. ||1||
The record of my account is erased, and my doubts are dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam rate jan bhe bhagava(n)taa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, His humble servant is blessed with good fortune. ||1||Pause||
When I remember my Lord and Master,
my fears are dispelled, O my friend. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਮੈ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jau mai oT gahee prabh teree ||
verses.translation: When I took to Your Protection, O God,
my desires were fulfilled. ||3||
Gazing upon the wonder of Your play, my mind has become encouraged.
Servant Nanak relies on You alone. ||4||29||80||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Night and day, the mouse of time gnaws away at the rope of life.
Falling into the well, the mortal eats the sweet treats of Maya. ||1||
Thinking and planning, the night of the life is passing away.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anik ra(n)g maiaa ke chitavat kabahoo na simarai saari(n)gapaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Thinking of the many pleasures of Maya, the mortal never remembers the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhrum kee chhaiaa nihachal girahu baa(n)dhiaa ||
verses.translation: Believing the shade of the tree to be permanent, he builds his house beneath it.

verses.original: ਕਾਲ ਕੈ ਫਾਂਸਿ ਸਕਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਂਧਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaal kai faa(n)s sakat sar saa(n)dhiaa ||2||
verses.translation: But the noose of death is around his neck, and Shakti, the power of Maya, has aimed her arrows at him. ||2||
The sandy shore is being washed away by the waves,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਮੂੜਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: so thaan mooR nihachal kar paiaa ||3||
verses.translation: but the fool still believes that place to be permanent. ||3||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Name of the Lord, the King.
Nanak lives by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||30||81||
