Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Thukay 9:

verses.original: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੂ ਕਰਤੀ ਕੇਲ ॥
verses.translit: aun kai sa(n)g too karatee kel ||
verses.translation: With that, you are engaged in playful sport;

verses.original: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲ ॥
verses.translit: aun kai sa(n)g ham tum sa(n)g mel ||
verses.translation: with that, I am joined to you.

verses.original: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਲੋਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: aun(h) kai sa(n)g tum sabh kouoo lorai ||
verses.translation: With that, everyone longs for you;

verses.original: ਓਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋਊ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: os binaa kouoo mukh nahee jorai ||1||
verses.translation: without it, no one would even look at your face. ||1||
Where is that detached soul now contained?

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਦੁਹੇਰੀ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin tuhee dhuheree ree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without it, you are miserable. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੂ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aun(h) kai sa(n)g too gireh meh maahar ||
verses.translation: With that, you are the woman of the house;

verses.original: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੂ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਜਾਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aun(h) kai sa(n)g too hoiee hai jaahar ||
verses.translation: with that, you are respected.

verses.original: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੂ ਰਖੀ ਪਪੋਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: aun(h) kai sa(n)g too rakhee papol ||
verses.translation: With that, you are caressed;
without it, you are reduced to dust. ||2||

verses.original: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: aun(h) kai sa(n)g teraa maan mahat ||
verses.translation: With that, you have honor and respect;

verses.original: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਾਕੁ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: aun(h) kai sa(n)g tum saak jagat ||
verses.translation: with that, you have relatives in the world.

verses.original: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਥਾਟੀ ॥
verses.translit: aun(h) kai sa(n)g teree sabh bidh thaaTee ||
verses.translation: With that, you are adorned in every way;

verses.original: ਓਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: os binaa too(n) hoiee hai maaTee ||3||
verses.translation: without it, you are reduced to dust. ||3||
That detached soul is neither born, nor dies.
It acts according to the Command of the Lord's Will.
O Nanak, having fashioned the body, the Lord unites the soul with it, and separates them again;
He alone knows His All-powerful creative nature. ||4||31||82||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰਤਾ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਡਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naa oh marataa naa ham ddariaa ||
verses.translation: He does not die, so I do not fear.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕੜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naa oh binasai naa ham kaRiaa ||
verses.translation: He does not perish, so I do not grieve.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਭੂਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: naa oh niradhan naa ham bhookhe ||
verses.translation: He is not poor, so I do not hunger.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਓਸੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਦੂਖੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naa os dhookh na ham kau dhookhe ||1||
verses.translation: He is not in pain, so I do not suffer. ||1||
There is no other Destroyer than Him.
He is my very life, the Giver of life. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਬੰਧਨ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: naa us ba(n)dhan naa ham baadhe ||
verses.translation: He is not bound, so I am not in bondage.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਧੰਧਾ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਧਾਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: naa us dha(n)dhaa naa ham dhaadhe ||
verses.translation: He has no occupation, so I have no entanglements.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਮੈਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa us mail na ham kau mailaa ||
verses.translation: He has no impurities, so I have no impurities.

verses.original: ਓਸੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਤ ਹਮ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: os ana(n)dh ta ham sadh kelaa ||2||
verses.translation: He is in ecstasy, so I am always happy. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਸੋਚੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸੋਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa us soch na ham kau sochaa ||
verses.translation: He has no anxiety, so I have no cares.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਪੋਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa us lep na ham kau pochaa ||
verses.translation: He has no stain, so I have no pollution.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa us bhookh na ham kau tirasanaa ||
verses.translation: He has no hunger, so I have no thirst.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਉਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਤਾਂ ਹਮ ਜਚਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa uh niramal taa(n) ham jachanaa ||3||
verses.translation: Since He is immaculately pure, I correspond to Him. ||3||
I am nothing; He is the One and only.
Before and after, He alone exists.
O Nanak, the Guru has taken away my doubts and mistakes;

verses.original: ਹਮ ਓਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੋਏ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੮੩॥
verses.translit: ham oi mil hoe ik ra(n)gaa ||4||32||83||
verses.translation: He and I, joining together, are of the same color. ||4||32||83||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Serve Him in many different ways;
Dedicate your soul, your breath of life and your wealth to Him.
Carry water for Him, and wave the fan over Him - renounce your ego.
Make yourself a sacrifice to Him, time and time again. ||1||
She alone is the happy soul-bride, who is pleasing to God.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis kai sa(n)g milau meree maiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In her company, I may meet Him, O my mother. ||1||Pause||
I am the water-carrier of the slaves of His slaves.

verses.original: ਉਨੑ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: aun(h) kee ren basai jeea naal ||
verses.translation: I treasure in my soul the dust of their feet.
By that good destiny inscribed upon my forehead, I obtain their society.
Through His Love, the Lord Master meets me. ||2||
I dedicate all to Him - chanting and meditation, austerity and religious observances.
I offer all to Him - good actions, righteous conduct and incense burning.
Renouncing pride and attachment, I become the dust of the feet of the Saints.

verses.original: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੈਨ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aun(h) kai sa(n)g dhekhau prabh nain ||3||
verses.translation: In their society, I behold God with my eyes. ||3||
Each and every moment, I contemplate and adore Him.
Day and night, I serve Him like this.
The Lord of the Universe, the Cherisher of the World, has become merciful;
in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, He forgives us. ||4||33||84||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee preet sadhaa sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: In the Love of God, eternal peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee preet dhukh lagai na koi ||
verses.translation: In the Love of God, one is not touched by pain.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee preet haumai mal khoi ||
verses.translation: In the Love of God, the filth of ego is washed away.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh kee preet sadh niramal hoi ||1||
verses.translation: In the Love of God, one becomes forever immaculate. ||1||
Listen, O friend: show such love and affection to God,

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeea praan ghaT ghaT aadhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: the Support of the soul, the breath of life, of each and every heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee preet bhe sagal nidhaan ||
verses.translation: In the Love of God, all treasures are obtained.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee preet ridhai niramal naam ||
verses.translation: In the Love of God, the Immaculate Naam fills the heart.
In the Love of God, one is eternally embellished.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਭ ਮਿਟੀ ਹੈ ਚਿੰਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: prabh kee preet sabh miTee hai chi(n)t ||2||
verses.translation: In the Love of God, all anxiety is ended. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee preet ih bhavajal tarai ||
verses.translation: In the Love of God, one crosses over this terrible world-ocean.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਡਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee preet jam te nahee ddarai ||
verses.translation: In the Love of God, one does not fear death.
In the Love of God, all are saved.
The Love of God shall go along with you. ||3||
By himself, no one is united, and no one goes astray.
One who is blessed by God's Mercy, joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to You.
O God, You are the Support and the Strength of the Saints. ||4||34||85||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Becoming a king, the mortal wields his royal authority;
oppressing the people, he gathers wealth.
Gathering it and collecting it, he fills his bags.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਡਾਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੑੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh us te ddaar avar kau dheen(h)ee ||1||
verses.translation: But God takes it away from him, and gives it to another. ||1||
The mortal is like an unbaked clay pot in water;

verses.original: ਗਰਬਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਉਆਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: garab garab uaahoo meh pareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: indulging in pride and egotism, he crumbles down and dissolves. ||1||Pause||
Being fearless, he becomes unrestrained.
He does not think of the Creator, who is ever with him.
He raises armies, and collects arms.

verses.original: ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਫੂਕ ਤ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਓ ਸੁਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nikasiaa fook ta hoi gio suaahaa ||2||
verses.translation: But when the breath leaves him, he turns to ashes. ||2||
He has lofty palaces, mansions and queens,
elephants and pairs of horses, delighting the mind;
he is blessed with a great family of sons and daughters.
But, engrossed in attachment, the blind fool wastes away to death. ||3||
The One who created him destroys him.
Enjoyments and pleasures are like just a dream.
He alone is liberated, and possesses regal power and wealth,
O Nanak, whom the Lord Master blesses with His Mercy. ||4||35||86||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The mortal is in love with this,
but the more he has, the more he longs for more.
It hangs around his neck, and does not leave him.
But falling at the feet of the True Guru, he is saved. ||1||
I have renounced and discarded Maya, the Enticer of the world.
I have met the Absolute Lord, and congratulations are pouring in. ||1||Pause||
She is so beautiful, she captivates the mind.

verses.original: ਬਾਟਿ ਘਾਟਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਨਿ ਬਨਿ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: baaT ghaaT gireh ban ban johai ||
verses.translation: On the road, and the beach, at home, in the forest and in the wilderness, she touches us.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
verses.translit: man tan laagai hoi kai meeThee ||
verses.translation: She seems so sweet to the mind and body.
But by Guru's Grace, I have seen her to be deceptive. ||2||
Her courtiers are also great deceivers.
They do not spare even their fathers or mothers.
They have enslaved their companions.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te mai sagale saadhe ||3||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have subjugated them all. ||3||
Now, my mind is filled with bliss;
my fear is gone, and the noose is cut away.
Says Nanak, when I met the True Guru,
I came to dwell within my home in absolute peace. ||4||36||87||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Twenty-four hours a day, he knows the Lord to be near at hand;
he surrenders to the Sweet Will of God.
The One Name is the Support of the Saints;

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hoi rahe sabh kee pag chhaar ||1||
verses.translation: they remain the dust of the feet of all. ||1||
Listen, to the way of life of the Saints, O my Siblings of Destiny;

verses.original: ਉਆ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: auaa kee mahimaa kathan na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: their praises cannot be described. ||1||Pause||
Their occupation is the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
The Kirtan, the Praise of the Lord, the embodiment of bliss, is their rest.

verses.original: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: mitr satr jaa kai ek samaanai ||
verses.translation: Friends and enemies are one and the same to them.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: prabh apune bin avar na jaanai ||2||
verses.translation: They know of no other than God. ||2||
They erase millions upon millions of sins.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਨ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh dhoor karan jeea ke dhaataaraa ||
verses.translation: They dispel suffering; they are givers of the life of the soul.
They are so brave; they are men of their word.
The Saints have enticed Maya herself. ||3||
Their company is cherished even by the gods and the angels.

verses.original: ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸੁ ਸਫਲ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: amogh dharas safal jaa kee sev ||
verses.translation: Blessed is their Darshan, and fruitful is their service.
With his palms pressed together, Nanak offers his prayer:
O Lord, Treasure of Excellence, please bless me with the service of the Saints. ||4||37||88||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
All peace and comforts are in the meditation of the One Name.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sagal dharam har ke gun gaam ||
verses.translation: All righteous actions of Dharma are in the singing of the Lord's Glorious Praises.
The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is so very pure and sacred.
